links.title: More Correct Mass, Worse Answers: Why Power Sampling Can Fail and How to Fix It

evidence: Abstract: reports accuracy drops of up to 18.5 percentage points across models and reasoning benchmarks when Power replaces Base SC8, with seven of nine model-benchmark settings degrading (Figure 1(a)).

Section 6.2, Table 1: Power underperforms Uniform in all six LiveAoPSBench and PHYSICS settings (drops of 1.808-18.474 and 1.934-6.999 points); SoftSat improves five of nine settings, ties one, with largest regression of 1.004 points.

Section 6.1: fixed SoftSat configuration (m=0.75, beta=1, eta=0.25, kappa=64, clip bounds [0.75,17]) across all model-benchmark pairs; eight Base trajectories at temperature 1, top-k=50, max 16,384 tokens; Power and SoftSat are deterministic weighted readouts of the same pool.

Section 5.1 and Appendix D: Lemma 1 (asymptotic expectation equivalence via SLLN and bounded convergence) and Lemma 2 (O(N^-1) second-moment bound under bounded density ratio) are stated with full proofs.

Section 6.5 and Appendix C: weighted realization vs repeated Power-SMC on all 1,118 MoreHopQA Case-5 examples agrees on 99.55% of decisions, accuracy difference 0.089 points with paired-bootstrap 95% CI [-0.268, 0.447], and 7.42x mean inference-time reduction (19.50s to 2.63s).

Section 4, Figure 2: KL expansion (Eq. 9) shows D_KL(q_alpha||p) leading term proportional to (alpha-1)^2/2 times within-problem likelihood variance, supporting the dose-mismatch claim; derivation deferred to supplementary material.

Limitation indicators: only three 4-9B models (Nemotron-4B, Qwen3.5-9B, Ministral-8B) and three benchmarks (BigCodeBench, LiveAoPSBench, PHYSICS); Section 6.3 budget sweep reports 'best beta' per budget (0.25 at N=4 to 2 at N=32), suggesting selection outside the fixed main-table configuration; no code or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic LLM inference-time reasoning paper: analyzes Power Sampling (sequence-level sharpening) interacting with self-consistency, with clear relevance to LLM, reasoning/CoT, and inference/scaling preferences. The core finding (sharpening raises correct-trajectory mass but degrades aggregated answers) is a genuinely interesting, non-obvious negative result with a plausible two-part diagnosis (coverage and dose mismatch). However, the repair (Relative-Rank SoftSat) is a fairly natural reweighting scheme resembling prior probability-weighted self-consistency variants, and the two lemmas are elementary self-normalized importance-sampling results whose theoretical content is modest. Rigor is solid: matched-budget comparisons, a single fixed hyperparameter configuration, diagnostics across all models in the appendix, and a finite-sample validation with bootstrap CI; but N=8 trajectories, only three 4-9B models, and small average gains (+0.175 to +1.491 on BigCodeBench, one tie, regressions up to 1.004) limit evidential weight, and the budget sweep reporting 'best beta' hints at post-hoc selection outside the main table. No code or artifact release is stated. Overall a well-executed, relevant, moderately novel empirical/analytical contribution.

primary_link.title: More Correct Mass, Worse Answers: Why Power Sampling Can Fail and How to Fix It

papers.summary: Power Sampling sharpens a language model's distribution over complete generation trajectories, offering a verifier-free way to improve reasoning at inference time. It also has the potential to serve as a general-purpose front end for a broad range of downstream sampling methods. However, we uncover a striking paradox: Power Sampling can drive more probability mass toward correct trajectories while degrading the downstream inference it is intended to enhance. Using self-consistency as a represent
papers.summary_zh: Power Sampling 透過對完整生成軌跡的分配取 p^α 銳化,標榜無需驗證器即可在推論時改善推理,並可作為多種下游取樣方法的通用前端。本文揭露一個悖論:它能把更多機率質量推向正確軌跡,卻使其欲強化的下游推論變差——以 Self-Consistency 為代表,跨模型與推理基準的準確率最多下跌 18.5 個百分點。作者診斷出兩種失配:劑量失配指固定指數因各題似然離散度不同,而施加差異懸殊的分配變動;覆蓋失配指全域銳化將質量集中於少數主導路徑,高 pass@k 只證明正確軌跡可達,卻未保留下游聚合、搜尋與選取所需的廣泛支撐。據此提出 Relative-Rank SoftSat 修復:以題內相對排名取代原始似然,統一各題劑量;並使高排名增益飽和,保留中等機率路徑。作者另將理想目標取樣連結到共享 Base 候選池上的重要性加權聚合,在相同預算下重複利用 N 條軌跡,並在正邊際條件下漸近保持目標決策。實驗涵蓋三個模型與 BigCodeBench、LiveAoPSBench、PHYSICS:Power 在九個設定中的七個退化,SoftSat 則移除大幅回歸並於五個設定勝出;在 MoreHopQA 上,加權實現與重複 Power-SMC 的決策一致率達 99.55%,推論時間降低 7.42 倍。啟示在於:銳化後的分配不應只以單一輸出品質或 pass@k 評判,更須保留下游決策規則所需的支撐結構。
papers.title: More Correct Mass, Worse Answers: Why Power Sampling Can Fail and How to Fix It
papers.title_zh: 更多正確機率質量,更差的答案:Power Sampling 為何失效與修復之道

links.title: What to Forget in Unlearning? Forget Set Curation for Language Models

evidence: Abstract: introduces CleanSlate, 'a benchmark for verbatim output suppression over songs and books, with model-specific extraction profiles, content-grounded QA, and capability-retention evaluations'.
Section 3: extractability defined via probabilistic extraction with threshold tau=0.001 taken from Cooper et al. [7]; curator is the object under evaluation with the unlearner held fixed.

Section 6, Table 1: under SimNPO, retrieval curators average ~21% forget reduction while EA reaches 99.4% F with 86.3% R suppression and −5.5 pp average validation change; small models (Olmo-3-7B, Qwen3-8B) barely move under retrieval (1.0–2.8% F).
Section 6.3 / Table 3: identical BM25-pre forget sets yield 10.5% (SimNPO), 98.2% (UNDIAL), and 32.8% (RMU) average forgetting, showing curator–unlearner interaction; 'No configuration is selective'.
Section 4: Never Gonna Give You Up has 94.2% coverage at n=5 and 56.4% at n=25 in C_mid across ≥147 documents; Smile has 100% coverage at 50-gram level in C_CC25.

Section 7: authors acknowledge the deliberately narrow scope ('It does not address all forms of concept, entity, or factual unlearning') and that exact-overlap diagnostics miss paraphrase and translation.
Appendix E Table 4 and Appendix G Table 5: full per-model baselines and unlearning hyperparameters (SimNPO beta=2.0, LR 1e-5, etc.) reported; Appendix B specifies 8x NVIDIA H200 compute.

Appendix K Table 8: curator outputs differ in size (2,432–67,323 windows) with fixed epochs, a confound on optimizer-update count that the authors acknowledge as a property of the end-to-end curator; no code or data availability statement appears anywhere in the document.

Appendix F: CleanSlate-QA built with LLM-generated propositions and an OOS filter using gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview and two probe models; prompts included verbatim, but no human validation of QA quality is reported.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-LLM machine unlearning paper with a genuinely underexplored framing: the upstream 'forget set curation' problem mapping suppression requests to unlearning data, instantiated as the CleanSlate benchmark (4,616 songs, 50 books, per-model extraction profiles, 12,088 content-grounded QA pairs). Preference relevance is high: six open-weight LLMs (7B–32B), unlearning algorithms (SimNPO, UNDIAL, RMU), retrieval (BM25, Infini-gram-mini), and benchmark/evaluation construction all match weighted interests. Novelty is solid but partially adjacent to RWKU and Zhu et al. [39], which the paper positions against (Appendix A). Rigor is strong: controlled curator-vs-unlearner factorial designs (Table 3 reuses fixed D_f across unlearners), forget-set-size ablation (Appendix I), per-model baselines (Table 4), and honest acknowledgment that overlap is a lower bound and diagnostic, not causal (Section 4). Evidence is quantitatively dense: EA curator achieves 99.4% average forget reduction but −5.5 pp average validation drop and 86.3% retain suppression (Table 1); the same BM25-pre forget sets yield 10.5%/98.2%/32.8% forgetting under SimNPO/UNDIAL/RMU (Table 3), convincingly showing curator–unlearner interaction. Generalizability is intentionally limited to verbatim output suppression of songs/books, with explicit scope caveats (Section 7). Reproducibility is decent (compute in Appendix B, hyperparameters in Table 5, full prompts in Appendix F, curator sizes in Appendix K) but no code/data release statement, no seed/error-bar reporting, and closed-license works plus licensed lyrics may impede release.

primary_link.title: What to Forget in Unlearning? Forget Set Curation for Language Models

papers.summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted data or behaviors from a trained model without retraining from scratch. Yet most evaluations assume that the examples to forget are already known. In realistic language-model deployments, a requester may ask a model to stop reproducing a song or book without knowing which spans, documents, quotations, or near-duplicates in a trillion-token corpus support that behavior. We study this missing upstream problem, forget set curation: mapping a suppression re
papers.summary_zh: 機器遺忘旨在不從頭重新訓練的前提下,移除已訓練模型中的特定資料或行為,但多數方法與基準都假設遺忘集已知。現實中,請求者可能只要求模型停止重現某首歌或某本書,卻不知道兆級詞元語料中哪些片段、文件或近似副本支援該行為。本文研究這個上游缺失問題——遺忘集策劃,並提出 CleanSlate 基準:涵蓋 4,616 首 Billboard Hot 100 歌曲與 50 本書,提供逐模型的抽取設定檔、內容扎根的 QA 與能力保留評估,評測「請求→策劃資料→固定遺忘演算法→編輯後模型」的完整管線。研究顯示文化作品的語料足跡極為分散:文本透過引用、評論、程式碼與論壇等向外擴散,新作品也可能繼承語料中既有的成語與模板(向內擴散),使遺忘對象遠超過正典副本。結果上,自然詞彙與精確子字串策劃者(BM25、Infini-gram)常導致微弱壓制且成效因模型而異;直接選取評估視窗的評估感知策劃者雖能近乎完全壓制目標續寫,卻伴隨對非請求內容的連帶壓制與模型相關的能力退化(平均最多約 10 個百分點),且同一遺忘集在 SimNPO、UNDIAL、RMU 等遺忘演算法下結果截然不同。限制包括僅涵蓋逐字輸出壓制,精確重疊診斷無法捕捉改述與翻譯。核心訊息是:遺忘集應被視為遺忘問題的評估對象,而非給定前提,實務遺忘應端對端研究。
papers.title: What to Forget in Unlearning? Forget Set Curation for Language Models
papers.title_zh: 機器遺忘該忘什麼?為語言模型策劃遺忘集

links.title: A Four-Axis Trustworthiness Benchmark for LLM-as-Judge in Principle-Based Regulation

evidence: §5 Results: LLM-judge collapses on Consumer Duty keyword-stuffed inputs from 0.74 to 0.27 accuracy (47-point drop, 'compliance theatre'), while holding 0.92 on COBS adversarial
Table 2 (§5): inter-judge Cohen's κ between gpt-oss:120b and different-family kimi-k2.6 drops to 0.16 on Consumer Duty adversarial vs 0.853 on COBS original, localizing the failure to the model

§4 Experimental Setup: six methods compared; bootstrap 95% CIs with 10^4 resamples, McNemar's exact test; calibrators tuned on a 20-scenario dev split; 7–16% of original-scenario judge cells excluded for malformed JSON
Table 1: on original split, LLM-judge reaches 0.96 (COBS) / 0.74 (Cons. Duty) accuracy with post-Platt test ECE 0.040–0.096, while all three sentence-transformer embedders sit at chance (0.50)

Appendix C (Limitations): labels are author-assigned per pre-registered rubric with no external annotator validation; corpus generated by gpt-oss:120b shares model family with one judge, partly mitigated by the second-family judge

Appendix B: Ceca raw score is a sigmoid of positive-minus-negative mean cosine similarity to exemplars (Eq. 1–2) with a Lipschitz bound, followed by Platt scaling; exact per-exemplar counterfactual Δ_e = s − s_∖e

Appendix G (Reproducibility): releases method code, prompts, raw LLM responses, fitted calibrators, full benchmark, and pre-registration tags (v0-rubric-prereg, v1-corpus-frozen) at a public GitHub URL

§5 Cascade analysis: keyword-primary cascade with [0.4,0.6] deferral band scores 0% on COBS adversarial because the primary confidently mis-scores stuffed inputs outside the band — a disclosed structural hazard
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM evaluation/trustworthiness work: a four-axis (accuracy, paraphrase robustness, adversarial robustness, calibration) benchmark for LLM-as-judge in principle-based regulation, with a calibrated exemplar-cluster assessor (Ceca) offering exact counterfactual attribution. Not a pure domain application — the methodology targets LLM-judge reliability, gameability, and auditability, aligning with high-weight preferences (Red Teaming & Evaluation, AI Safety, Interpretability, LLMs). Novelty is moderate: the four-axis framing and pre-registered perturbation suite are new for principle-based regulation, but Ceca recombines prototype networks, Platt scaling, and leave-one-out counterfactuals. Rigor is careful but constrained: pre-registered rubric with tamper-evident git tags, bootstrap CIs (10^4 resamples), McNemar tests, and a different-family second judge (κ=0.16 on Consumer Duty adversarial) to localize the failure model-side; however, the benchmark is small (168 scenarios), labels are author-assigned with no external annotator, ground truth is the generation-time target verdict, calibration uses a 20-scenario dev split, and 7–16% of judge cells are dropped for malformed JSON. Evidence for the headline finding (0.74→0.27, 47-point adversarial drop) is well quantified with CIs and cross-model confirmation, but it rests on a synthetic corpus generated by the same model family as one judge (partly mitigated, openly disclosed). Generalizability of the framework to other principle-based domains is plausible but the benchmark itself is narrow (two FCA principles, cryptoasset promotions, English). Reproducibility is good: prompts, raw responses, calibrators, seeds, and pre-registration tags are released on GitHub.

primary_link.title: A Four-Axis Trustworthiness Benchmark for LLM-as-Judge in Principle-Based Regulation

papers.summary: Principle-based regulation, with evaluative standards such as "fair, clear, and not misleading" or "deliver good outcomes", cannot be reduced to binary predicates, and LLM-as-judge is increasingly used as the substitute. Our position is that any such judge must be evaluated on four axes: accuracy, paraphrase robustness, adversarial robustness, and calibration. We release Principle-Bench, 168 cryptoasset financial-promotion scenarios mapped to two UK FCA principles, with paraphrase, adversarial k
papers.summary_zh: 「公平、清晰且不誤導」等原則型監管標準無法化約為二元謂詞,而 LLM-as-Judge 正日益成為其替代評判者。本文主張任何此類評判者必須在四個軸上被評估:準確率、改述穩健性、對抗穩健性與校準。作者釋出 Principle-Bench:168 個加密資產金融推廣情境,對應英國 FCA 的兩項原則,並在預註冊評分準則下製作改述、關鍵字塞入對抗與邊界擾動切分;另提出 Ceca,一個可校準、可稽核的範例叢集評估器,能輸出逐範例的精確反事實歸因。實驗比較關鍵字計數、三種句向量嵌入器、開源權重 LLM 評判與校準串接,發現沒有方法在四軸上全面勝出。最醒目的發現是:120B LLM 評判在良性輸入上最強,卻在關鍵字塞入的 Consumer Duty 情境上暴跌 47 個準確率點(0.74→0.27),重現法學界警示的「合規表演」;來自不同模型家族的第二評判在該切分上僅有 Cohen's κ=0.16 的一致性,將此弱點定位於模型本身而非語料。串接方法則繼承初級評估器的弱點,在對抗切分上得 0%。限制包括作者自行標註、語料與評判共用模型家族(部分以第二評判緩解)及情境為合成。對治理應用而言,部署級 LLM 評判必須回報逐原則的對抗欺騙率與事後校準,並搭配可稽核、可爭議的歸因層。
papers.title: A Four-Axis Trustworthiness Benchmark for LLM-as-Judge in Principle-Based Regulation
papers.title_zh: 原則型監管下 LLM-as-Judge 的四軸可信度基準(Principle-Bench)

links.title: MathForm: Scaling Mathematical Autoformalization with Knowledge Retrieval and Verification-Guided Refinement

evidence: Abstract: 367K verified examples; average Pass@8 of 88.06% (SC) and 72.37% (CC) across six benchmarks; FATE-H/X CC of 63%/37%
Section 3.1.2: retrieval planner issues targeted queries via LeanExplore (top-2 results) to gather Mathlib definitions before generation, reducing reliance on parametric memory
Section 3.1.3 & Figure 4: verification-guided refinement (max 3 rounds) with compiler diagnostics plus QwQ-32B semantic judge; later rounds contribute 31.0% of retained pairs
Section 3.1.5: decontamination removing any training example sharing a 13-gram with evaluation examples
Section 4.3.2, Table 2: pipeline ablation on FATE with gpt-oss-120b and Qwen3-235B generators; full pipeline exceeds best single-component config by 7.00/6.90 and 8.80/7.46 SC/CC points
Section 4.3.3, Table 3: controlled 100K-example comparison; FormalVerse average CC 60.32% vs FineLeanCorpus 46.53% and NuminaMath-LEAN 41.49%, SC comparable to FineLeanCorpus (77.17 vs 78.25)
Section 4.3.4, Table 4: judge reliability on 200 human-annotated examples, gpt-oss-120b F1 0.8940 vs QwQ-32B 0.8609; gpt-oss-20b used for RL reward
Appendix B, Table 7: MathForm-8B CC (72.37%) remains below Qwen3.7-Plus (83.38%) and DeepSeek-V4-Pro (76.54%), an acknowledged limitation
Appendix B, Table 8: human evaluation on FATE-M/H with two experts preserves the automated ranking (86.67/76.67 on FATE-M)
Appendix A, Tables 5-6: SFT (lr 2e-5, 3 epochs, bs 128) and DAPO RL (lr 1e-6, clip 0.8/1.28, 8 rollouts) hyperparameters on 16 H100s, Lean 4.21.0
Footer: release links to HuggingFace dataset openbmb/FormalVerse, model openbmb/MathForm-8B, and GitHub openbmb/MathForm
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: LLM-driven autoformalization with retrieval augmentation, verification-guided iterative refinement, CoT trajectory reconstruction, and SFT+DAPO RL on Qwen3-8B, aligning strongly with LLM (2.5), reasoning (2.5), agents/tool-use (2.5), RAG (1.8), RL (1.5), and code (2.0) preferences. Novelty is moderate rather than high: retrieval-augmented and tool/verifier-feedback autoformalizers (Aria, DRIFT, ATF, ReForm) already exist; the differentiator is applying retrieval+feedback iteration at data-construction scale rather than inference time (Section 2.1), plus trajectory reconstruction. Rigor is solid: six benchmarks, 9 specialized baselines plus general-purpose LLMs (Tables 1, 7), a five-way pipeline ablation replicated across two generator families showing full pipeline beats the best single component by 7.00/6.90 and 8.80/7.46 SC/CC (Section 4.3.2, Table 2), a controlled data-quality ablation with identical training config (Table 3), 13-gram decontamination (Section 3.1.5), and human evaluation on FATE-M/H (Table 8). Main caveats: the Consistency Check metric and reward hinge on LLM judges (best F1 0.8940 on only 200 human-annotated examples, Table 4), the main evaluation judge gpt-oss-120b is the same model family that drove data-construction generation (self-preference risk only partially mitigated by using QwQ-32B during construction, Section 4.3.4), small FATE/CombiBench subsets, and no explicit limitations section. Generalizability is bounded: the verification loop is Lean/Mathlib-specific, though the recipe plausibly transfers to other formally checkable domains and is validated across two generators. Reproducibility is strong: dataset/model/GitHub releases, full SFT/RL hyperparameters (Appendix A, Tables 5-6), and all prompts in Appendix D; some pipeline components (LeanExplore, Kimina Lean Server) are external dependencies.

primary_link.title: MathForm: Scaling Mathematical Autoformalization with Knowledge Retrieval and Verification-Guided Refinement

papers.summary: Autoformalization is commonly framed as translating natural-language mathematical statements into machine-verifiable formal languages such as Lean 4. However, faithful formalization requires more than translation. Models must map mathematical concepts to the complex hierarchy of types and definitions in formal libraries such as Mathlib, while ensuring that generated statements preserve the meaning of the source propositions. Existing approaches struggle because they rely heavily on the model's p
papers.summary_zh: 自動形式化將自然語言數學敘述翻譯為 Lean 4 等可機器驗證的語言,但現有方法重度依賴模型參數記憶處理 Mathlib 的型別階層與定義,且常見資料管線僅以 Best-of-N 事後過濾單次輸出、缺乏回饋修正,使資料難度受限於模型的單次生成能力。本文提出 MathForm 框架:生成前由檢索規劃器向 Mathlib 取回相關定義與既有形式化以引導生成;候選敘述經編譯檢查與語義一致性判斷(QwQ-32B 擔任評判)後,依失敗回饋迭代修正,最多三輪,把驗證訊號轉為具體修訂指引而非僅做事後篩選。運用此管線,作者建構 FormalVerse——約 367K 個已驗證的 Lean 4 範例,並以 SFT 搭配 DAPO 強化學習(二元獎勵同時要求編譯成功與語義一致)訓練 MathForm-8B。在六個基準上,其平均 Pass@8 達 Syntax Check 88.06% 與 Consistency Check 72.37%,超越多個專門的 32B 自動形式化器;在挑戰性的 FATE-H 與 FATE-X 分別取得 63% 與 37% 的 CC 通過率,增益集中於高度抽象的代數領域,印證知識檢索與驗證引導精煉的互補性。限制方面,與最強通用模型(如 Qwen3.7-Plus)相比,其語義保真度仍稍遜,語義判斷亦依賴 LLM 評判。此工作顯示高品質訓練資料可讓 8B 小模型具備競爭力的自動形式化能力,實現資料與模型的共同演化。
papers.title: MathForm: Scaling Mathematical Autoformalization with Knowledge Retrieval and Verification-Guided Refinement

links.title: CoRun: Padding is Simple and Efficient for Deterministic LLM Inference

evidence: Abstract: 'CoRun ensures determinism while improving throughput by 15-324% over batch-invariant approaches, reducing time-to-first-token by 51.8% and time-per-output-token by 48.6% on average.'

Section III-B, Table I: characterizes kernels as batch-invariant vs position-invariant (e.g., Mean/RMSNorm/Softmax/MatMul position-invariant but not batch-invariant; Ring AllReduce and FlashAttention w/ Split-KV neither), crediting 'shape-consistent reduction' to prior work [15,14].
Section IV-E: formal determinism contract Y(x,s;C,p,a)=Y(x,s;C',p',a') with an induction over autoregressive generation covering isolated prefill base case and fixed-shape decode step.
Section V-B: determinism validation uses vLLM's batch-invariance test harness with only 32 prompts, batch size 1 vs 32, temperature 0.6, seed 42, up to 8 output tokens per prompt.

Section V-F (Ablation Study): 'Disabling Split-KV costs 15-41% when prompt lengths vary... Isolated prefill accounts for the larger share of CoRun's gap to STD'; Fig 12 shows CoRun falls below BI when padding size exceeds 64 with a single active request.

Section VII: explicitly positions CoRun against LLM-42, showing LLM-42 wins for sparse deterministic traffic and variable-concurrency online serving, and reports LLM-42 rollback ratios rising to 45.41% on the MoE Qwen3-30B-A3B (Fig 14b).

Section V-A: 'We implement CoRun in vLLM 0.25.0'; Section IV-C gives exact config flags (--cudagraph_mode=full_decode_only, capture-sizes 256, max-num-reqs 256), but no code release or hardware specification appears in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM systems/serving paper squarely matching the LLM (2.5), Inference & Serving (1.5), and Scaling & Efficiency (1.3) preferences, with RL-rollout motivation; it does not touch the higher-weighted methodology areas (agents, reasoning, prompting, Japanese NLP), capping relevance below top tier. The key insight—batch invariance is stronger than needed because most kernels are position-invariant, so scheduling can fix execution shapes instead—builds on prior 'shape-consistent reduction' observations (Section III-B cites [15,14]) but is a genuinely distinct third design point between batch-invariant kernels (Thinking Machines/SGLang/vLLM) and verified speculation (LLM-42). Rigor is solid: formal Definitions 1-2 (Table I kernel characterization), a determinism contract with an inductive proof (Section IV-E), STD/BI baselines, three models (Qwen3-235B-A22B, DeepSeek-V3, Hy3), three workload classes, ablations (Fig 12-13), and an honest limitations section (Section VII). Evidence is weakened by a small determinism validation (Section V-B: only 32 prompts, 8 output tokens, one seed) and reliance on kernel invariance properties verified in prior work [14]; throughput gains (15-324% over BI, 51.8% TTFT / 48.6% TPOT reductions) are stated and broken down per workload. Generalizability is bounded: the paper itself shows the method fits all-deterministic, high-concurrency offline regimes and fails for sparse deterministic traffic or variable-concurrency serving (Section VII-A/B), with the fixed decode shape chosen at launch. Reproducibility is moderate: vLLM 0.25.0 base, exact config flags and pseudocode for both scheduling algorithms (Section IV-B/C), public workloads and test harness, but no code/artifact release and the Hy3 model's availability is unclear.

primary_link.title: CoRun: Padding is Simple and Efficient for Deterministic LLM Inference

papers.summary: Despite fixed sampling parameters and random seeds, Large Language Model (LLM) inference exhibits output inconsistency, which undermines downstream tasks such as model evaluation and reinforcement learning. A major source of this nondeterminism is batch-dependent GPU execution: dynamic input shapes change kernel tiling and floating-point reduction orders. Existing systems address this problem with batch-invariant kernels, but these kernels restrict optimized tiling and split reductions, increasi
papers.summary_zh: 即使固定取樣參數與隨機種子,LLM 推論輸出仍可能不一致,主要來源是批次相依的 GPU 執行:動態輸入形狀會改變核心分塊與浮點數歸約順序,自迴歸生成再把微小數值擾動放大成不同答案,危及模型評估、除錯與強化學習訓練。現有系統以批次不變核心解決,但這類核心限制最佳化分塊與分割歸約,延遲增加逾 2 倍、輸送量最多損失 74%。本文觀察到多數核心雖非批次不變,卻具有較弱的位置不變性:在相同形狀的批次內移動 token 不改變其結果。據此提出 CoRun,以排程控制執行形狀而非替換整個核心堆疊:預填階段隔離每個請求以保留自然長度;解碼階段將批次填充至最大並行度並重播單一固定形狀的 CUDA Graph;對非位置不變的元件採用確定性集合通訊並關閉解碼時的 Split-KV;另將 RNG 狀態綁定至請求而非批次槽位,並以歸納法證明端對端確定性契約。在 Qwen3-235B-A22B、DeepSeek-V3 與 Hy3 上,CoRun 產生完全相同的輸出,輸送量較批次不變方法提升 15%–324%,TTFT 平均降低 51.8%、TPOT 降低 48.6%。限制在於隔離預填造成 TTFT 階梯效應、低並行時填充浪費,固定最大並行度也不適合流量劇變的線上服務;它特別適合評估與 RL rollout 等全請求都需確定性的離線高並行工作負載。
papers.title: CoRun: Padding is Simple and Efficient for Deterministic LLM Inference
papers.title_zh: CoRun:以填充實現簡單高效的確定性 LLM 推論

links.title: CEDAR-GRPO: Process-Aware Reinforcement Learning for General Abductive Reasoning in LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'CEDAR-GRPO improves every model on every held-out task over both base models and correctness-only GRPO, with average gains of 7.4 and 2.7 points, respectively, and a maximum gain of 30.8 points.'

Section 5.1, Table 1: per-task accuracy for Base vs Cor-GRPO vs CEDAR-GRPO across ART, B-COPA, DefNLI, GoEmo, MuSR-M/O/T, NeuLR, StratQA, MedQA, ML-Debug for all four backbones; CEDAR-GRPO is highest in every column per model (verified cell-by-cell).

Section 5.3, Table 4: ablation grid on Qwen3-4B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B including SFT on same training pool (Avg Δ −0.41/−0.42 vs base), Cor+Cov-GRPO, Cor+Dir-GRPO, Stage-I-only, Stage-II-only, and General Cor-GRPO control (Avg Δ −0.80/−1.73).

Section 4.3 and Appendix D.3: composite reward R=(r_cor+r_cov+r_dir)/3, process rewards scored by openai/gpt-oss-120b at temperature 0.0; Section D.5 reports reward-hacking-risk screening that motivated metric selection.

Section 5.2, Table 3: process metrics for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B: Coverage 33.1%→52.9%, Directionality 0.21→0.60, Diff. Elim. 0.79→1.29, Branchiness 1.22→1.53; held-out process metrics evaluated by Gemini 3 Flash (Appendix E.1).
Section 7 Limitations: 'there is a potential circularity between optimization signal and evaluation', backbones limited to 4-8B, training pool 'relatively small at 2,400 instances'.

Appendix A, Table 5: training pool totals 2,400 samples (1,920 train / 480 validation) across seven datasets; Appendix C.2: single NVIDIA RTX 5090, seeds 3407/42, 'Code and data are available at https://github.com/cedar-grpo/cedar-grpo' (footnote 1).

No confidence intervals, error bars, or statistical significance tests are reported anywhere in Tables 1, 3, or 4; gains over Cor-GRPO on several tasks (e.g., MedQA 37.75 vs 37.50, ML-Debug 29.00 vs 28.50 for Qwen3-4B) are within plausible seed noise.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-scoped LLM reasoning paper squarely matching curator preferences: GRPO post-training with a composite process reward (evidence coverage + evidence-to-explanation directionality) for abductive reasoning, evaluated on 4 open-weight backbones (Qwen3-4B/8B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) across 11 held-out tasks including code debugging, medical QA, and non-abductive controls. The design is unusually careful for this area: a matched SFT baseline on identical data, reward-composition ablations (Cor+Cov vs Cor+Dir), Stage-I/II-only training, and a generic-reasoning GRPO control (Table 4), all of which support the attribution of gains to the abductive composite reward rather than RL or format exposure alone. Main weaknesses temper the score: novelty is incremental over GRPO plus existing process-supervision ideas (authors cite CtrlHGen, DARK, Lightman et al.); results are single-seed with no significance testing and some margins over Cor-GRPO are small (~0.25-2 points) despite consistent direction; the average gain over correctness-only GRPO is 2.7 points; and the authors themselves flag LLM-judge circularity (gpt-oss-120b reward judge vs Gemini 3 Flash metric judge), closed-form benchmark bias, and the 4-8B scale restriction in Section 7. Reproducibility support is strong (hyperparameters, prompts, verifiers, seeds, single RTX 5090, code/data link).

primary_link.title: CEDAR-GRPO: Process-Aware Reinforcement Learning for General Abductive Reasoning in LLMs

papers.summary: Abductive reasoning, often characterized as inference to the best explanation, is central to explanation under uncertainty, from everyday sense-making and investigation to scientific discovery. Yet LLM research has mostly studied abduction through narrow, task-specific benchmarks, making it unclear whether observed gains transfer beyond the benchmark family used for training or evaluation. We ask whether RL post-training can improve abduction as a transferable reasoning capability. We introduce
papers.summary_zh: 溯因推理（abductive reasoning）是從不完整觀察推斷最佳解釋的能力，廣泛出現在臨床診斷、程式除錯與科學假說形成中。既有研究多只在單一基準上評估此能力，難以判斷改善能否跨任務遷移。本文提出 CEDAR-GRPO，結合最終答案正確性與兩項溯因過程獎勵的 GRPO 訓練框架：證據覆蓋率（解釋是否涵蓋觀察細節）與證據到解釋的方向性（推理是否由證據出發），兩者由 gpt-oss-120b 作為評判模型打分。作者在涵蓋假說生成與假說選擇的領域中立資料混合上，對 Qwen3-4B/8B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 與 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 四個開源模型進行後訓練，並在 11 個未見任務（臨床診斷、程式除錯、長上下文調查、非溯因對照等）上驗證。結果顯示 CEDAR-GRPO 在所有任務上皆優於原始模型與僅用正確性的 GRPO，平均分別提升 7.4 與 2.7 分，最高提升 30.8 分；過程指標亦顯示更多分支探索、回溯、差異排除與不確定性標記。消融實驗確認強化學習、獎勵組成與兩階段資料混合各有貢獻，而通用推理資料後訓練反而無效。限制包括仍屬封閉式基準、模型規模限於 4–8B、過程獎勵依賴 LLM 評判可能有循環性，且訓練資料僅 2,400 筆。此研究證明溯因推理可作為可遷移的推理能力加以培養，而非基準特定技巧。
papers.title: CEDAR-GRPO: Process-Aware Reinforcement Learning for General Abductive Reasoning in LLMs
papers.title_zh: CEDAR-GRPO：以過程為導向的強化學習，提升大語言模型的通用溯因推理

links.title: AI Research Preference Models

evidence: Abstract: RPM variants raise AIRS-Bench average normalized score from 0.684 to 0.711 (Inference-only) and 0.729 (Agentic), approaching the validation-oracle ceiling of 0.748.

Section 5.1 'Significance Testing': probability of improvement over the No-RPM baseline is 0.5923 (Inference-only) and 0.5913 (Agentic), with 95% CI lower bounds 0.5066 and 0.5018 via task-stratified bootstrap (rliable).

Section 4.1: end-to-end evaluation on 20 public AIRS-Bench tasks with 24h single-H200 budget and 10 seeds; operators and RPM share the Qwen3.6-27B backbone so improvements are attributable to the framework.

Section 4.2: offline dataset of 1,000 sibling pairs from 40 unreleased image/video/audio AIRS-Bench tasks; Section 7 acknowledges off-policy data and subtree-max label bias, resting main claims on end-to-end results.

Section 7 Limitations: RPM demonstrated only in AIRA-dojo child-selection with a single backbone on a single benchmark; Appendix D shows final-node-selection integration yields no significant improvement over validation-based selection.
Appendix B.2: ablations removing time-budget overstating, feedback mechanism, or GPU access each degrade offline selection accuracy, with tool-call and execution-time analysis in Figures 11-12.
Section 5.1 'Research Efficiency': Inference-only RPM matches the 24h baseline score in 14.88h (1.61x speedup) and Agentic RPM in 15.50h (1.55x).
Appendix A.2.3 Table 1: offline selection accuracy 64.66% (GPT-5), 67.44% (Claude Opus 4.8), 67.40% (Gemini 3.1 Pro), 68.04% (majority vote), 69.35% (LLM-Arbiter).

Section 5.1 'State-of-the-Art Breakthroughs': Agentic RPM reaches 94.1% on WinoGrande (prior agentic SOTA 90.4%) and Inference-only RPM reaches 95.7% on SVAMP (prior human SOTA 94.2%), per the authors' knowledge claim.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper: frozen pretrained LLMs act as preference models (an inference-only judge and an agentic variant running sandboxed pilot experiments) to rank unexecuted code candidates and allocate GPU budget in an AI research agent. Directly relevant to LLMs, agents/tool use, reasoning, and preference/reward modeling. Evaluation is fairly rigorous: 10 seeds, oracle ceilings, rliable bootstrap significance testing, design ablations, and a selection-advantage vs final-score correlation (Pearson r=0.55, p=0.0007). However, effect sizes are modest (probability of improvement ~0.59, CI lower bounds barely above 0.5), results are confined to one scaffold (AIRA-dojo child creation), one backbone (Qwen3.6-27B), and one benchmark; offline tuning data is off-policy from unreleased tasks with acknowledged label bias. Novelty is incremental over Zheng et al. (2026) pairwise prediction and Goldie et al. (2026) unimplemented judge proposal, with the live-tree grounding and pilot-experiment agentic variant as the main deltas. Prompts, Algorithm 1 pseudocode, and hyperparameters are provided, but there is no explicit code-release claim and key offline analyses rely on proprietary frontier models, limiting reproduction.

primary_link.title: AI Research Preference Models

papers.summary: AI research agents (AIRA) can now carry machine learning experiments from proposal through implementation and evaluation. Yet progress on frontier tasks is throttled by the cost of evaluations that can consume days of GPU time. When an agent can propose far more candidates than it can afford to run, progress depends on its research preference: how it allocates a fixed execution budget across many candidates. We introduce AI Research Preference Models (RPMs) that predict which candidate solution
papers.summary_zh: AI 研究代理（AIRA）能自動提出、實作並評估機器學習實驗，但真正的瓶頸在執行成本：訓練一個候選解可能耗費數小時到數天的 GPU 運算，而代理能提出的候選遠多於可執行的數量。本文提出 AI 研究偏好模型（RPM），在執行前預測哪些候選最值得投入運算，將資源配置轉為偏好排序問題。RPM 有兩種變體：僅推論版本以凍結權重的 LLM 對候選計畫、程式碼與歷史解進行推理比較；代理式版本則先在沙盒中執行小規模試點實驗再下判斷。兩者整合於 AIRA-dojo 演化樹搜尋框架，在 AIRS-Bench 的 20 個機器學習任務上評估：平均正規化分數從基線 0.684 提升至 0.711 與 0.729，接近驗證上限 0.748，且約 15 小時即達到未引導代理 24 小時的表現，僅用不到三分之二的執行預算，並在 WinoGrande 與 SVAMP 上達成新 SOTA。離線分析顯示增大搜尋樹上下文、候選池與推理預算皆能提升選擇品質，三個前沿模型搭配 LLM 仲裁者集成可達 69.35% 選擇準確率；選擇優勢與最終分數呈正相關。限制包括離線資料源自貪婪搜尋而具偏差、僅整合於子代建立階段，且只在單一架構、骨幹與基準上驗證。此工作凸顯機器學習研究中「易生成、難驗證」的不對稱性，並把候選選擇視為測試時運算的重要標的。

links.title: Trust Is Not Enough: Influence Calibration for On-Policy Self-Distillation in Agentic RL

evidence: Abstract: 'ICSD improves all matched aggregate metrics over trust-only allocation under Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO), across two model families spanning 1.5B to 7B. At 7B, it reaches 96.1% ALFWorld success and a WebShop score of 93.1.'

Experiments and Results - Setup: 'We evaluate language agents on ALFWorld..., WebShop..., and the seven Search-QA subsets used by Search-R1... Experiments cover Qwen2.5-Instruct models at 1.5B, 3B, and 7B..., as well as Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B.'
Setup: 'Published baseline rows retain the values reported by SDAR; the remaining entries come from our training and evaluation logs.' (mixes inherited and re-run baselines)

Ablations and Analysis - Allocation ablation: 'The Fisher-magnitude control... Its 91.4% average matches GiGPO... Influence-only allocation... 93.0%. Combining both signals gives the full 93.8% result.'

Mechanism analysis: 'Across four matched ALFWorld batches, TCM falls from 60.1% under SDAR to 37.8% under ICSD, a 22.3-point reduction (95% CI [22.1,22.6])' and 'Across sixteen frozen batches, ICSD raises cosine compatibility with the RL gradient by 0.192 (95% CI [0.147,0.240])'.

Appendix C.2 Runtime and Approximation Audit: 'ICSD increases per-token actor-update time by 1.7% over the trust-only SDAR allocator... about 0.4% normalized end-to-end overhead' and '0.128% of tokens fall outside the clip interval'.

Appendix C.1 Training Protocol (Table A1): full SDAR-aligned hyperparameters including lambda=0.01, ratio clip 0.2, learning rate 1e-6, and 150-200 ICSD updates; companion repository URL stated in Abstract.

Limitation evidence: frozen-batch mechanism analyses are small-scale ('four evidence batches (544,427 valid response tokens)' and 'sixteen frozen batches'), and main Tables 1-3 report no variance or significance testing.

Method (Equations 4-6): influence score is the exact first-order Taylor coefficient u_t = A_t*rho_t*Delta_t of the unclipped RL surrogate under a teacher-directed output perturbation - a simple closed-form term rather than a deep methodological advance.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent training methodology: ICSD reallocates token-level distillation mass in agentic RL (GRPO/GiGPO) by a first-order output-coordinate influence score u_t = A_t*rho_t*Delta_t, directly matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, agents/tool-use, RL, and training optimization. Novelty is moderate: the trust-utility mismatch framing is clean and the allocation rule is well-constructed (batch-adaptive asymmetric-Laplace CDF, conservative double-negative fallback, exact per-turn mass matching with proof), but the core score is a simple first-order term and the contribution is an incremental refinement over SDAR-style trust-only allocation in a crowded subarea. Rigor is above average: matched comparisons across three benchmarks, two optimizers, five model configurations, allocation ablations isolating sign vs magnitude vs trust (Table 4), permutation control for gradient compatibility, clipping-exposure and runtime audits, and appendix proofs (Taylor remainder, affine invariance). Weaknesses: main tables lack error bars/significance tests and appear single-seed; some baseline rows are inherited from SDAR publications rather than re-run ('Published baseline rows retain the values reported by SDAR'), so matched-comparison claims for those rows are weaker; frozen-batch mechanism analyses use only 4 and 16 batches. Evidence strength is solid for mechanism claims (95% CIs, e.g., TCM 60.1%->37.8%, CI [22.1,22.6]) but thinner for headline gains, some of which are small (Search-QA 49.1 vs 49.0 at 7B). Generalizability is decent within text-based agent settings (ALFWorld, WebShop, Search-QA) but confined to Qwen-family models and does not demonstrate other domains. Reproducibility is good: companion repository link, full SDAR-aligned hyperparameter table (Table A1), Algorithm A1, and calibration details are provided.

primary_link.title: Trust Is Not Enough: Influence Calibration for On-Policy Self-Distillation in Agentic RL

Existing methods allocate this supervision mainly by teacher trust, but trust does not reveal whether emphasizing a token supports the current policy objective. papers.summary_zh: 同策略自我蒸餾（OPSD）讓語言代理在自身軌跡上獲得來自特權自我教師的稠密詞元級監督，但現有方法主要依教師信任度分配監督，無法回答某個詞元的修正是否有助於當前的 RL 目標，此即「信任—效用錯配」：凍結批次上約六成教師支持權重落在目標反對的詞元。本文提出影響力校準自我蒸餾（ICSD）：對每個受監督詞元計算其重要性加權 RL 代理目標對教師導向輸出擾動的一階響應，作為目標影響力訊號；再以批次自適應的非對稱拉普拉斯 CDF 校準，將漂移且重尾的分數轉為有界分配權重，並搭配保守回退與動作回合內精確質量匹配，確保只重新分配而不增加輔助損失總量，且不需額外模型前向傳遞。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 與 Search-QA 三項基準、GRPO 與 GiGPO 兩種最佳化演算法、五個 1.5B 至 7B 模型上，ICSD 一致優於僅用信任的 SDAR 分配：7B 模型在 ALFWorld 達 96.1% 成功率、WebShop 達 93.1 分。凍結批次分析顯示分配給目標對立詞元的教師支持權重占比從 60.1% 降至 37.8%，與 RL 梯度的餘弦相容性提升 0.192。限制包括依賴特權教師設計、評估限於特定代理基準，且未剪裁區域的近似需謹慎解讀。此工作示範了如何把稠密蒸餾訊號與策略最佳化方向對齊。

links.title: The More Popular, The Harder to Forget: Adaptive Popularity for LLM Unlearning

evidence: Abstract: claims ~5x less forgotten content under paraphrased queries and ~1.6x under adversarial reformulations across three model families and two benchmarks

Sec 3.2, Eq. (4)-(6): per-fact exponent beta_i = a*s_i^{-b} from external popularity proxy reweights per-token ascent signal; Sec 3.3, Eq. (8)-(10): epoch-level dual-ascent controller adjusts retain penalty
Sec 5.2, Table 4: RWKU adversarial-attack forget ROUGE-L AdaPop 0.262/0.144/0.195 vs WGA 0.396/0.211/0.239 (Llama/Qwen/Gemma); DUET paraphrase best on Qwen and Gemma, within seed noise on Llama
Sec 5.3, Table 6: internal metrics show WGA forget Delta-Rank negative (-3,714) vs AdaPop +53,760, cited as surface-suppression signature; retain splits indistinguishable
Sec 5.4, Table 7: NPO, WGA, AdaPop stay within 0.05 MMLU of pre-unlearning checkpoints; GA collapses to 0.23-0.25
Sec 5.5, Figure 3 and Appendix F, Table 10: Wikidata proxy correlates with measured Pile-train counts (Pearson 0.970 log-space); label inversion degrades retain only to 0.92 (Table 11)
Appendix N: 2x2 component ablation showing fixed-alpha loses retain (0.769) without controller and fixed-beta cannot deep-erase popular facts
Limitations section: external proxy unavailable for procedural/creative knowledge, LoRA-only evaluation, coefficients calibrated on DUET distribution
Appendix A and Sec 1 footnote: full hyperparameters (alpha0=0.5, eps=0.1, eta_lambda=0.1, a=58.7, b=0.796, clip [0.05,2.0]) and code released at github.com/Anya-wUw/open-unlearning
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM methodology paper on machine unlearning, squarely within LLM/AI-safety preferences: it unlearns factual knowledge from Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Gemma-7B using LoRA, evaluates safety-relevant robustness to paraphrase and adversarial recovery, and uses LLM-as-Judge. Novelty is moderate: popularity-aware gradient reweighting via an external proxy plus a dual-ascent retain controller is a new combination (prior work characterized the popularity gap but did not propose a training-time fix; dual-ascent constrained optimization exists in PDU), though the three-regime analysis of the exponent beta is a genuine mechanistic contribution. Rigor is strong: closed-form parameter derivation with propositions, 4 main plus 11 additional baselines, learning-rate sweeps, per-epoch dynamics, proxy ablation, coefficient sensitivity, label-noise stress test, and a 2x2 component ablation; weaknesses include single-seed cosine similarity and anchor calibration on the authors' own benchmark. Evidence supports the headline claims from tables (e.g., adversarial ROUGE-L 0.262/0.144/0.195 vs WGA 0.396/0.211/0.239) and internal metrics distinguish parametric disruption from surface suppression, though the primary benchmark (DUET) is from the same group. Generalizability is limited by acknowledged scope: external popularity proxy applies mainly to entity-centric factual QA, LoRA-only training, and DUET-derived calibration; extension to procedural/code knowledge is left to future work. Reproducibility is high with a public code link, fully specified hyperparameters, formalized metric definitions, and a released annotation prompt.

papers.summary_zh: 熱門事實在預訓練中被記得更深，比罕見事實更難移除，但現有 LLM 遺忘學習方法對所有遺忘樣本施加一致的梯度壓力，造成「熱門度落差」：罕見事實被過度抹除而損害保留品質，熱門事實則可透過改寫或對抗性提示復原。本文提出 AdaPop，首個在訓練時利用外部熱門度訊號的方法：將每個事實的熱門度分數（如 Wikidata sitelink 數或 LLM 評判）經冪律映射為每事實指數 β，對詞元級上升訊號加權，使熱門事實維持壓力、罕見事實自我節制；並以雙重上升控制器每個 epoch 依保留損失漂移調整保留懲罰，免除逐資料集的超參數搜尋。在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B 與 Gemma-7B 上，於 DUET 與 RWKU 兩個真實基準評估：AdaPop 在改寫查詢下洩漏約少 5 倍、對抗改寫下約少 1.6 倍；內部指標（ΔRank、隱藏層餘弦）顯示破壞發生在參數表示而非表面壓制，且 MMLU 保留在原模型 0.05 以內。消融證明熱門度指數與控制器互補、缺一不可，代理訊號即使被破壞也僅輕微降低保留品質。限制包括需外部熱門度代理、係數以 DUET 校準、且僅測 LoRA 微調。此研究說明模型自身信心無法反映記憶深度，關閉熱門度落差需要模型外的訊號。

evidence: Abstract: method 'achieves near-lossless accuracy at approximately 5.8x compression, whereas each baseline degrades in at least some settings' on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct across LongBench, RULER, GSM8K, MMLU-Pro, MATH-500.

Section IV, Theorem 1 with Assumptions 1-2: expected attention output distortion decomposes as D = D_K + D_V + R, factoring into token-dependent (a_i^2, ||v_i W_O - o||^2) and channel-dependent (q_c^2, ||W_Oc||_F^2) weights; Remark 2 explicitly concedes cross-token independence is 'an idealization'.

Section VI, Table II: at 5.82x, AATC on Qwen scores LongBench avg 0.567 vs FP16 0.574 while KIVI drops to 0.351 and PALU to 0.483; RULER-32k 0.715 vs KVQuant 0.643 (+7.2); MMLU-m 0.710 vs PALU 0.542 (+16.8).

Section VI-B: 'AATC var-only is statistically indistinguishable from full AATC for Llama' at the 5.82x operating point; attention-awareness benefits appear only at ~7x/2-bit where var-only 'degrades sharply as the context grows' (Fig. 1), and Table II shows AATC var (0.566) slightly above AATC (0.558) on Llama LongBench.

Appendix D, Proposition 1: proves the whitening-based SVD transform coincides with the PCA of XW used by KVTC, so the transform novelty rests on the per-layer granularity and the output-aware allocation criterion.

Appendix A-E, Table VI: ablation at 2-bit on Llama shows global (vs per-layer-channel) allocation costs 8.6 LongBench points (0.568 to 0.483) and removing q_c^2 costs 3.8 points, while removing W_O costs only ~0.8.
Section VII: acknowledged limitations — token-independence assumption, implementation 'lacks a dedicated CUDA implementation', and evaluation covers 'only two model families (Llama and Qwen)'.

Appendix A-A: reproducibility-relevant details given for all methods (KIVI per-channel/per-token with window 128 and group size 32; KVQuant reimplementation with dense-and-sparse decomposition keeping top 1% outliers), and Section VI specifies calibration (wikitext2 for transform; 256 sequences of 2048 tokens from FineWeb sample-10BT + OpenR1-Math-220k), though no code release is stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically solid LLM inference-efficiency paper on KV cache compression that matches several weighted preferences (LLM, Inference & Serving with 'KV cache', Scaling & Efficiency quantization, Long Context & Memory, Transformer attention). The attention-aware distortion decomposition (Theorem 1) is a genuine theoretical contribution with a careful proof, and the reverse-waterfilling bit allocation using q_c^2 and W_Oc weights is new relative to KVTC/PALU/RateQuant, though the transform itself is admitted to coincide with per-layer KVTC/PALU whitening (Appendix D, Prop. 1). Evidence is internally consistent and detailed (5.82x compression, Qwen RULER-32k +7.2 and MMLU-m +16.8 over best baseline), but the headline attention-awareness gain over the var-only ablation is absent on Llama at the main operating point and only materializes at aggressive 2-bit/long-context settings, tempering the central claim. Only two ~7-8B model families are tested, no code release is stated, and the system lacks an optimized CUDA implementation, capping generalizability and reproducibility.

primary_link.title: KV Cache Compression Through the Lens of Transform Coding

papers.summary: The key-value (KV) cache stores information from past tokens and is a major memory bottleneck in long-context inference. Existing quantization methods address this bottleneck by representing the KV cache uniformly with lower-precision data types and designing quantization schemes to minimize reconstruction error in the cache itself, without accounting for how that error propagates through attention mechanisms. We prove that, under a white-noise quantization model, the expected attention-aware di
papers.summary_zh: KV 快取儲存過去詞元的鍵值資訊，是長上下文推論的主要記憶體瓶頸。既有量化方法只最小化快取本身的重構誤差，未考慮誤差如何透過注意力機制傳播。本文在白雜訊量化模型下證明，注意力感知失真可分解為鍵與值兩項加法貢獻並跨詞元與通道分解：鍵項權重包括注意力權重平方、該詞元值投影與輸出的殘差、以及查詢通道平方；值項則由注意力權重平方與輸出投影矩陣的通道範數加權。此分解也統一了詞元驅逐、查詢感知量化、輸出投影感知與逐通道敏感度等既有方法的個別視角。據此提出 AATC（注意力感知變換編碼）：先在校準集上以白化 SVD 得到去相關、按奇異值排序的表示，再以反向注水法在全域位元預算下為各層各通道分配位元，並保留首尾詞元全精度。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 與 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 上，涵蓋 LongBench、RULER、GSM8K、MMLU-Pro 與 MATH-500 的評估顯示，AATC 於約 5.8 倍壓縮下在所有測試格皆與 FP16 統計上不可區分，而 KIVI、KVQuant 與 PALU 至少在一項基準退化；更激進的 2 位元設定下注意力感知分配的優勢更明顯，消融顯示自適應分配是關鍵。限制包括詞元獨立假設、缺乏專屬 CUDA 實作，且僅測兩個模型家族。此工作為 KV 壓縮提供統一的理論與實務框架。
papers.title: KV Cache Compression Through the Lens of Transform Coding
papers.title_zh: 從變換編碼的視角看 KV 快取壓縮

llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-constructed LLM-agent benchmark paper squarely within scope: it evaluates ten self-evolving agent methods (Reflexion, Self-Refine, ACE, ExpeL, ReasoningBank, ToT, CodeEvolve, SEAL, RAGEN, TTT-Discover) across Qwen3 scales and six frontier LLMs on 144 source-to-target physics-adaptation pairs. Novelty is solid but compositional—the adaptation-after-environment-shift setting (Table 1) is new, while the methods, Box2D simulator, and analysis tools are established. Rigor is above average: difficulty calibration against Qwen3-4B, three-pass human audit, denominator auditing for exclusions (Appendix D.3), run-reliability statistics (Table 10), and explicit cost accounting (Appendix D.2). Evidence is decent but partially interpretive: the 'know-how over know-what' claim rests on noisy Change-Exposed results where Vanilla-14B drops 7.2 points under disclosure (Table 6), and only two runs support most conclusions with 86.6% pass agreement. Generalizability is limited by 2D simulation, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is strong: public code/data, documented prompts (Appendix F), hyperparameters, and method adaptation details (Appendix C). Main concerns: two-run protocol on small subsets for headline claims, and Self-Refine's anomalously low scores warrant closer scrutiny.

primary_link.title: PACE-Bench: Benchmarking Physics Adaptation via Code Evolution in Dynamic Environments

papers.summary: Self-evolving agents improve future behavior from interaction experience, yet existing evaluations typically optimize under fixed execution conditions and do not test recovery after those conditions change. To address this gap, we introduce PACE-Bench (Physics Adaptation via Code Evolution), a simulator-grounded benchmark of 144 source-to-target adaptation pairs across six physics domains. Each pair links a source environment to a mutated target environment with the same goal and interface. A co
papers.summary_zh: 自演化代理能從互動經驗改進未來行為，但現有評估多在固定執行條件下測最佳化或泛化，未曾檢驗環境改變後對既有設計的修復能力。PACE-Bench 以 Box2D 模擬器為基礎，建立 144 個跨六大物理領域的源到目標適應配對：每個任務的程式碼化設計在源環境成功，經摩擦、材料強度、重力等系統性突變後在目標環境失效，代理須在 20 次嘗試內依診斷沙盒回饋迭代改寫設計。作者比較四大範式十種自演化方法：上下文式、記憶增強、推論期搜尋與參數式。基準遠未飽和：Reflexion 搭配 Qwen3-14B 在全基準僅 35.9% 通過，GPT-5.5 在完整預算下於靜力學子集亦僅 66.7%。主要發現包括：以模擬器證據為基礎的反思比未驗證的自我修訂可靠；記憶方法易錨定於早期設計造成設計固化；廣度樹搜尋探索而不收斂；參數式方法整體弱於 Vanilla。關鍵的是，即使揭露確切的物理參數變化也未提升效能上限，顯示機制再設計（know how）而非參數推斷（know what）才是真正瓶頸。限制在於僅涵蓋 2D 模擬、固定 20 次嘗試預算，且前沿模型與視覺回饋實驗僅涵蓋部分子集。此基準為診斷與改進環境變遷下的自演化代理提供可重現的測試場。
papers.title: PACE-Bench: Benchmarking Physics Adaptation via Code Evolution in Dynamic Environments
papers.title_zh: PACE-Bench：動態環境中透過程式碼演進測試物理適應

links.title: Wrong but Useful: Trajectory Value Beyond Answer Correctness in Multi-Agent Messages

evidence: Abstract: 'Across five mathematics and science benchmarks and two openly available model families—gpt-oss-120b (OSS) and gemma-4-31B-it (Gemma)—wrong-helpful messages appear in every benchmark–model combination.'
Results (Correctness Does Not Determine Trajectory Value): 'when a wrong-answer message does flip correctness, 41.9% of OSS events and 45.3% of Gemma events are helpful'
Results (Controlled repeated replay): 'No null dataset matches the observed aggregate effect count, giving the add-one permutation result p=(0+1)/(5,000+1)=0.0002'
Results: 'a global Benjamini–Hochberg screen ... keeps 11 Gemma wrong-helpful problems spanning all five benchmarks and none for OSS'
Related Work (Replay attribution and positioning): 'Removal replay itself is not our novelty. We pair each message's replay effect with the correctness of its own answer.'
Appendix G Table 22: integrator-family swap yields 'Pearson r=0.095' and only 10 of 20 nonzero messages retain direction, showing trajectory value is not integrator-invariant
Appendix H Table 23: wrong-helpful anchors (n=10) show 82% success with full message vs. 44% with reasoning hidden and 64% with answer hidden; paper labels this 'not a prevalence estimate'
Experimental Setup: 'The headline LOO analysis contains 91,740 eligible OSS and 83,020 eligible Gemma messages'

Appendix K (Reproducibility materials): 'anc/reproducibility_artifact.zip contains the exact prompt and protocol configurations, analysis scripts, sanitized derived records, figure inputs, and checksums'; 'The hosted endpoints did not expose weight-revision hashes'
Limitations: 'the fifth-block analysis measures same-problem opportunity rather than unseen-problem generalization'
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM multi-agent reasoning paper measuring message-level 'trajectory value' vs. answer correctness via a leave-one-out replay protocol (DHD) on five math/science benchmarks with gpt-oss-120b and gemma-4-31B-it. Methodologically careful: permutation tests over label exchanges (p=0.0002), problem-cluster bootstrap, BH/BY corrections, evaluator robustness audits, and honest reporting that multiplicity-controlled wrong-helpful cases survive only for Gemma (Appendix G, Table 20) and that conservative BY retains none. Headline result (41.9% OSS / 45.3% Gemma helpful share among wrong-answer flips) is well supported. Weaknesses: novelty is incremental—the paper concedes removal replay is not new (Related Work) and concurrent removal-attribution work exists; the component-masking mechanism evidence is a small 22-message diagnostic (Appendix H); trajectory value is context-specific with weak cross-integrator stability (r=0.095, Appendix G Table 22), and demonstrated utility is same-problem only, not a deployable selector. Strong reproducibility artifact and settings, but no weight-revision hashes for hosted endpoints and compound six-cell labels are evaluator-sensitive (71.6–78.6% OSS tuple agreement, Appendix K Table 28).

primary_link.title: Wrong but Useful: Trajectory Value Beyond Answer Correctness in Multi-Agent Messages

papers.summary: Multi-agent reasoning systems often use agreement, confidence, or automated scores to decide which messages should shape a final answer. Such filtering assumes that a message likely to be correct is also worth keeping. Yet a wrong answer can contain a useful decomposition, constraint, or scientific principle. We test this distinction with Diverse Hypothesis Deliberation (DHD), a controlled measurement protocol that caches five independently generated messages and replays the same downstream solv
papers.summary_zh: 多代理推理系統常以一致性、信心或自動評分決定哪些訊息可傳遞，隱含「可能正確的訊息才值得保留」的假設；然而錯誤答案可能包含有用的分解、約束或科學原理。本文提出多元假說商議（DHD）測量協議：招募者為每題指派五個互補角色，五位代理各自獨立產出結構化訊息並快取；再以同一下游整合器分別在該訊息可見與隱藏兩條件下重跑，透過留一重播比較衡量訊息的軌跡價值。在 Omni-MATH-2、JEEBench、SciBench、LAB-Bench、MaScQA 五個數理與科學基準，以及 gpt-oss-120b 與 gemma-4-31B-it 兩個模型家族上，每種基準—模型組合都出現「錯但有用」的訊息：在改變最終正確性的錯答案訊息中，超過四成的改變是有幫助的。控制性重複重播顯示這些效應超出重播隨機變異（p=0.0002）；對可重複錯但有用訊息的組成遮罩實驗顯示，隱藏其錯誤答案比隱藏推理保留更多成功率，且完整訊息效果最佳。同題內的重複軌跡價值證據也比僅用答案正確性更能找出更好的保留或移除選擇。限制包括軌跡價值是情境特定、單一模型家族擔任所有角色、且未涵蓋互動辯論與開放式任務。此研究證明答案正確性有參考價值，但無法決定訊息的軌跡價值。
papers.title: Wrong but Useful: Trajectory Value Beyond Answer Correctness in Multi-Agent Messages
papers.title_zh: 錯但有用：多代理訊息中超越答案正確性的軌跡價值

links.title: ScienceFlow: A long-horizon agent for ML research, scientific discovery and beyond

evidence: Abstract/§3.1.2: ScienceFlow achieves 70.22±1.18% Any-Medal on the full 75-task MLE-bench under a 24-hour budget, 4.92 pp above the strongest reported baseline.
§3.1.3 Mechanism ablation: on MLE-bench Lite, full system 80.30±2.62% vs 66.67±2.62% without ESTRA and 69.70±5.25% without execution control over three seeds.
§3.1.3 State-matched re-anchoring study: 84 replay branches across 7 historical ESTRA decision points; historical policy has zero median regret and 1.725e-3 mean AUROC regret.

Table 1/Table A3 footnotes: baselines use different LLMs (e.g., Gemini-3-Pro-Preview, Claude-Opus-4.6) and some use 12h or 36h budgets, so the headline SOTA comparison confounds framework and backbone.

§4.2 'Closest mechanisms and distinction': authors state ScienceFlow does not claim memory, checkpointing, trajectory revision, or resource scheduling are individually new; distinction is the unified recoverable-executable-state abstraction.
§3.3.1: 'We run each system–task pair once' on SciModelingBench, so no variance is reported for the group-balanced 54.41 result.
§3.1.4 Backbone sensitivity: four backbones compared on a single task with three runs; authors state comparisons are 'descriptive rather than statistically conclusive'.
Appendix C.2: exact-decimal feasibility audit for circle packing (δ=9.26×10⁻¹⁵ repair) and exact reconstruction of the AlphaEvolve Hermite verifier; improves uncertainty bound by 2.5%.
§3.2.2/Table 4: KTTSP-hard rank 3rd on public leaderboard (393.229 vs winner 337.646); comparison acknowledged as not compute-normalized.
Appendix B.2: mechanism telemetry available for only 54 of 75 tasks, reflecting retrospective record availability.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper (long-horizon autonomous research agents with tool use, code workspaces, and structured memory), squarely matching high-weight preferences for agents, LLMs, reasoning, code, and long-context memory. Technical content is credible: recoverable executable states, ESTRA re-anchoring, evidence-aware execution control, with 3-run SEM results, mechanism ablations, a state-matched counterfactual replay study, and unusually careful feasibility audits. Main deductions: the SOTA MLE-bench margin (+4.92 pp) is confounded because baselines use different backbones (Gemini-3-Pro-Preview, Claude-Opus-4.6) and non-uniform budgets (12h/36h footnotes), so framework vs. model contribution is not isolated; SciModelingBench is single-run per system-task; backbone sensitivity is 3 runs on one task and self-described as descriptive; mechanism telemetry covers only 54/75 tasks and is retrospective. The authors honestly concede individual mechanisms are not new, so novelty rests on the integrated abstraction. No explicit code/artifact release is verified; only a project page and extensive protocol detail are provided.

primary_link.title: ScienceFlow: A long-horizon agent for ML research, scientific discovery and beyond

papers.summary: Enabling LLM agents to sustain productive, stable, and goal-aligned research over extended horizons is a central challenge for autonomous machine learning and scientific discovery, as progress hinges on continuously managing evolving state, exploration decisions, and computational resources. Pioneering autoresearch agents, despite great success, still lack mechanisms for continuity, recovery from dead ends, and value-driven compute allocation, which inherently undermines overall search efficienc
papers.summary_zh: 讓 LLM 代理在長時程中維持穩定、目標對齊且高效的研究流程，是自主機器學習與科學發現的核心挑戰；既有先驅系統缺乏連續性、從死路恢復與價值驅動的運算配置機制。ScienceFlow 將研究工作組織為基於可執行工作空間的研究段，並把研究進度表示為可恢復的執行狀態（工作空間快照、結構化記憶、驗證證據與資源紀錄）。研究段之間的轉換由可執行狀態重錨轉移（ESTRA）治理：在純文字回應或接近上下文上限時，工作者選擇延續當前狀態或還原封存檢查點，並決定延續或轉向新方向。證據感知執行控制器則依資源可用性、剩餘預算與已驗證進度決定實體任務的准許、監控、暫停或終止，科學決策仍由研究工作者掌握。在涵蓋機器學習、科學建模與數學最佳化的任務上，ScienceFlow 以 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Preview 在完整 75 任務 MLE-bench 於 24 小時預算內達成 70.22% 的 Any-Medal 率，較先前最佳報導高 4.92 個百分點；在 SciModelingBench 取得最佳群組平衡分數 54.41，並在圓形填充、比值最小化與傅立葉符號不確定性上界等問題達到或超越公開前沿，KTTSP-hard 排名第三。消融顯示 ESTRA 與執行控制皆顯著貢獻，案例研究亦展示檢查點重用與跨工作者證據共享。限制包括各系統運算預算不一致使比較偏描述性、最佳化比較未完全正規化，且機制遙測僅涵蓋部分任務。此框架展示狀態管理、自適應探索與目標對齊執行對擴展自主研究的關鍵性。
papers.title: ScienceFlow: A long-horizon agent for ML research, scientific discovery and beyond
papers.title_zh: ScienceFlow：面向機器學習研究、科學發現與更廣領域的長時程代理

links.title: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: 7B trained-from-scratch model achieves similar downstream score as 7B Transformer baseline with 62.6% of baseline's training data; continual-pretrained 35B claims 'nearly 4x end-to-end inference speedup'.

Section 3.1: 'Mobius attains the same score with only 0.626x data — that is, Mobius exhibits 1.6x data efficiency of Transformer'; immediately concedes 'The mechanism ... remains to be fully explored.'

Table 1 (Section 3.2): Intern-S2-Mobius-35B vs Qwen3.5-35B AVG 67.88 vs 65.05 with losses on UGD hard (73.02 vs 78.02) and HLE (19.11 vs 22.40); scientific tasks AVG 52.14 vs 18.20 with Biology-Instructions 51.40 vs 3.77, unexplained.

Section 3: CPT pipeline 'continued pre-training on 1TB tokens, and subsequently performed supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL)' — no statement that the Qwen3.5-35B baseline received identical post-training.
Figures 2-4 carry the data-efficiency, throughput, and output-length evidence; the text provides no numeric throughput tables, hardware, batch, or serving-stack details.

Table 2 (Section 3.2) and Appendix D: token-length comparison based on single case studies (516 vs 2,364 tokens; 472 vs 1,649 tokens), described by authors as 'comparing multiple cases' without aggregate statistics.
Appendix C: compositional generalization result is from 'our yet-to-be-released, newer Mobius architecture (unreleased)' — not verifiable from the artifact.

Model availability note (front page): 'Model is available at https://huggingface.co/internlm/Intern-S2-Mobius'; no code, architecture equations, or hyperparameter/training recipe details appear in the document.
Sections 5.1-5.4: claims about self-evolution, world models, scientific discovery, and hardware-software co-design are explicitly unvalidated ('remains to be validated in future work').
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-relevant LLM architecture paper: decoupling knowledge (shared FFN memory) from reasoning operators (attention 'Reasoners'), with latent reasoning and shorter CoT — directly hits LLM, reasoning/CoT, transformer-architecture, and inference-efficiency preferences. The decoupled shared-memory design is a genuinely interesting architectural contribution, though it synthesizes known ideas (looped transformers, COCONUT-style latent reasoning, MoE-style partitioning, memory networks). Rigor is mixed: there is a controlled 7B TFS comparison and a same-checkpoint CPT comparison across 12 benchmarks, but the CPT arm's post-training (SFT+RL) parity with the Qwen3.5 baseline is not stated, results are mixed on general tasks (Table 1 avg 67.88 vs 65.05, with losses on UGD hard and HLE), huge scientific-task gaps (52.14 vs 18.20) lack data-mixture explanation, and no component ablations (backward residual vs dynamic latent reasoning vs memory size) or seeds/significance are reported. Key efficiency claims (~4x speedup, 1.6x data efficiency) rest on figures without numeric tables, hardware, or measurement protocol; the shorter-CoT evidence is largely single case studies (Tables 2, Appendix D), and Appendix C's compositional-generalization result uses an explicitly unreleased future model. Speculative sections (self-evolution, world models, scientific discovery, hardware co-design) are position statements without experiments. Weights released on HuggingFace aid reproduction, but no code, equations, or training recipes are provided. Calibrated weighted score ~0.66: high preference fit and moderate novelty, held back by thin verifiable evidence and incomplete methodological specification.

primary_link.title: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning

papers.summary: We introduce Mobius-v0, an architecture that comprises a globally shared Memory (FFN) that stores knowledge vectors and multiple Reasoners (Self-Attn) that iteratively achieve compositional reasoning. Using hidden states as cache and carrier, reasoners repeatedly query memory for required knowledge-vectors, while the knowledge is transmitted back to reasoning operators. Through this knowledge-reasoning-separation architecture, Mobius achieves better knowledge compression and reasoning efficiency
papers.summary_zh: 論文指出 Transformer 架構中知識儲存（FFN）與推理算子（Self-Attention）逐層緊密綁定，模型常需生成冗長思維鏈，推論效率受限。作者提出 Mobius-v0 架構：以全域共用的 Memory（FFN）儲存知識向量，多個 Reasoner（Self-Attention）反覆查詢記憶體完成組合推理，實現「後向殘差連結」與「動態潛在推理」，讓深層可取用淺層知識，並在極少層內迭代精煉潛在表示後一次解碼多個 token。實驗顯示：從頭訓練的 7B 模型僅用 Transformer 基線 62.6% 的訓練資料即達到相近 MMLU 分數（約 1.6 倍資料效率）；以 Qwen3.5-35B 持續預訓練的 Intern-S2-Mobius 在多項一般與科學基準上保持或提升效能，並達到近 4 倍端對端推論加速，主要來自更短的思維鏈，個案分析顯示其省去重複推導與檢查。作者並論證架構在自我演化、世界模型與科學發現上的潛力。限制包括：知識與推理分離後的專家路由仍受原始檢查點層級結構影響、共用知識庫增加記憶體存取壓力、縮短思維鏈的機制尚未完全釐清，各項潛力仍待實證。此研究顯示提高架構複雜度可同時拉高智慧上限並降低端對端成本。
papers.title: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
papers.title_zh: Intern-S2-Mobius：知識與推理解耦的基礎模型

links.title: Twin: Playing an Unknown Game with a Test-Time Digital Twin

evidence: Abstract: 'Twin clears 179 out of 183 levels (97.8%)' and 'Played directly, the base model scores only 7.8%; an off-the-shelf harness increases it to 61.1%, whereas our twin world model increases the same base model to 93.3%, clearing 23 out of 25 games.'

Experimental Results, Table 1: Twin 93.3 / 23 won / 179 levels vs OPINE-World 78.4, Prime Agent 78.3, EWM 63.8, Codex 61.1; text notes 'OPINE-World runs Claude Opus 4.8 and EWM runs GPT-5.5... so the Codex ablation and Prime Agent's Sol configuration are the only entries sharing Twin's base model.'

'The harness earns the score: an ablation': 'Disabling the Twin harness reduces the mean score from 93.3 to 61.1 and the number of fully cleared games from 23 to 13,' keeping 'the identical agent, base model, file bridge, and sandbox.'

Related Work: 'WorldCoder introduced the core pattern of using an LLM to synthesize an executable transition and reward model from interaction, plan through it, and repair it from counterexamples'; 'The other three systems converge on one control loop' — bounding novelty to the enforced-validation and pre-reward goal distinctions.

Appendix A: 'The final twins predict the complete next frame exactly for 70.1% of previously unobserved pairs' with per-game range '9.9% on wa30 to 98.8% on tu93,' showing replay validation does not guarantee generalization.
Appendix J: goal claims graded at 'recall 138/179 = 0.771, precision 138/646 = 0.214' — a self-reported weakness of the goal-inference half.

Limitations: 'Replay validation assumes deterministic dynamics representable by the twin'; 'continuous observations would make every replay an approximate comparison'; 'Truly latent state... stays out of scope.'

Appendix I, Table 10: fixed evaluation config (search budgets, effort, workstation) but 'gpt-5.6-sol is accessed through a hosted service without an exposed random seed, so its exact token sequences are not reproducible'; code at github.com/Alexyskoutnev/TWIN-ARC-AGI-3 and public run replays are provided.
llm_evaluation.rationale: High personal relevance: an LLM coding agent (GPT-5.6 Sol via Codex) synthesizes executable Python world models at test time, combining agentic harness design, code generation/repair, planning, and test-time compute — all heavily weighted preferences. Research quality is strong but incremental: the executable-world-model-from-interaction recipe is explicitly credited to WorldCoder, and the Related Work section concedes three concurrent systems 'converge on one control loop'; the genuine deltas are harness-enforced replay validation as a hard precondition and pre-reward goal hypothesis testing. Rigor is mixed: a clean same-base-model ablation (93.3 vs 61.1) isolates the harness contribution, but head-to-head comparisons (OPINE-World on Claude Opus 4.8, EWM on GPT-5.5) are base-model-confounded, Schema self-reports 98.98 above Twin's 93.3, and there is one run per game with no variance reporting. Evidence is unusually deep and self-critical (Appendix J reports goal-predicate precision of only 0.214; Appendix A shows wa30 at 9.9% unseen-pair accuracy), but quantitative cross-system claims rest on heterogeneous configurations. Generalizability is bounded by stated assumptions of deterministic, program-compressible, discrete grid dynamics with exact replay. Reproducibility benefits from released code, run replays, and a fixed configuration table, but the hosted base model exposes no seed so exact runs are not reproducible.

primary_link.title: Twin: Playing an Unknown Game with a Test-Time Digital Twin

papers.summary: We present a Test-time World-model Inference (Twin) system, in which a frontier coding agent writes an executable world model for completing continual learning tasks, such as ARC-AGI-3 games. Traditional approaches hand-engineer such models, one custom design per task. Each game hides its rules and goal, and our system constructs them from simulation and interaction alone. Its inductive prior over grid games is strong enough to recover the true transitions of the game and the goal on nearly all
papers.summary_zh: ARC-AGI-3 是規則與勝利條件皆隱藏的 64×64 網格遊戲基準，人類可全破而前沿模型直接遊玩僅得 7.8 分。本文提出 Twin：由編碼代理在測試時以 Python 撰寫可執行的「數位孿生」世界模型，並由 harness 強制：提出任何計分行動前，世界模型必須重播並吻合所有已觀察轉移；驗證—探索—規劃循環反覆修復模型，規劃只在已驗證孿生內以 BFS 搜尋路徑，執行時逐步比對預測，任何不符即成為修復用反例。因目標從未明示，系統先在孿生內提出候選目標假說，於獎勵出現前以最省行動的路徑測試並確認或否決。以 GPT-5.6 Sol 為基礎模型，Twin 清空 25 款遊戲中的 23 款、183 關中的 179 關（97.8%），得分 93.3，且在完成的 179 關中有 158 關行動數少於人類首次遊玩（平均 0.61 倍）；首個目標假說在 87.2% 的完成關卡即正確。消融實驗移除整套 harness 後分數降至 61.1，顯示貢獻主要來自方法本身。限制包括僅適用於近似確定性、可程式壓縮的動態，隱藏狀態與概率性動態超出範圍，且每次計分行動約耗 22.4 萬 tokens。研究證明測試時建構並驗證世界模型可達人類級行動效率，而推斷「何謂獲勝」才是更難的一半。
papers.title: Twin: Playing an Unknown Game with a Test-Time Digital Twin
papers.title_zh: Twin：以測試時數位孿生遊玩未知遊戲

links.title: Workspace Topology as an Attack Vector in Agentic Coding Assistants

evidence: Abstract: study of IPI across 'open-source repositories spanning 10 languages and 6 domains', finding 'highly modular environments demonstrating significantly lower attack success rates'.
§4.5: defines ASR = R·C decomposition into reachability and compliance; EP1 reachability R≡1 by construction since opencode auto-loads AGENTS.md.
Table 2: modularity buckets with Wilson 95% CIs — Low ASR 44.0% [39.0, 49.0] vs High 26.5% [22.6, 30.8], intervals fully separated by 8.2pp.
§5.2/Figure 4: defensive AGENTS.md cuts ASR from 25.7% to 10.2% (≈60% suppression, n=1000 per cell); rename cue Δ=−3.0pp not significant.
§5.4/Figure 6: position ablation — plain envelope compliance decays 8%→4%→2% with position while mimicry envelope inverts to 20% at end-of-file.
§6.3 Limitations: 'scoped to a single model (gpt-oss-120b) served through a single harness (opencode 1.14.46) with one payload action'; cross-model replication left to future work.
Appendix D: modularity scorer inter-rater reliability between Claude Sonnet 4.6 and gpt-oss-120b, Spearman ρ=0.80, n=100, MAE 1.28 with systematic +1.3 bias.
Appendix A/Table 3: full inference stack documented (model, 128k context, harmony template, opencode 1.14.46, invocation command); no code/data artifact release is mentioned anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an empirical security study of indirect prompt injection in agentic coding assistants (agents/tool use, AI safety, red teaming, code agents), not a pure domain application. Novelty is solid but incremental: IPI (Greshake 2023) and ChatInject format-mimicry (Chang 2025) are existing techniques; the contribution is the first systematic topology ablation (modularity, depth, in-file position, framing), an R·C decomposition, and clean-room testing recommendations. Rigor and evidence are above average: 100-repo dataset across 10 languages/6 domains, n=1261 sessions for the main analysis, Wilson 95% CIs with fully separated low/high modularity buckets (44.0% vs 26.5%, 8.2pp gap), deterministic attack verification via stdout markers, and scorer inter-rater reliability (Spearman ρ=0.80, Appendix D). Generalizability is explicitly limited: single model (gpt-oss-120b), single harness (opencode 1.14.46), one payload action, with several ablations on a 10-repo stratified subset. Reproducibility is aided by detailed stack/rubric/payload documentation (Appendices A, C, F) but no code or data release is stated, and the primary modularity scorer is a proprietary model.

primary_link.title: Workspace Topology as an Attack Vector in Agentic Coding Assistants

papers.summary: Agentic coding assistants are finding widespread use, not just in new code development but in quickly ingesting and leveraging third-party code. This opens up a risk of malicious code being ingested as these coding tools operate with broad filesystem access inside developer workspaces. In this paper, we extensively study the impact of different dimensions of a novel attack surface we term workspace topology -- defined via directory depth, codebase modularity, in-file injection position and conte
papers.summary_zh: 代理式編碼助理（如 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode）在獲信任的專案資料夾內擁有廣泛檔案系統存取權，攻擊者可於儲存庫檔案植入間接提示注入（IPI）承載。本文系統研究「工作區拓撲」——目錄深度、程式碼庫模組化、檔案內注入位置與情境框架——對攻擊成功率（ASR）的影響。作者建立涵蓋 10 種語言、6 個工程領域的 100 個開源儲存庫，以 gpt-oss-120b 搭配 Opencode harness，針對 AGENTS.md（EP1）、README.md（EP2）與原始碼（EP3）三個注入入口實測，並將 ASR 分解為可達性 R 與服從度 C。結果顯示：模組化與 ASR 負相關（低模組化約 44%，高模組化約 26.5%），效應主要來自服從度；防禦性 AGENTS.md 可將 ASR 由 25.7% 降至 10.2%（約 60% 抑制），但資料夾改名等命名提示無顯著效果；深度 2 的 ASR 最高，深度 4 遽降；ChatInject 格式擬態使檔尾服從度反轉升至 20%。限制為僅評測單一模型與 harness、單一承載，跨模型重現待驗證。研究強調乾淨測試環境的重要，並建議紅隊評測跨拓撲取樣、同時報告 framed 與 unframed 條件、分別呈報 R 與 C，並推動模組化程式碼衛生與工作區設定檔驗證等防禦。
papers.title: Workspace Topology as an Attack Vector in Agentic Coding Assistants
papers.title_zh: 工作區拓撲作為代理式編碼助理的攻擊向量

links.title: TimeSage-EV: A Live Benchmark for Agentic Time Series Analysis in Evolving Environments

evidence: Abstract: 'tracks 60 real institutional scenarios across 6 domains, comprising 1,485 scenario-period QA pairs from Feb 2023 to May 2026'

Section 4.2 Baseline Models: six LLMs (Sonnet-4.6, GPT-5.4, Kimi-K2.6, Qwen-3.5-397B, Devstral-2-123B, Gemma-4-31B) run in smolagent with memory, search, and code execution; temperature=0, 32,768-token budget, 20 steps/2,700s limits
Section 4.3: 'GPT-5.4 achieves the strongest score (86.0)' and 'On hard tasks, the best model reaches only 72.7'; token cost varies 'from 84M for GPT-5.4 to 364M for Sonnet-4.6'
Section 4.5: reusable skills 'reduce token cost to 0.82x' with gains concentrated in medium/hard scenarios, but 'skill induction and reuse are concentrated in the early periods and do not persist'
Section 4.5/Figure 9: sequential memory helps Qwen-3.5-397B but its advantage 'narrows and reverses in later periods' for Gemma-4-31B
Appendix A.7.2 Table 13: human-LLM judge agreement coverage kappa=0.882, faithfulness kappa=0.917, quality kappa=0.665
Section 3.2.2/A.3.2 Step 5-6: questions and ground truth generated using LLM (Claude Opus 4.6) within a fixed contract, mitigated by grounding audit and human review (Section 3.2.3)
Limitations: failure modes 'may be partially entangled with this specific harness' and corpus 'relies predominantly on English-language reports'
Appendix A.5 and Conclusion: full prompt templates released and 'frozen, versioned snapshot... capped at May 2026' promised for reproducibility
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark paper squarely within Agents & Tool Use, LLM evaluation, and long-context/memory preferences: it evaluates six frontier LLM agents in a smolagent harness with code execution, audited cutoff-valid web search, memory compaction, and a self-evolving skill library (TimeSage-1.0) on recurring time-series analysis. Time-series is a domain substrate, but the methodology (live evolving environments, temporal cutoff isolation, multi-axis LLM-as-judge scoring, skill induction) is core language/agent research, so it is not capped as a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate-to-good: live/evolving/cutoff evaluation for agentic time-series analysis fills a genuine gap per Table 1, though each ingredient (live benchmarks, skill libraries, agent harnesses, time-series QA) exists separately and TimeSage-1.0 echoes prior skill-library work. Rigor is solid: three-stage construction with eight grounding-audit gates and three human reviewers, bootstrap CIs, tier and per-question-type breakdowns, memory and skill ablations, and a judge-verification study; however, LLM-generated questions/ground truth (Claude Opus 4.6), a single judge model (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) with only modest quality-axis agreement (kappa 0.665), and harness-specific failure modes (acknowledged in Limitations) temper this. Evidence is mostly strong and quantified (e.g., GPT-5.4 86.0 overall vs 53.1 for Gemma-4-31B on hard tier; 0.82x token cost with skills), though claims like 'reasoning efficiency drives performance' are correlational from token counts and the memory analysis covers only two models. Generalizability is reasonable across six domains and cadences but limited by English-only institutional sources and one harness. Reproducibility is strong: code, dataset, leaderboard, full prompt templates, hyperparameters, and a promised frozen May-2026 snapshot.

primary_link.title: TimeSage-EV: A Live Benchmark for Agentic Time Series Analysis in Evolving Environments

papers.summary: Time series analysis in high-stakes domains relies on recurring data releases, where new observations can alter the evidence base and the validity of later conclusions. Existing time series QA benchmarks mostly rely on fixed snapshots, leaving temporal validity and cutoff-aware evidence use unevaluated. We introduce TimeSage-EV, a live benchmark for agentic time series analysis in evolving environments. It tracks 60 real institutional scenarios across 6 domains, comprising 1,485 scenario-period
papers.summary_zh: 現有時間序列問答基準多為靜態快照，無法評估代理在資料持續更新時能否維持時間有效性並遵循資訊截止線。TimeSage-EV 是一個 live（持續更新）基準，追蹤農業、氣候、能源、金融、醫療、運輸六領域共 60 個真實機構發布情境，自 2023 年 2 月至 2026 年 5 月計 1,485 個情境-期間問答對，涵蓋月、週、日與不定期發布節奏。每個期間代理僅能存取截止前的累積時間序列與先前文件，目標期發布被隱藏作為 ground truth；任務分 easy/medium/hard 三級，問題涵蓋狀態識別、變化偵測、組成分析、事件偵測、歸因與展望六大類。評測沿關鍵點準確率、覆蓋率、報告忠實度與報告品質四軸進行。實驗顯示 GPT-5.4 總分最高（86.0）且 token 成本最低；easy 任務近飽和，但歸因與預測題最佳僅約 46 與 43 分；live 排行榜顯示弱模型隨上下文累積而衰退，記憶管理成為瓶頸；自演化代理 TimeSage-1.0 的可重用技能庫在困難情境帶來增益並將 token 成本降至 0.82 倍，但技能歸納難以持續整個時程。限制包括依賴 smolagent 框架、LLM 評審雜訊與英文機構報告偏差。此基準填補演化式、截止感知代理評測的空白，具診斷價值。
papers.title: TimeSage-EV: A Live Benchmark for Agentic Time Series Analysis in Evolving Environments
