links.title: MazeRunner: Nonlinear Task and Clue Orchestration for LLM-driven Black-Box Automated Penetration Testing

evidence: Abstract: 'With Claude Sonnet 4.5, MazeRunner completes 47.7% of the annotated subtasks, compared with 36.2% for PentestGPT-V2 and 34.2% for Claude Code'
Section 5.1.2: 'impose a maximum budget of 20 million tokens on each system–target run' and manual inspection of traces for target-specific write-up leakage

Section 5.5 (Ablation): 'The completion rate plunges from 73.5% to 51.5%, while token consumption surges by over 80% (to 79.5M)' when removing the Reviewer; ablation run only on 'a subset of 5 targets, where the framework successfully secured at least a user shell utilizing GPT-5.2'
Section 2.3 (Motivating Example): 'we employed manual intervention for this specific task' for password brute-forcing; notes these runs 'are excluded from the formal evaluation'
Section 5.3: failure analysis covers '56 target-level runs that do not obtain root access across the three frameworks, two shared backbone models, and 10 targets', indicating one run per combination
Appendix A.1 Table 4: all 10 HTB targets released Feb-Apr 2026 across Linux/Windows and easy/medium/hard difficulties with per-target subtask counts
No statement of code or artifact availability appears anywhere in the paper; implementation depends on Kimi Code CLI and a MySQL-backed cache (Section 4)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly aligned with LLM-agent preferences: a Strategist-Executor-Reviewer multi-agent framework with a persistent Task & Clue Cache for long-horizon orchestration, evaluated with frontier LLM backbones (Sonnet 4.5, DeepSeek-V3.2, GPT-5.2). Though set in pentesting, the contribution is agent architecture (planning, memory, failure diagnosis, backtracking), not a pure domain application. Novelty is incremental: planner-executor-reviewer loops and external state stores are established patterns; the clue-graph producer/consumer mapping and branch-switching are refinements over PentestGPT-V2/Trinity/Cochise. Rigor is mixed: thoughtful contamination controls (targets postdating training cutoffs, leakage inspection per §5.1.2), token budgets, and an ablation (§5.5) are positives, but single runs per system-target combination despite acknowledged stochasticity, author-annotated ground truth, and an ablation subset selected only from targets where the framework already succeeded weaken the design. Evidence is internally consistent (Table 2, Table 5) but many efficiency claims rest on figures without reported numbers, and key motivating runs used manual password-cracking intervention (§2.3, excluded from formal eval). Generalizability is limited to HTB targets, and no code or artifact release is stated, with proprietary models and paid targets further hindering reproduction.

primary_link.title: MazeRunner: Nonlinear Task and Clue Orchestration for LLM-driven Black-Box Automated Penetration Testing

papers.summary: Penetration testing is essential yet resource-intensive. Although large language models (LLMs) show promise for automating security auditing, existing agents mainly execute end-to-end workflows in simplified linear scenarios. Real-world black-box testing is fundamentally nonlinear: the attack graph is initially unknown and must be incrementally inferred from environmental feedback. Observations may reveal multiple attack branches, failures are often ambiguous, and critical clues may span long ac
papers.summary_zh: 真實黑盒滲透測試中攻擊圖未知、失敗語意模糊、關鍵線索常相隔數十步，現有 LLM 代理易陷入「深度優先陷阱」、上下文失憶與錯誤歸因。MazeRunner 採 Strategist-Executor-Reviewer 三代理協作，配合持久化 Task & Clue Cache（任務圖與線索圖）維護任務依賴、執行狀態與跨階段證據；Reviewer 獨立診斷失敗根因，支援局部修正、補足前置條件與分支切換，緩解重複嘗試與幻覺任務。作者在 10 台 2026 年 2 至 4 月發布的 Hack The Box 機器上評測，統一每組合 2,000 萬 tokens 預算，並禁止存取目標專屬 write-up 以避免資料污染。以 Claude Sonnet 4.5 而言，MazeRunner 子任務完成率 47.7%，高於 PentestGPT-V2 的 36.2% 與 Claude Code 的 34.2%；取得 6 台 user 權限（含 2 台 root），基線皆僅 2 台 user、0 台 root。失敗分析顯示其規劃錯誤與線索遺忘率較低，但程式碼／承載失敗占比較高。消融顯示移除 Reviewer 使完成率由 73.5% 滑落至 51.5% 且 token 消耗暴增逾 80%。限制包括無法處理 GUI 互動、依賴已知漏洞與公開 exploit，以及 LLM 對罕見攻擊路徑的統計偏誤。此工作凸顯任務與線索編排對非線性長期安全任務的關鍵性。

links.title: Scaling Domain Data Repetition in LLM Pretraining

evidence: Page 2, Introduction: 'when the training-token budget grows with model size using a fixed TPP, the optimal repetition count surprisingly increases with model size' - contradicts fixed-data-size prior findings ([4,27,37]).

Page 6, Section 4.1/Figure 4: estimated optimal repetition count has Pearson correlations of -0.944 with minimum validation loss, 0.400 with model size, and 0.018 with unique-data fraction, via quadratic fits to loss-vs-repetition curves.
Page 7-8, Section 4.2: Theorems 4.2-4.4 formalize noise decay, fixed-D model-size crossover, and r*(D,N)=Theta(D^(alpha/beta)) under D/N -> C0; proofs deferred to Appendix D (pages 17-19).

Page 4, Section 3: grid defined as alpha in {1/40, 1/20, 1/10}, e in {1,...,7}, D_N = TPP*N, but TPP only 'set to a constant greater than 100' and model sizes N = {N_1,...,N_K} never given numerically.
Page 9-10, Section 5.2: fixed-domain-fraction design isolates repetition from web-data changes; OOD validation loss on ArXiv and News 'remains largely stable' across 1/2/4 repetitions.
Page 11, Figure 7 / Section 5.3: learning-rate schedule shifts the degradation onset - earlier WSD decay tolerates fewer repetitions, constant LR tolerates the most.

Page 15, Appendix A.2: LR and batch size follow power laws in model size per DeepSeek LLM [1], 200-step warmup, Muon optimizer, attention dropout 0.1; no code or data release is stated anywhere in the paper.
Page 11, Section 6: acknowledged limitations - 'Our current setup repeats only one high-quality dataset in each training run' and no quantitative scaling rule for transferring repetition counts yet.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM pretraining methodology paper, squarely in scope (LLMs, training/optimization, scaling laws, data mixtures). Main novelty is the regime correction: prior cross-scale repetition studies fixed data size, but under the practical fixed-TPP regime the optimal repetition count mildly increases with model size, plus a strong negative correlation with domain validation loss and a linear-regression theory (Thms 4.2-4.4) explaining it. Rigor is solid: controlled grid (4 domains, 3 unique-fractions, 7 repetition counts, fixed token budgets), confound-aware OOD analysis, LR-schedule ablation. Evidence is weakened by missing specifics (model sizes and exact TPP value never stated numerically, datasets described only generically, no downstream benchmarks, loss values only in figures), and the headline -0.944 correlation pools non-independent points across only four domains. Generalizability is moderate: single-domain repetition per run, one TPP regime, linear-model assumptions (beta > alpha) untested empirically. Reproducibility is limited: no code release, no named datasets or model scales. Out-of-scope exclusions do not apply.

primary_link.title: Scaling Domain Data Repetition in LLM Pretraining

papers.summary: As large language models scale, their training-token budgets must also increase to maintain an appropriate tokens-per-parameter ratio (\(\mathrm{TPP}\)). However, high-quality domain data is much harder to scale than general web data. As model size and the training-token budget increase, its fraction in the training mixture tends to decrease. Repeating the available high-quality data provides an effective way to counteract this dilution, but excessive repetition may lead to overfitting. We study
papers.summary_zh: 高品質領域資料難以隨模型規模等比擴充，重複使用可對抗稀釋但恐致過擬合。本文在固定 tokens-per-parameter（TPP）設定下，於 code、math、Wikipedia、medical 四領域掃描唯一資料比例 α 與重複次數 e，得出三項發現：其一，最佳重複次數與該領域最小驗證損失呈強負相關（Pearson −0.944），損失越低的領域可容忍越多重複；其二，固定 TPP 下最佳重複次數隨模型規模溫和增加，與固定資料量設定下「模型越大越易過擬合」的結論相反；其三，最佳重複次數對唯一資料量幾乎不敏感（相關僅 0.018）。作者以一維線性迴歸理論解釋：重複降低知識習得誤差但增加雜訊擬合誤差；TPP 固定時資料預算隨模型成長，使知識習得收益主導更久。附加實驗顯示重複效果具領域依賴性（Math 較耐重複，Wiki 超過 2 次即明顯退化），且學習率衰減越晚、可容忍重複越多。實務上可先在小型代理模型以任意 α 掃描重複次數，作為大模型的保守估計。限制為每次僅重複單一領域，多領域同時重複的交互作用、以及定量的跨規模遷移規則仍待研究。此研究為資料受限下的預訓練配方設計提供實用指引。

Chapter 1: strong-graded external result — Bjarnason et al. (2026) 60,000 SWE-bench-Verified trajectories with single-run pass@1 spread of 2.2–6.0 pp and SD >1.5 pp at temperature 0, grounding the repeated-run practices.

Chapter 8 evidence profile: '0 strong · 4 directional · 3 corroborating' — containment practices rest on incident reports; Chapter 20.2 reports Spearman rho of -0.004 between urgency rank and presence of strong evidence.

Chapter 12: CodeScaleBench, 370 paired tasks across 46 repositories; retrieval Precision@10 0.095→0.313 while end-to-end reward moved only +0.0349 (bootstrap CI [+0.0130, +0.0579]), with a disclosed resampling-unit flaw ('The interval therefore likely understates uncertainty').

Data and materials availability: frozen CodeScaleBench suite csb-v1-mixed371 released under Apache-2.0 with per-task traces and checksums; 'The 199-trace diagnostic corpus and the 1,286-item fleet ledger are not redistributed' with a stated de-identification rationale.

Chapter 19.5: PagedAttention and SGLang serving results cited only as directional transfer — 'None of the serving work cited here was measured on a coding-agent fleet', exemplifying the paper's disciplined transfer-boundary claims.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An engineering monograph on LLM coding-agent reliability that directly targets the highest-weight preferences: agents/tool use, coding agents, evaluation methodology, AI safety/containment, retrieval, and context/memory engineering. Topic relevance is very high, though it is a review-plus-case-study synthesis rather than new methodology. Rigor is unusually high for the genre (explicit four-tier evidence grading with a targeted audit that reduced six grades, disclosed unexecuted search lanes, paired/power-analysis statistics), but grading is single-author with no completed external calibration, and core empirical results are author-operated systems explicitly marked as non-independent evidence. Evidence strength is mixed by the paper's own accounting (strong-heavy in Part I, near-zero strong in containment chapters; urgency uncorrelated with evidence strength at rho=-0.004). Novelty is moderate: the dependency-chain/repair-asymmetry framing and evidence-graded 206-record catalog are fresh syntheses, but individual claims largely restate cited work. The framework generalizes with explicitly bounded transfer claims (observatory/cluster scheduling and inference-serving results are flagged as not measured on agent fleets). Reproducibility is partially supported: public CodeScaleBench suite with per-task traces and checksummed companion artifacts, yet withheld trace/fleet corpora and an unredeemed blinded grading packet.

primary_link.title: Engineering Reliable Coding Agents: Evaluating and Operating the System Around the Model

papers.summary: AI coding agents are commonly evaluated as models but deployed as systems. Their reliability depends not only on model capability, but on the harness, execution state, retrieval, memory and state management, permissions, review interfaces, and resource allocation. This monograph examines those boundaries and develops a framework for evaluating and operating coding agents reliably. It synthesizes 164 scholarly works, 100 practitioner records, 29 benchmark records, and 17 author-system case record
papers.summary_zh: 編碼代理常以模型身分被評測，卻以系統身分被部署；其可靠性取決於 harness、執行狀態、檢索、記憶、權限、審查介面與資源調度等周邊。本技術專書以多源文獻綜述（164 篇學術、100 篇實務、29 個基準與 17 個作者系統案例）提出「可靠性依賴鏈」：測量、評分、遏制與復原、檢索與上下文、審查與問責、配置與成本六層，每層決定下一層可信任什麼，下游修補無法挽回上游遺失的證據（修復不對稱性）。全書貢獻 206 條可靠性實務記錄（193 條獲准入門檻、其中 56 條深入發展）、證據帳本與可執行協定，主題涵蓋單次運行即一次抽樣、成對比較與統計檢定力、基準污染與 oracle 強度、以執行結果把關發布、LLM 評審校準、代理指標博弈監控、最小權限與爆炸半徑、持久狀態與冪等重試、故障注入復原測試、儲存庫檢索與新鮮度閘門、人類審查與權責對齊，以及車隊排程與模型路由。核心論點：許多表面上的模型失敗源自系統其他環節，且證據強度與營運急迫性幾乎無關（Spearman −0.004），工程上常須以機制論證先行部署控制。書中另提供最小可靠性通過流程，協助團隊區分模型能力與基礎設施效應、設計可辯護的評測並在故障時安全復原。

links.title: WANDR: A Benchmark for Wide and Deep Research

evidence: Abstract: 'the strongest system achieves only 0.363 soft F1 and 0.133 hard F1' with tasks and harness released at https://github.com/perplexityai/wandr

Section 2 / Table 1: WANDR positioned as the only listed benchmark combining real-world tasks, open-set discovery, collection-record grading, at-scale task generation, and reference-free verification versus WideSearch, DeepWideSearch, DeepSearchQA, GISA
Section 4.3 (Admission): feasibility audit via 10-12 merged rollouts and judge audit where 'an automated-judge error rate above approximately 10% of the remaining sample also blocks it'
Section 6.1: all systems graded with 'the same pinned GPT-5.4 evaluation configuration'; Table 4 reports one full-sample run per system with zero-filled terminal errors

Section 7.2 (Limitations): 'The main evaluation reports one production run per system rather than repeated trials' and the shared agentic fetch backend 'may confer some alignment advantage' to Perplexity, though 'the comparative ordering appears less sensitive'
Section 6.3.5 / Table 9: faithful excerpts fully support all requirements on only 55.6%-80.4% of qualifying records, the dominant partial-proof failure mode
Appendix N (Table 16): RL-suitability design with explicit reward-hacking and held-out-split caveats
llm_evaluation.rationale: A 500-task agentic wide-and-deep research benchmark squarely matching high-weight preferences (agents/tool use, evaluation/LLM-as-judge, retrieval grounding). Task contribution: qualification key hierarchies plus reference-free, citation-re-fetched record grading at collection scale, advancing beyond WideSearch/DeepWideSearch whose gold-table grading the authors explicitly contrast (Section 2, Table 1). Construction is unusually disciplined: author-critic loop, feasibility and judge audits with a ~10% judge-error block threshold, and a 20-min/task human budget (Section 4.3). Evaluation covers six production systems on 500 tasks plus a 45-task effort sweep with cost/latency/token accounting (Tables 4-7) and a four-layer failure decomposition (Sections 6.3.1-6.3.5). Deductions: single run per system with no variance estimate (Section 7.2), an LLM judge (pinned GPT-5.4) validated only by sampled audits and fixtures rather than large-scale human verification, observational failure analysis without causal ablation (Section 7.3), and a disclosed conflict where the grading fetch backend is shared with the top-scoring Perplexity solver (Section 7.2), partially mitigated by a reported fetch-ablation. Reproducibility is aided by the released harness (github.com/perplexityai/wandr) but constrained by live-web drift, proprietary APIs, and judge-model dependence.

primary_link.title: WANDR: A Benchmark for Wide and Deep Research

papers.summary: WANDR (Wide ANd Deep Research) is a benchmark of 500 realistic, challenging data-collection tasks for research agents. Each task requires a system to discover a large set of entities that satisfy specified criteria (breadth), investigate each entity through multiple coordinated web searches (depth), and return independently verifiable records with supporting sources and excerpts. Tasks are represented as qualification key hierarchies that specify the entities, relationships, evidence, and requir
papers.summary_zh: 知識工作常要求系統同時「廣泛發現」大量符合條件的實體，並為每個實體「深入查證」具體事實。WANDR 以 500 個源自去識別化產品使用日誌的代理式資料蒐集任務評測此能力：任務以資格鍵層級樹表示（如 company(70)→employee(1)→url(1)），定義數十至數千筆記錄目標；每筆記錄須附 URL 與逐字摘錄，任務專屬評審會重新抓取引用頁面逐條驗證，實現免參考答案的證據核實評分，並在任務層聚合出軟/硬 precision、recall 與 F1。建構採半自動管線（播種、作者—評論者迭代、可行性與評審稽核、策展），人類僅做品質把關。實驗評測六個生產系統：Perplexity 的 Search as Code 以 0.363 軟 F1、0.133 硬 F1 居首，但基準遠未飽和；失敗分析顯示 recall 普遍低於 precision、硬分數遠低於軟分數，效能隨目標量與層級深度急降；主要瓶頸不在找到頁面而在完整證據建構——忠實摘錄僅 55.6% 至 80.4% 能完全支持主張。限制包括每系統僅單次運行、無法分離各元件的因果貢獻，且評分抓取路徑與 Perplexity 後端對齊可能帶來偏差。WANDR 亦提供記錄級密集獎勵與課程結構，可作為 RL 訓練基底，凸顯大規模結構化蒐集與逐條事實正確的兼顧是代理搜尋的核心挑戰。

links.title: Training Leaves Traces: Centered Residual Signatures for Language Model Lineage Verification

evidence: Abstract and Table 3 (Section 4.1): centered residual signature achieves AUROC=1.0 on 52-pair MLP and 45-pair GPT-2 benchmarks (Gap-Z +53.0 and +31.0), distinguishing fine-tuned/LoRA-merged/pruned/quantized descendants from independent and distilled models.

Table 5 and Appendix A.1 Table 8 (Section 4.2): AUROC=1.0 maintained under permutation/rescaling laundering while weight cosine Gap-Z collapses from +76.3 to +1.8-2.1 (Appendix D.1 Table 15); method is 76x faster than Re-Basin+scale on GPT-2 (5.1ms vs 387.9ms).
Table 4 (Section 4.1): public LLaMA-2 case study — Llama-2-chat (0.995), Vicuna (0.996), CodeLlama (0.336) vs 7 independently trained architectural clones all |L|<5e-5.

Figure 2 and Appendix C (Tables 12-13): mechanism tests — orthogonal initialization (exact dynamical isometry) yields 0% correct pairs at init, PlainNet stays at chance (3%), pretrained Jacobians are 5-12x less orthogonal than init; mechanism explicitly described as 'a plausible mechanism, not a proven cause' (Section 3.2).

Appendix B.2 and Limitations: effective sample size for null calibration is limited by independent roots (8 GPT-2 roots, 3 test; 3 MLP roots), so conformal p-value claims are downgraded in favor of AUROC reporting.

Limitations section: method requires white-box access, compatible residual architectures only (plain nets, RNNs, SSMs out of scope), symmetric score cannot establish descent direction, and residual-stream Q-rotation laundering is not defended against for unparameterized normalization; Appendix A states code 'will be released upon acceptance'.

Appendix D.5/D.6: trace concentration alone fails lineage verification (AUROC=0.417), and a gradient-based suppression attack can reach the null threshold at +1.5% utility loss — an appropriately skeptical self-evaluation of robustness claims.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A data-free, white-box lineage verification method for LLM checkpoints, squarely relevant to LLM research and AI safety (provenance auditing, model theft, checkpoint laundering), with secondary overlap to training/efficiency topics (fine-tuning, LoRA, pruning, quantization). Not a pure domain application. Novelty is solid but partially incremental: the trace-concentration observation is credited to Park (2026), with this paper's contribution being the centering step, calibrated symmetric lineage score, and laundering-robustness evaluation against prior work (HuRef, REEF, MoTHer). Rigor is strong: controlled 52/45-pair benchmarks with distilled-student negative controls, seven baselines, initialization and centering ablations, mechanism experiments that are appropriately hedged ('plausible mechanism, not a proven cause'), and honest statistical caveats about limited effective sample size (8 roots, 3 test roots). Evidence is convincing within scope (AUROC=1.0 with large Gap-Z margins; public LLaMA-2 case study separates 3 descendants from 7 architectural clones), though the language-model benchmark uses only 30M-parameter TinyStories models and public validation is limited. Generalizability is constrained by design: only compatible residual architectures with matching depth/width, no cross-architecture verification, and acknowledged Q-rotation laundering vulnerability for unparameterized normalization. Reproducibility protocols are detailed (seeds, hardware, hyperparameters) but code and per-pair scores are only promised 'upon acceptance'.

primary_link.title: Training Leaves Traces: Centered Residual Signatures for Language Model Lineage Verification

papers.summary:
Open-weight language models are fine-tuned, quantized, pruned, and merged, yet their provenance is often undocumented. We study data-free white-box lineage verification: can weights alone reveal whether two compatible model checkpoints share ancestry?
  Residual training produces a shared identity-aligned component in branch products, so this structure alone cannot establish ancestry. We remove it and compare checkpoint-specific structure across residual blocks, yielding a symmetric lineage scor
papers.summary_zh: 開源語言模型常在 fine-tuning、量化、剪枝或合併後以新名稱重新發布,血緣往往無從查考。本文研究免資料的白盒血緣驗證:能否僅憑權重,判斷兩個架構相容的 checkpoint 是否源自共同祖先?作者觀察到訓練後的殘差分支乘積 W_out·W_in 呈現所有模型共享的單位對齊成分,不足以證明血緣,因此進一步扣除該成分,取其跡零餘項作為各 checkpoint 特有的「中心化殘差簽章」,再以 Hungarian 演算法對齊區塊,計算對稱的血緣分數,並以獨立訓練模型建立經驗虛無分布校正。在殘差 MLP 與 30M 參數 GPT-2 基準上,該分數以 AUROC=1.0 完美區分 fine-tuned、LoRA 合併、剪枝與量化的後代,以及蒸餾學生與獨立模型,證明其辨識的是權重繼承而非行為相似。在函數保持式的「checkpoint 洗白」攻擊下,權重餘弦等基線失效或差距崩落,本方法的分數維持不變,且在 GPT-2 上比 Re-Basin 快 76 倍。跡集中現象跨六個語言模型家族及視覺、語音架構皆成立,LLaMA-2 公開案例正確辨識 3 個後代與 7 個獨立克隆。限制方面:僅適用於殘差架構與同構 checkpoint、需白盒存取、分數對稱無法判定血緣方向,且在 85% 稀疏剪枝或 CodeLlama 式長期持續預訓練下訊號減弱(仍高於虛無門檻)。整體而言,這為開源模型供應鏈提供了一種被動式溯源審計工具。

links.title: ASSERT: A Measurement Pipeline for GenAI Audits

evidence: §3.3: on identical transcripts, judge substitution moves the reported rate from 80% (Opus-4.7) to 95% (Grok-4.3), a 15-point swing with the GPT-5.5 baseline at 82%

§3.4 Table 1: 3×3 judge×system matrix (N=120 transcripts per system) shows no single ranking of GPT-5.5, Opus-4.7, and Grok-4.3 holds across all judges; Grok-4.3 as judge reports 97–99% for every system
§3.1: conditional reproducibility checks—five fresh judge calls stay within a narrow band, while three rollout reruns produce 82–87%, defined as the run-to-run noise floor

Appendix D.2: across 360 transcripts GPT-5.5 flags 125, Opus-4.7 flags 68, Grok-4.3 flags 11; criterion-level Jaccard ≈0.7, so disagreement is driven by selection of which transcripts fail, not attribution

Appendix D.1: under a single global judgment, GPT-5.5 and Opus-4.7 both report 84% yet disagree on 20/120 labels, and Grok-4.3 reports 99%, so rubric decomposition is not the sole cause of judge sensitivity

Appendix D.3: analogous sensitivity holds for disability representation and crisis response (elicitation mode shifts crisis-response rates by >30 points), but ISA varies <6 points—an honest boundary condition
§5 Limitations: Wilson confidence intervals do not account for judge error, and shared generator structure across templates likely overstates independent sample size
Footnote 1: code is available at https://github.com/responsibleai/ASSERT; Appendix C publishes the full eval_config.yaml specification and Appendix B the ten-criterion rubric
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-evaluation/safety methodology paper: a specification-driven audit pipeline with a multiverse analysis showing reported compliance rates and system rankings swing with judge, simulated user, and evidentiary-standard choices. Directly serves high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI safety, red-teaming/evaluation, LLM-as-judge). The measurement framework is adopted from Chouldechova et al. (2024) and systematization from Agarwal et al. (2026); multiverse/specification-curve logic is borrowed from social science, so conceptual novelty is moderate—the contribution is the executable pipeline plus quantified instrument sensitivity. Rigor is solid: a run-to-run noise floor (82–87% over three rollout reruns) is separated from specification-induced shifts, a full 3×3 judge×system matrix is reported, and a global-judgment control rules out rubric structure as the sole disagreement source. Limitations: no human-annotation ground truth to adjudicate which judge is correct, N=120 per system, only three reruns for the noise floor, and no significance testing of ranking reversals. Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent but cannot establish which measurement is valid. Honest limitations (CIs exclude judge error; generator-induced dependence) and released code with a full config support reproducibility, though closed-model dependence limits exact replication. Generalizability is partially addressed via three extra concepts (D.3), including the honest null that ISA is insensitive.

primary_link.title: ASSERT: A Measurement Pipeline for GenAI Audits

papers.summary: Audits of generative AI (GenAI) systems often summarize behavior as a reported rate: how often the audited system complies with policy. Researchers and stakeholders use that rate to compare systems, track regressions, and gate deployment. A reported rate reflects both the system under audit and the measurement choices behind it, so a change in the rate can leave it unclear whether the system or those choices moved. We introduce ASSERT, a specification-driven measurement pipeline for GenAI audits
papers.summary_zh: 審計生成式 AI 系統時,常以單一「政策合規率」總結行為,但該數字同時取決於受測系統與測量選擇,一旦變動難以歸因。本文提出 ASSERT,一條以規格書驅動的測量管線:研究者從模糊的背景概念(如欺騙)出發,先系統化為明確的概念規格,再轉為行為量規、以 LLM 生成測試案例、由模擬使用者進行多輪互動、由評審模型逐項標註,最後彙整為報告率,每個環節的選擇都寫入可檢視的量測規格。在對話式欺騙個案中,作者以 GPT-5.5 為受測系統執行 multiverse 分析:基準合規率 82%,但更換評審模型會使其在 80%(Opus-4.7)與 95%(Grok-4.3)間擺盪,且三種評審下沒有任何系統排名維持不變;改用 GPT-5.5 擔任模擬使用者使比率升至 90% 以上,放寬或收緊舉證標準亦造成約十個百分點的移動,遠大於固定規格重跑的雜訊底線。即使改為單一整體判斷,評審間的逐筆分歧仍然存在,逐項弱點診斷也隨評審而變。作者提醒:系統比較只有在差異能抵禦合理的替代規格時才值得信賴;Wilson 信賴區間未涵蓋評審誤差與跨階段相關錯誤,更細的量規也會機械性壓低合規率。ASSERT 讓量測選擇透明化,使審計結果可歸因、可比較、可重現。
papers.title: ASSERT: A Measurement Pipeline for GenAI Audits
papers.title_zh: ASSERT:一條用於生成式 AI 審計的測量管線

links.title: SimpleOPD: Simple Tokenizer-Agnostic On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: 'Intern-S2-Preview improves by 21.2 points on ProofBench, reaching 55.2 and surpassing Gemini-2.5-Pro' — headline claim based on judge evaluation (Figure 1 uses Gemini-2.5-Pro as judge).

Section 3.2: 'For ProofBench, we use DeepSeek-V4-Flash as the judge... we evaluate 4 times for the same proof rollout and choose the average result' — same model scores 44.50 (Table 2) under this judge vs 55.2 under Gemini judge, indicating ~10-point judge sensitivity.
Section 3.2: 'The best checkpoint is selected based on the average score of AIME@4 and AnswerBench@1' — selection metric overlaps with reported test benchmarks, a potential selection-bias concern.

Section 3.2 (Implementation Details): lr 1e-6, 100 rollout iterations, rollout batch 64, 4 responses per prompt, PPO clip 0.2, max rollout 32K (Qwen-series) / 6K (GLM, Gemma) — reproducibility-supporting detail.
Section 4.1.2-4.1.3 and Table 1: ablations isolating special-token masking (ProofBench 21.70→38.10) and student-reference KL (21.70→38.50), supporting the stabilization claims.

Section 5.1 and Figure 8: comparison only against EOPD and G-OPD; SimCT (Sun et al., 2026) and byte-level cross-tokenizer distillation (Singh et al., 2026), cited in Section 1/6.2 as closest related work, are not empirically compared.
Section 5.3 and Table 3: out-of-domain gains are small (HLE +0.9, HiPhO +2.5, FrontierScience Research +3.3), tempering the generalization claim beyond math.
Title page: 'Project Page / Code / Models' entries are shown without URLs, and Section 3 states SU-01 is 'developed by our team', so teacher and artifacts availability is unverified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM methodology: on-policy distillation transferring long-context mathematical reasoning across tokenizers/model families (directly matches LLM, reasoning/CoT, training-optimization, and long-context preferences). The engineering contribution is real and empirically validated, but novelty is moderate: cross-tokenizer distillation via shared surface text is adjacent to cited prior work (SimCT, byte-level interface, dual-space KD), and the stabilizers (termination-token advantage masking, reference KL) are simple, standard RLHF-style fixes; no head-to-head against the closest cross-tokenizer OPD baseline. Rigor is supported by a broad ablation suite (Table 1 masking/KL, Table 4 length, Table 6 KL coefficient, Table 5 second teacher) but weakened by judge-based ProofBench scoring with large judge sensitivity (44.50 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash judge in Table 2 vs 55.2 with Gemini-2.5-Pro judge in Figure 1), no variance/significance reporting, and checkpoint selection on AIME/AnswerBench which are also reported results. Evidence for headline claims (surpassing Gemini-2.5-Pro) rests entirely on LLM-as-judge; out-of-domain gains are small (0.3-3.3 points). Generalizability is well demonstrated across five student families, two tokenizers, and two teachers, though all training data is math proofs. Reproducibility is middling: hyperparameters, framework (Slime/SGLang), and data sources are specified, but the teacher SU-01 is an internal model and the Project Page/Code/Models links appear as placeholders without verifiable URLs.

primary_link.title: SimpleOPD: Simple Tokenizer-Agnostic On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning

papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a promising way to transfer reasoning capabilities from stronger teacher models, but applying it to long-context reasoning teachers and short-context students introduces practical challenges, including tokenizer mismatch, teacher-student distribution mismatch, response length explosion, and training instability. In this work, we study this setting by transferring proof-reasoning capabilities from the long-context reasoning model SU-01 to short-context student
papers.summary_zh: On-policy distillation(OPD)以學生自生成的軌跡請教師逐 token 給予監督,是移轉推理能力的有效途徑,但將長上下文推理教師(如 IMO 金牌等級的 SU-01)蒸餾到短上下文學生時,會面臨 tokenizer 不一致、師生分布落差、回應長度暴增與頻繁截斷等問題。SimpleOPD 提出兩項簡單修正:一是在共享文字空間中對齊,僅當師生 token 佔據相同文字片段時才傳遞教師 log-probability,未對齊位置退回學生自身機率,以雙指標線性掃描完成部分一對一映射;二是遮蔽 、<|im_end|> 等終止 token 的優勢值,並加入學生參考 KL 損失以抑制策略漂移,讓長度穩定成長。實驗涵蓋 Qwen3、Qwen3.5、Intern-S2、GLM-4.7、Gemma-4 等同源與跨家族學生,數學推理一致提升:Intern-S2-Preview 在 ProofBench 由 34.0 增至 55.2(+21.2 分,以 Gemini-2.5-Pro 為評審),超越 Gemini-2.5-Pro,並在 AIME25、AnswerBench、AMOBench 與 HLE、HiPhO 等科學基準同步進步,顯示能力可遷移至數學訓練域之外。消融顯示 32k 蒸餾長度優於 6k,以 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 為教師同樣有效;KL 係數過大或過小皆不佳,詞彙差異較大的 Gemma(SentencePiece)僅在 ProofBench 進步。此法無須共享詞彙,也無須以教師軌跡做 SFT,即可跨家族轉移長篇證明推理能力。
papers.title: SimpleOPD: Simple Tokenizer-Agnostic On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.title_zh: SimpleOPD:簡潔的 Tokenizer 無關式 On-Policy 蒸餾,迎戰長上下文推理

links.title: Handover of In-Context Learning State Across Session Boundaries

evidence: Abstract: formulates handover as transfer of a task-relative ICL state, distinguishing exact recovery from preservation of the target distribution, with Gaussian and nonparametric regression results.
Sec. 3.3, Definition 3.2: predictive sufficiency defined as P(Y|C,X,T)=P(Y|H,X,T) almost surely, judged by post-handover prediction rather than similarity to earlier wording.
Sec. 3.4, Proposition 3.6: pre-query encoding incurs H2(Y|H,X) >= max{0, 1 - B/m} under I(C;H)<=B bits, whereas a query-aware encoder attains zero log loss with one bit.

Sec. 5.2, Theorem 5.1: record Hn=(Gn,bn) is predictively sufficient for Gaussian linear regression with I(Y;Xn,yn|Hn,x,T)=0; Cor. 5.5-5.6 give finite-bit codes with K2^{-2(B-B0)/p} predictive KL bound.

Sec. 5.3, Theorem 5.10: memory-constrained minimax lower bound R_{n,B} >= c*max{n^{-2beta/(2beta+d)}, (B+1)^{-2beta/d}}, matching the cell-statistics upper bound (Thm. 5.7, Cor. 5.8) up to coding logarithms.
Appendices D-F: complete proofs for all general, parametric, and nonparametric claims, e.g., D.12 proves Prop. 3.6 via conditional subadditivity and D.14 proves Thm. 3.5 via Pinsker's inequality.
Sec. 4: proposed three-part record H=(H_exact, H_stat, H_residual) with deterministic checks (Sec. 4.2, Appendix B), but no implementation or empirical evaluation anywhere in the paper.

Sec. 7.3 and Prop. C.5: acknowledged scope limits - sufficiency is relative to the later-input law, coverage violations can destroy sufficiency, and adaptive trajectories fall outside the fixed-replay results (Thm. C.3).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A theory paper squarely within preferred topics: it formulates LLM agent session handover as task-relative ICL state transfer with memory budgets (Abstract; Sec. 1), directly engaging LLM, agent, long-context/memory, and ICL preferences, though it is purely theoretical with zero empirical validation on actual LLMs or agent benchmarks. Novelty is solid: the pre-query (writer-before-realized-input) information ordering distinguishes it from query-aware prompt compression (Sec. 2.2, Sec. 3.4, Prop. 3.6), and the predictive-sufficiency characterization of the coarsest handover state (Prop. 3.1, Cor. 3.2) is a new framing, but the statistical machinery is classical (Blackwell, Wyner-Ziv, Gaussian sufficiency, Assouad/Fano minimax) applied to a new problem. Rigor is high: assumptions (exogeneity, coverage in Eq. 80, bounded loss) are stated carefully, claims are properly scoped, limitations are acknowledged (Sec. 7.3), and complete proofs appear in Appendices D-F and check out for the key results verified (Prop. 3.6 bit bound, Thm. 5.1 sufficiency, Thm. 5.3 perturbation bounds, Thm. 5.10 memory floor). Evidence strength is limited because the proposed three-part record (Sec. 4) is never evaluated empirically and the regression models are proxies whose connection to real transformer ICL behavior is untested; the ideal-decoder decomposition (Eq. 21) is calculable only in the controlled regression settings. Generalizability is decent given the model-agnostic information-theoretic formulation, but sufficiency is relative to a fixed later-input law and adaptive trajectories are excluded (Sec. 3.3, Thm. C.3 scope). Reproducibility is moderate: proofs are reproducible but no code, implementation, or experiments are provided.

primary_link.title: Handover of In-Context Learning State Across Session Boundaries

papers.summary: This study investigates the methodological and theoretical properties of session handover in applications that use large language models. A task may continue in a new session when the context reaches the model's input limit, when the application restarts, or when another agent is asked to finish the task. The application must then decide which information from the earlier session to pass on. We formulate handover as the transfer of a task-relative in-context learning (ICL) state and distinguish
papers.summary_zh: 當任務因 context 超過輸入上限、應用重啟或改由另一個 agent 接手而必須開啟新 session 時,應用程式該把舊脈絡中的哪些資訊交給新 session?本文將 session handover 形式化為「任務相對的 in-context learning 狀態」傳遞:寫入者在得知後續查詢之前先產生交接紀錄,再由延續程序消費。核心概念是預測充分性:在外生性條件下,預測等價類刻畫最粗的確定性充分交接,並導出至少 log2(N) 位元的固定長度下界;在 log loss 下,交接造成的風險差恰為條件互資訊 I(Y;C|H,X,T),一個 Bernoulli 例子量化了「先寫後知查詢」的資訊代價。方法上,紀錄分三部分:必須逐字保留的決策與限制、僅在有明確保證或誤差界時才採用的任務正當統計量,以及無法被統計量取代的原始觀察。Gaussian 線性迴歸給出精確的有限維充分統計量 (G_n, b_n)、合成充分示範的等價性,以及有限位元量化的擾動界;非參數迴歸則給出記憶預算 B 與平方誤差的上、下界 R ≥ c·max{n^{-2β/(2β+d)}, (B+1)^{-2β/d}},顯示所需記憶隨目標精度增長。作者強調記憶會計須計入外部檔案與資料庫,並提醒理論假設乾淨的接續情境,且以迴歸為主要可解實例;自適應軌跡需另以軌跡層級損失處理。此結果為 agent 的上下文壓縮、記憶系統與交接設計提供了評估基準。
papers.title: Handover of In-Context Learning State Across Session Boundaries
papers.title_zh: In-Context Learning 狀態跨 Session 邊界的交接

links.title: Envs-FORGE: Frontier-Optimized Reward-Grounded Environment Synthesis for Agent RL

evidence: Abstract: 'On Qwen 3.5 35B, Envs-FORGE improves Pass@1 over Base by 9.2 percentage points on tb-core (40.0% to 49.2%) and 6.4 points on tb-2.0 (23.0% to 29.4%), exceeding the strongest fixed-recipe baseline by 2.4 and 2.1 points.'

Section 3.2: 'Δ_increase=−0.25, Δ_reduce=0.25, Δ_diversify=0 ... These fixed transfer priors rank candidates before generation; they are not empirical claims that every materialized task shifts pass rate by the same amount.'
Section 4.1: 'Each run continues generation, repair, and verification until exactly 100 environment bundles are accepted and exported as the downstream RL training source.'

Section 4.5 Evaluation Scope / Limitations: 'Expanded component studies can isolate portfolio mode, solver-off selection, transfer-prior sensitivity, and Evol-Instruct's depth and breadth variants.' (no variance or significance testing reported anywhere in Tables 1-3)
Abstract: 'The source code is available at https://github.com/DataArcTech/DataArc-SynData-Toolkit/'; Appendix D: 'Training is conducted on 2 H800 80GB GPUs' with GRPO, FSDP2, lr 1e-6, 1 epoch.
Appendix B: 'PySCIPOpt reports status=optimal with objective value 49.9104' for the recorded 100-seed solve.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: environment synthesis for RL-trained terminal/code agents (Agents 2.5, Code 2.0, RL/Training), with an LLM-driven pipeline. The core idea—estimating seed pass rates and selecting a per-seed difficulty projection/direction before generation—is a sensible and reasonably fresh layer over Self-Instruct/Evol-Instruct and difficulty-aware synthesis (DART-Math), but the MILP is largely decorative: each seed independently picks 1 of 6 actions using hand-set transfer priors (Δ=±0.25, γ=0.65, Section 3.2), so the optimization machinery adds little beyond argmax. Rigor benefits from a controlled comparison (identical synthesis/verification pipeline, fixed 100-verified-environment export, token accounting in Table 1, benchmark and 4B-35B ablations in Table 2), but is weakened by absent variance/significance reporting, a single 100-seed pool, one model family, no ablation of frontier hyperparameters (τ=0.5, σ=0.2), no solver-off selector comparison, and approximate mapping of baselines into the action space (Table 4). Evidence is directionally consistent (gains of +6.8 to +9.2 over Base across sizes; +2.4/+2.1 over strongest fixed recipe) but rests on single runs with modest margins. Generalizability beyond terminal/code tasks and Qwen 3.5 is asserted, not shown. Reproducibility is aided by a code link, full prompts (Appendix C), SCIP/PySCIPOpt details (Appendix B), and training configs (Appendix D), though the identity of the synthesis LLM and the seed-task source are not pinned down.

primary_link.title: Envs-FORGE: Frontier-Optimized Reward-Grounded Environment Synthesis for Agent RL

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for terminal agents needs executable training environments with reliable rewards and useful difficulty. Fixed recipes such as few-shot, Self-Instruct, and Evol-Instruct apply the same prompting policy to every seed, even when the current policy would benefit from a harder, easier, or simply different task. We present Envs-FORGE, a prompting policy that converts verifier rewards into per-seed environment-synthesis actions. Envs-FORGE estimates seed pass rates, scores s
papers.summary_zh: 終端代理的強化學習（RL）訓練需要可執行、獎勵可靠且難度適中的訓練環境，但 few-shot、Self-Instruct、Evol-Instruct 等固定提示配方對每個種子任務施加相同的改寫策略，無法貼近當前策略的學習前沿。Envs-FORGE 提出獎勵導向的提示政策：先由驗證器獎勵估計種子通過率，再為「增加／降低／多樣化」三種投影與「深度／廣度」兩種演化方向組成的六個候選動作評分，並以每種子一個混合整數線性規劃（MILP）選出最適動作。選定動作會同步改寫指令、夾具資料（fixtures）、參考解答、測試與 Docker 環境，僅有在黃金驗證中取得獎勵 1 的環境才進入 GRPO 訓練。在 Qwen 3.5 35B 上，tb-core 的 Pass@1 由 40.0% 提升至 49.2%（+9.2 個百分點），tb-2.0 由 23.0% 提升至 29.4%（+6.4 個百分點），分別超越最強固定配方基準 2.4 與 2.1 個百分點；SWE-bench Verified 達 77.1%（Base 為 73.4%），且於 4B 至 35B 各模型規模皆有 6.8–9.2 個百分點增益。四種方法皆匯出 100 個已驗證環境，合成 tokens 總量介於 2.27M–2.88M，確保比較立足於相同的下游訓練集規模。限制為僅評估每種子 MILP 模式與固定匯出規模，組合層級技能覆蓋、關閉求解器的選擇與轉移先驗敏感度等研究留待後續。核心啟示：代理 RL 的環境合成應在要求 LLM 改寫前，先決定每個種子相對於當前策略該如何移動。
papers.title: Envs-FORGE: Frontier-Optimized Reward-Grounded Environment Synthesis for Agent RL
papers.title_zh: Envs-FORGE：面向代理 RL 的前沿最佳化、獎勵導向環境合成

links.title: Exploring High-Bandwidth Flash for Modern LLM Inference: Opportunities and Challenges

evidence: Section II (Background and Motivation): claims 'the first systematic study' on HBF replacing most HBM for LLM serving; notes only prior work [8] used HBF as read-only memory for cache-augmented generation

Section III (Hardware Configuration, Table I): five systems (HBM4, CONV, CONV+, HBF, HBF+) with HBF 512 GB/stack, projected 1.6 TB/s read bandwidth, assumed 100 µs page-program latency, and conservative CONV variants at 0.35 TB/s read

Section III (Simulation Methodology): extends LLMSimulator [12] with HBF-aware timing model, continuous batching and KV-write overhead modeling; states 'We will open-source our extended LLM simulator' (future availability only)
Section IV (Batch Size, Fig. 3): HBF/HBF+ give 1.3-4.5x and 1.7-5.3x per-GPU batch-size gains over 8-GPU HBM4 under 0.1s TPOT SLO; CONV often below HBM4, showing capacity alone is insufficient
Section IV (Performance Breakdown, Fig. 5): KV-cache writes account for 5-13.9% of decode time in Llama4 on HBF+
Section IV (Write Traffic Analysis, Fig. 7): per-block P/E-cycle counts far exceed 100K within three years in most scenarios, identifying endurance as a critical challenge (Takeaway 5)
Section IV (Effect of SLO, Fig. 6): HBF+ TPS gains grow under relaxed SLOs, e.g., 4.1% to 14.8% for Llama4 with 16 GPUs in the offline scenario (Takeaway 4)
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope systems study of LLM inference serving infrastructure: High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) as a main GPU-memory component, directly matching LLM (2.5), Inference & Serving (KV cache, batching, throughput, latency), Scaling & Efficiency, and Long Context & Memory preferences. Not a domain application or out-of-scope area. Novelty is moderate: the paper credibly claims the first systematic analysis of HBF replacing HBM for general LLM serving (Section II notes the only prior work [8] used HBF as read-only for CAG), but it is an exploratory simulation study of a projected hardware technology rather than a new technique. Rigor is solid for a simulation paper: five configurations with a conservative CONV variant (Table I, Section III), two models (dense Llama 3 405B, MoE Llama 4 Maverick), three context-length workloads, SLO sweeps, latency breakdown, and write-endurance analysis; however, key parameters (1.6 TB/s read, 100 µs write latency) are projections/assumptions, steady-state constant arrival is assumed, and no real hardware or measured baselines validate results. Evidence is quantitative but entirely simulation-derived with unshown figures; specific numbers (1.3-4.5x/1.7-5.3x batch gains, 5-13.9% KV-write time, PEC > 100K) are internally consistent. Generalizability is decent within serving (dense/MoE, 1-16 GPUs, SLO range) but conclusions hinge on HBF specs that may not materialize. Reproducibility is limited: detailed configurations and a promised open-sourced extended simulator, but no currently available artifact.

primary_link.title: Exploring High-Bandwidth Flash for Modern LLM Inference: Opportunities and Challenges

papers.summary: This work investigates the potential benefits and technical challenges of using high-bandwidth flash (HBF) for large language model (LLM) inference. HBF has gained increasing attention as a promising solution to mitigate memory-capacity bottlenecks in modern LLM-serving systems, but its benefits and challenges remain largely uninvestigated. To address this gap, we thoroughly analyze HBF-based LLM-serving systems under diverse system configurations and operating scenarios in which HBF serves as a
papers.summary_zh: 現代 LLM 推論深受 HBM 容量限制，擴充 HBM 需要更多 GPU 與昂貴的高速互連。高頻寬快閃記憶體（HBF）以低延遲 NAND 快閃堆疊取代 HBM 的 DRAM，單一堆疊容量可達 512 GB（為 HBM4 的 36 GB 之 14 倍以上），目標讀取頻寬與 HBM4 相當（約 1.6 TB/s）。本文是首篇系統分析以 HBF 取代大部分 HBM 作為 GPU 主記憶體的研究：作者擴充 LLM 推論模擬器，納入 NAND 讀寫頻寬不對稱、KV 快取寫入開銷與連續批次等機制，在 Llama 3 405B（密集模型）與 Llama 4 Maverick（MoE 模型）上，比較 HBM4、HBF、HBF+ 與由既有低延遲 NAND 外推的保守配置 CONV、CONV+，涵蓋 1 至 16 顆 GPU、不同 TPOT SLO 與短、中、長三種上下文長度負載。結果顯示：在 0.1 秒 TPOT SLO 下，8 顆 GPU 時 HBF 與 HBF+ 的每 GPU 批次大小分別為 HBM4 的 1.3–4.5 倍與 1.7–5.3 倍，單顆 GPU 即可超越 8 GPU HBM4 的批次規模，並降低最低 GPU 需求、提升吞吐量與部署彈性；但僅靠容量並不足夠，若讀取頻寬僅如 CONV 的 0.35 TB/s，批次大小反而受限。此外，KV 快取寫入占 5–13.9% 執行時間，且三年內每區塊抹除／寫入（P/E）循環遠超 NAND 約 10 萬次的耐用度上限。作者總結：HBF 的效益關鍵在於維持 HBM 同級讀取頻寬，並需大幅改善寫入效能與耐用度，特別適合 SLO 較寬鬆的輸送量導向或離線推論場景。
