links.title: Beyond Tokens: A Survey on Decoding Methods for Large Language and Vision-Language Models

evidence: Abstract: states the survey identifies three emerging paradigms of decoding methods for LLMs and LVLMs and links a public GitHub resource (Awesome-LLM-Decoding).
§4.1-§4.3 + Table 1: formal Definitions 1-3 for contrastive, guided, and parallel decoding, with a table categorizing roughly 45 works by paradigm, model type (PLM/LLM/LVLM), and year.
§5.1.3: surveys decoding for reasoning, including eliciting CoT paths by modifying the decoding process ([149]) and contrastive decoding improving LLM reasoning ([96]).

§5.1.2 and §6.5: covers safety-oriented decoding (SafeDecoding [161], ROSE [182], Jailbreak Value Decoding [143]) and the risk that adversaries can steal decoding hyperparameters via API access ([91]).

§6.1-§6.2: critical discussion of limitations, e.g., task-sensitive layer selection in DoLa ([20]), heavy hyperparameter tuning requirements ([115]), and a theoretical account of contrastive decoding as logit extrapolation ([13]).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A survey squarely on core LLM methodology: inference-time decoding for LLMs and LVLMs, touching reasoning/CoT, safety/alignment, RAG factuality, code generation, and inference efficiency, so preference relevance is high. As a synthesis it offers a clear three-paradigm taxonomy (contrastive, guided, parallel) with formal definitions, but novelty is limited by prior decoding surveys it cites (Wiher et al. 2022; Xia et al. 2024) and by the absence of new experiments or quantitative meta-comparison; claims are citation-backed rather than empirically verified. Coverage is broad and the limitations section is genuinely critical (hyperparameter sensitivity, layer-selection fragility, decoding-attack surface), supporting decent generalizability; a public companion repository aids traceability, though no paper-selection protocol is documented.

primary_link.title: Beyond Tokens: A Survey on Decoding Methods for Large Language and Vision-Language Models

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) and large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated impressive generative capabilities, yet ensuring their outputs align with user intent is still challenging. While most existing approaches address this issue at the training stage, inference-time approaches like decoding methods offer a more efficient and scalable solution. Decoding methods control model generation by guiding token-level selection, performing sequence-level generation, or generating tokens in
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）與大型視覺語言模型（LVLM）的輸出未必符合使用者意圖；相較於訓練階段的對齊方法，推論階段的解碼方法更具效率與可擴充性。本綜論先回顧貪婪搜尋、beam search、top-k／top-p 抽樣、溫度調整與 speculative decoding 等基礎策略，接著歸納三種新興典範：對比解碼（contrastive decoding）透過專家與反專家模型或跨層 logits 的差異調整詞元機率；引導解碼（guided decoding）以分類器、獎勵模型或前瞻搜尋等啟發式函數決定下一個詞元；平行解碼（parallel decoding）先平行草擬多個詞元，再由目標模型驗證以加速生成。作者進一步整理這些方法在緩解幻覺、提升安全性、強化推理、檢索增強生成、程式碼生成，以及文字、影像、影片生成效率與醫療、機器人等領域的應用。討論部分指出主要挑戰：對比範例與對比層的選擇依賴人工且對任務敏感、樹搜尋類方法難以擴展、各典範之間的組合與理論解釋仍不足，隱私、偏見與著作權等解碼目標尚未充分探討；解碼機制本身也可能被攻擊者以低成本竊取超參數，需浮水印等防禦。整體而言，解碼方法免再訓練、模型無關且具可解釋性，是低成本提升與延伸 LLM 能力的重要方向，文末附有持續更新的論文清單資源。
papers.title: Beyond Tokens: A Survey on Decoding Methods for Large Language and Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 超越詞元：大型語言與視覺語言模型解碼方法綜論

links.title: JarvisBench: Always-on Intelligence Between Humans and Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'JarvisBench contains 45 agentic task instances: 20 single-agent tasks and 25 workstreams organized into 10 multi-agent projects... selected and adapted from more than 2,000 public candidates'

Section 5.1/Table 1: 'Jarvis improves every completed worker-task configuration, with gains of 4.9-24.7 points on single-agent tasks and 12.5-28.2 points on multi-agent tasks'; GPT-5.6-Sol worker multi-agent w. Jarvis cell is a dash ('a dash denotes an unavailable result')

Section 3.3: User-Interaction Track uses causal replay with 'GPT-5.6-Luna' as generator of follow-ups and 'An evaluator independently scores each response as 0, 1, or 2' - both roles are LLMs with no human validation reported

Appendix A.1: 'We audited 69 existing agent benchmarks... produced a catalog of 2,038 candidate tasks'; Appendix A.4: validation via 'static checks, runtime preflight, a worker-only baseline, and manual trace review'
Section 5.3/Table 3: GPT-5.6-Sol Overall 96.3; 'latency is also sensitive to API conditions and the TTS serving strategy, we report these measurements only as a reference'
Appendix A.4: 'Only tasks with a valid execution, a clear attention gap, and a plausible one-turn repair were admitted'
Header: Code released at https://github.com/cchen1436/JarvisBench; Section 4.1 fixes worker model/harness/prompt/tools identical between baseline and Jarvis conditions
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is an agentic LLM benchmark: an always-on intermediary coordinating human attention with working agents, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, LLM, and Evaluation/LLM-as-judge preferences (audio is a peripheral prototype detail). The bidirectional attention-coordination framing is genuinely distinct from τ-bench, UserBench, π-Bench, and MultiAgentBench as argued in Section 6, though it is a benchmark paper rather than a method. Rigor is mixed: controlled worker-fixed comparisons, a defined Task Outcome Score, Attention Efficiency metric, causal replay protocol, and documented task validation (Appendix A.4) are strengths, but the judge and simulated user are both LLMs (GPT-5.6-Luna) with no human agreement study, runs appear single-shot with no variance or significance testing, the task count is small (45), and a cell is missing (Table 1: GPT-5.6-Sol worker multi-agent with Jarvis is a dash), softening the 'every completed configuration improves' claim. Evidence is quantitative but unaccompanied by CIs; latency is fairly acknowledged as deployment-entangled (Section 5.3). Generalizability is supported by 19 domains, cross-family worker transfer (Table 1), and a runtime-agnostic sidecar design, yet results are grader- and model-dependent. Reproducibility benefits from released code, listed task identifiers, and detailed protocol appendices, but relies on proprietary models and unspecified decoding.

primary_link.title: JarvisBench: Always-on Intelligence Between Humans and Agents

papers.summary: Long-horizon agents can execute continuously, but human attention remains intermittent and scarce. This creates a bidirectional coordination problem: users may need immediate access to an agent while work continues in the background, whereas agents may encounter consequential decisions that require user judgment after the user has stopped monitoring execution. We posit an always-on attention-coordination layer---\textit{Jarvis}\footnote{Named after the fictional AI assistant in \textit{Iron Man}
papers.summary_zh: 長時程代理可持續執行任務，但人類注意力是間歇且稀缺的，形成雙向協調問題：使用者想提問或給予指引時常須中斷執行；代理遇到需人類判斷的關鍵決策時，也無法確定使用者是否在關注，只能自行猜測繼續。現有基準尚未評估這種雙向注意力協調。作者提出 JarvisBench 與一層名為 Jarvis 的常開（always-on）注意力協調中介：它持續供使用者查詢，並在代理工作需要人類判斷時適時引入使用者注意力。基準包含 45 個任務實例（20 個單代理任務與 10 個多代理專案下的 25 條工作流），涵蓋 19 個領域，自 2,000 多個公開候選中挑選改編；關鍵設計是對使用者注意力的需求會在執行過程中自然浮現，而非初始提示刻意留白，且不需修改代理執行迴路即可整合。評估分兩條軌道：代理協作軌道以加權檢查點的任務成果分數與注意力效率，檢驗 Jarvis 能否及時辨識並取得人類判斷以改善成果；使用者互動軌道透過因果重播，評估 Jarvis 回答使用者問題的品質與延遲。實驗顯示，以 GPT-5.6-Sol 擔任 Jarvis 時，所有完成的 worker 設定皆獲改善，單代理任務提升 4.9–24.7 分、多代理任務提升 12.5–28.2 分；其亦以 96.3 分取得最佳使用者互動成績。但增益幅度隨模型組合差異甚大，介入強度與延遲仍是開放問題。此基準將注意力協調與任務執行分離，為持續進步的代理能力提供穩定的評估目標。
papers.title: JarvisBench: Always-on Intelligence Between Humans and Agents
papers.title_zh: JarvisBench：人類與代理之間的常開智慧

links.title: Act2Intention: A Benchmark For Developing Active Mobile Agents Through Inferring User Intention from GUI Actions

evidence: Abstract: SFT yields '+32.0 Acc-S, +10.25 Acc-S, and +6.9 SSR points' over non-fine-tuned counterparts for understanding, prediction, execution; these correspond to Table 7/10 fractional gains (e.g., Acc-S +0.32 avg, Acc-C +10.25 avg, SSR +6.9 avg) once unit conventions are reconciled.

Section 1 & Table 5: benchmark contains 360 personas, 72,511 intentions, 705,366 actions across 52 apps; authors claim first benchmark with continuous 'intention-actions' trajectories (Table 1 compares to AITW, AndroidControl, ProactiveBench).

Section 4.1 footnote 1: raw data from a major smartphone manufacturer, 90 anonymous participants, ethics-board approved; recruitment/withdrawal/compensation details unavailable due to confidentiality.

Section 4.2.3 & Table 4: two-step synthetic filtering via DeepSeek-R1 (persona cosine similarity >= 0.7; trajectory success judged from terminal screenshot) retains 92.63% intentions and 87.03% actions.
Section 4.3 'Human Realism Assessment': 30 segments per subset rated blind by 10 annotators; RR realism 4.19 vs GG 3.55; authors state it is 'a limited sanity check'.
Table 7 (Section 6.2.1): Qwen-2.5-7B-SFT Acc-G 12.14->100.0 and Acc-S 0.24->0.49 on ID test; closed-source models score Acc-G 16-68 and Acc-S <= 0.32.
Table 11 (Section 6.2.5): best end-to-end SR 22.7 (Llama-3.1-8B-SFT + UI-TARS-7B-SFT); with ground-truth intentions SR rises to 47.6, isolating prediction vs execution bottlenecks.
Table 14 (Appendix D.3.1): OOD degradation documented, e.g., Llama-3.1-8B-SFT Acc-G -12.73 and Acc-C -10.65; Gemini-1.5-pro nearly unchanged.
Section 6.1.1: training details - LR 1e-5, cosine schedule, warmup 0.1, batch size 1, 3 epochs, LoRA rank 64 alpha 128, single A100 80GB.

Section 7: acknowledged limitations - no opportune-interruption task, no real-user acceptance studies, 52 apps / 90 participants, emulator-only evaluation, possible stereotypical patterns in LLM-generated data.
Abstract and Section 8: code and benchmark claimed open-sourced at npuNancy/Act2Intention.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM-agent work: a proactive mobile GUI agent benchmark plus a fine-tuned multi-module agent (understanding/prediction/execution), strongly matching the highest-weight preferences (LLMs, Agents & Tool Use) and secondary ones (SFT/LoRA, VLM perception). Novelty is in the task setting and dataset (first continuous mobile 'intention-actions' benchmark per Table 1 comparison) rather than methodology, which reuses persona-conditioned synthesis (Ge et al.), UI-TARS execution, and standard SFT. Rigor is solid: formal task definitions, six evaluation metrics, ablations (action-description quality, with/without understanding module, persona, RR/RG/GG data mix, sequence length), OOD analysis, confidence-fallback, and candid limitations. Deductions for a small evaluation base (test data from 80+10 users of 90 total), a suspiciously perfect ID Acc-G of 100.0 after SFT, LLM-judge (DeepSeek-R1) data validation with only a small 90-sample human sanity check the authors themselves call limited, no significance testing, and abstract metrics (Acc-S in points) that must be re-derived to match Table 7 fractions. Evidence is extensive but partly circular (synthetic data generated and judged by LLMs). Generalizability is moderate: multiple backbones (UI-TARS, GUI-R1, CogAgent) and four open LLMs are tested, but scope is Android, 52 apps, one manufacturer's user pool, emulator-only, with documented OOD degradation (e.g., -12.73 Acc-G for Llama-3.1-8B-SFT in Table 14). Reproducibility is aided by released code/data, hyperparameters (LoRA r=64, alpha=128, LR 1e-5), and appendix prompts, but manufacturer-collected raw logs cannot be independently recreated.

primary_link.title: Act2Intention: A Benchmark For Developing Active Mobile Agents Through Inferring User Intention from GUI Actions

papers.summary: Mobile GUI Agents powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promise in human-computer intelligence. However, current research primarily focuses on reactive task execution while lacking a comprehensive understanding-prediction-execution process for user intentions, which are the core requirements of active agents. In this paper, we propose the Act2Intention framework that builds an active mobile agent by integrating understanding, predicting user intentions, and executing decisions
papers.summary_zh: 行動裝置上的GUI代理多半依賴使用者明確指令，屬於被動執行任務的模式，然而真實情境中使用者常不會主動說出需求。本文提出Act2Intention框架，將主動代理能力拆解為理解、預測、執行三個環節：先從連續GUI動作序列切分並推斷意圖，再結合歷史意圖軌跡、時間與人物誌預測下一個意圖，最後在使用者確認後借助相似經驗軌跡執行任務。作者建構Act2Intention Bench，含360個人物誌、72,511個意圖與超過70萬個動作，橫跨52個應用程式，並以真實軌跡（RR）、真實人物誌生成軌跡（RG）與生成人物誌生成軌跡（GG）三個子集搭配雙重驗證確保品質。實驗顯示，對Qwen-2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B等開源模型進行監督微調後，意圖理解、預測與執行分別獲得約32.0、10.25與6.9個絕對點提升；但端到端成功率仍僅約22.7%，顯示長鏈GUI執行與意圖預測精準度仍是瓶頸。此基準為主動式人機互動研究提供標準化平台，不過涵蓋的應用與受試者規模有限，也未處理何時介入的使用者時機判斷。
papers.title: Act2Intention: A Benchmark For Developing Active Mobile Agents Through Inferring User Intention from GUI Actions
papers.title_zh: Act2Intention：從GUI動作推斷使用者意圖以發展主動行動代理的基準

links.title: When Is an Agent Evaluation Over? Outcome Finality and Cross-Unit Separation

evidence: Section 4.1: 'Each condition uses five matched schedule identifiers, delays of 0, 25, 100, and 250 ms, and ten repetitions of each combination'; 'All trials completed, all 12 implementation checks passed, and no run was excluded'; synchronous write, no-write, and order-reversal controls are specified.

Section 4.2 / Table 2: endpoint and terminal labels disagree in all 150 nonzero-delay trials ('Snapshot scoring records 50 of 200 successes, while reconciliation records 200 of 200'); shared-state exposure occurs in 150 of 200 pairs and 0 of 200 under namespacing, verified reset, and no-write controls.

Section 5 / Table 3 and Appendix A Table A.1-A.2: of ten purposively reviewed protocols, unfinished-operation handling is 'not reported' in six, and separate-scoring evidence is explicit in only three and partial in seven; a cell-level source ledger with cited paper sections is provided, with the caveat 'One reviewer assigned each code' and 'No independent recoding was conducted'.

Section 7 (limitations): 'Our replay uses fixed traces, scheduled delays, a benign local service, and no model API. The public-source review was coded by one reviewer and cannot assess private implementations.'

Appendix C / Table C.1: full field-level specification of the proposed open-effects record (run/task, observation handle, effect status, cross-run scope, verification, analysis disposition); no code, data, or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological/meta-evaluation paper on agent benchmark boundaries that squarely matches the Agents & Tool Use, Red Teaming & Evaluation, and AI Safety preferences (agent misbehavior, tool calling, evaluation protocols), though no LLM is actually run in the experiments. The conceptual contribution — separating outcome finality from cross-unit separation, plus a proposed open-effects record — is a clean and reasonably novel framing that builds on existing audit work (ABC checklist, evidence-supported bounds, computer-use scoring audits). Rigor is good for a conceptual paper: the replay uses fixed traces, matched schedule identifiers, synchronous/no-write/order-reversal controls, 12 implementation checks, and exact counts, and the documentation review uses an explicit coding rubric with a per-protocol source ledger. Evidence is internally valid but only demonstrates the mechanism in one constructed system with a benign local service; the ten-protocol review is a purposive sample coded by a single reviewer and explicitly cannot establish finality or prevalence. The framework is intended to generalize, but empirical generalizability is limited. Reproducibility is moderate: detailed parameters (AgentDojo 0.1.35, delays, seeds, repetitions, Appendix C spec) are given, but no code or artifact release is claimed. Limitations are candidly stated in Section 7.

primary_link.title: When Is an Agent Evaluation Over? Outcome Finality and Cross-Unit Separation

papers.summary: Current agent evaluations score models on the state visible at the end of a stopped run which they count as one trial. However, interpreting the score as a final result would require two conditions that the endpoint does not itself necessarily establish: outcome finality and cross-unit separation. These conditions are independent, since reconciling a delayed outcome can settle the label while runs still share state and isolating runs can prevent carryover while the scored outcome remains unfinis
papers.summary_zh: 代理評估通常在執行停止的端點取狀態打分，並把每次執行當成一個獨立試驗。本文指出此解讀隱含兩個條件：結果終局性，即端點之後的事件無法再改變宣稱的結果；跨單元分離，即先前執行無法改變後續執行的相關條件。兩者可各自獨立成立，端點本身無法保證任何一項。作者提出完成論證框架，要求協議明確宣稱的結果、觀察期間與分析單元，並對未完成操作與共享資源逐一交代。在受控重播實驗中，以固定代理動作與延遲寫入的本地服務驗證：只要延遲非零，端點與終局標籤便全部不一致；共享狀態下，前次執行的延遲寫入會改變下次執行的分數，而命名空間隔離或經驗證的重置能消除此影響。作者亦檢視WebArena、OSWorld、SWE-bench、τ-bench等十個公開協議的文件，發現重置或保留行為多有記載，但未完成操作的處理方式與支撐獨立計分的證據則較少披露。最後提出「開放效果紀錄」，記錄端點後仍可能生效的操作、資源與跨執行路徑。此工作提醒：評估報告必須說明證據支持何種結論，否則分數的獨立試驗解讀不成立。
papers.title: When Is an Agent Evaluation Over? Outcome Finality and Cross-Unit Separation
papers.title_zh: 代理評估何時才算結束？結果終局性與跨單元分離

links.title: Detecting Contaminated Code-Generation Prompt Batches via Influence Functions

evidence: Abstract: 'achieving AUROC scores of up to 0.98 at moderate-to-high injection rates, while maintaining well-calibrated false positive rates and substantially outperforming static analysis baselines'

Section 4 / Algorithm 1: CodeSIFT runs 'Welch's one-sided, two-sample t-test' between influence scores of candidate set D and benign reference D*; rejection of H0 at significance α yields the malicious verdict

Section 5 (Dataset Construction/Provenance): 'We authored all 800 records manually'; 'We validated the malicious pool by generating completions with several code models and confirming that the targeted weakness appears in the generated output' — no quantitative validation rates reported

Section 6.3 (Baselines): 'To the best of our knowledge, no established tool targets the threat detection problem studied in this work, so two baselines are repurposed general-purpose linters and the third we implement ourselves'

Section 6.5 (Results): 'AUROC already exceeds 0.6 to 0.85 at the lowest injection rate... and saturates to essentially 1.0 once roughly 40 to 50 percent of the candidate set is malicious'; baselines 'frequently fall below 0.5 AUROC'

Section 7 (Discussion): 'Our evaluation spans models up to 7B parameters, consistent with the compute budget for this study'; 'extending the benchmark beyond Python and the vulnerability families studied here would help establish the generality'
Appendix C (Table 2): ε=1e-3, N=25 samples per prompt, K-FAC damping 0.1, damping floors 1e-3/1e-2, α=0.01
Section 6.4 (Compute): 'single node with four NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs (48GB each...)' — no code or dataset availability statement appears anywhere in the paper
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference match: a methodology paper on LLM code-generation safety (LLMs w2.5, Code w2.0, AI Safety w2.0) rather than a pure domain application, so it is in scope. Novelty is solid but not high: using influence-function magnitude as an aggregate detection statistic is a new twist on Koh & Liang / Grosse et al., yet gradient/activation-based malicious-prompt detectors (GradSafe, PiShield, cited in Section 1/2) already occupy adjacent ground. Rigor is above average — formal derivation with proof (Appendix A), matched-domain dataset design to block topic shortcuts (Section 5), FPR-vs-nominal-α calibration (Section 6.5), and extensive sweeps (Appendix D) — but two weaknesses hold it back: baselines are admittedly repurposed linters (Section 6.3) with no cheap stronger baselines like perplexity, embedding-distance, or adapted GradSafe; and no adaptive/stealthy-prompt ablation rules out the confound that the influence signal detects stylistic distribution shift between author-written pools rather than misalignment induction. Evidence is internally consistent (AUROC up to 0.98, calibration tracking α) but rests entirely on a self-built 800-record benchmark whose malicious-pool validation is only qualitative (Section 5 Provenance, no per-record success rates). Generalizability is limited to Python, batch-level detection, and ≤7B models (Section 7 admits this). Reproducibility is middling: full hyperparameters (Appendix C) and compute setup (Section 6.4) are given, but no code or dataset release is stated anywhere in the document.

primary_link.title: Detecting Contaminated Code-Generation Prompt Batches via Influence Functions

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, yet they remain vulnerable to prompts that elicit insecure implementations. Existing defenses typically rely on predefined threat models or known vulnerability patterns, limiting their effectiveness against novel attacks. We propose CodeSIFT, a threat-model-agnostic detection method that leverages influence functions to identify batches of prompts that induce anomalous model behavior. Rather than detecting specific vulnerabi
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型生成的程式碼常含安全弱點，而現有防禦多依賴已知弱點模式或靜態規則，難以應對新型攻擊。本文提出CodeSIFT，一種不預設威脅模型的批次偵測方法：以影響函數衡量各提示所引發生成結果在參數空間的影響力，其直覺是誘發失準行為的回應需要模型偏離良性訓練分布才能容納，因而產生較大的參數位移。實作上以簡化的K-FAC近似反Hessian向量積，僅保留單側Kronecker因子以降低計算與記憶體成本，並對候選提示集與良性參考集的影響分數進行Welch單尾t檢定，拒絕虛無假設即判定批次受污染。作者自建兩個各200條的資料集AuthSec（認證授權）與InfraCloud（基礎設施），搭配400條良性提示，並在Granite-3B、DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B與Qwen2.5-Coder-7B三個開源模型上評估。結果顯示中度以上污染率時AUROC最高達0.98，假陽性率與顯著水準校準良好；Bandit、Semgrep與AST污點追蹤等靜態基線則跨模型表現不一致，甚至與真實標籤反相關。限制包括僅涵蓋Python與批次層級偵測，尚無法定位批次內的單一惡意提示。
papers.title: Detecting Contaminated Code-Generation Prompt Batches via Influence Functions
papers.title_zh: CodeSIFT：以影響函數偵測受污染的程式碼生成提示批次

links.title: When Personal Memory Has No Single Answer: Evaluating LLM Agents under Irreducible Conflict

evidence: Abstract: 'TANGLE comprises 541 instances that span 40 diverse personas and three conflict types: Context-Partitioned Conflict (CPC), Behavior-Oscillation Conflict (BOC), and Source-Contradiction Conflict (SCC)' with oracle and pipeline tracks.

§4.1: 'GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.7 independently score each response on D1–D5... Pearson r=0.838; Spearman ρ=0.820' over 2,705 shared responses; human annotators agree within one point on 85.8% of dimension scores on a 556-record reference set.

§4.2: 'the strongest model remains below 15/20 under both Judges'; D4 (clarification seeking) is 'the lowest-scoring dimension for every response model'; BOC hardest (10.81/10.14), CPC easiest (14.79/14.96).

§4.3: 'Letta preserves the complete target conflict in 91.7% of cases, compared with 69.1% for Mem0, 47.0% for A-mem, and 46.2% for MemOS'; conditional D1/D2 gaps small under FULL retrieval, indicating extraction is the bottleneck.
§4.4: paired 60-instance distractor ablation, N∈{0,2,4,6}; total declines 13.26→12.63 (GPT-5.4) and 13.35→12.48 (Opus) with paired bootstrap intervals excluding zero.

§4.5: CAAP defined as two-stage policy with action space {commit, conditionalize, clarify, verify, defer, reversible_trial}; matched comparison on Sonnet 5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-4o described qualitatively ('the magnitude and composition of its benefit depend on how reliably each response backbone realizes the selected action').

§3.3: instances synthesized from Persona Hub seeds with 'non-leakage' and 'pattern balancing' constraints; dialogues verbalized from curated memories for the pipeline track — no external real-user data.

Reproducibility gaps: multiple references render as incomplete ('Full generation algorithm and prompts are in Appendix' with no marker) and no statement of public code or data release appears in the provided text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Clearly in-scope LLM-agent research: a benchmark (TANGLE, 541 instances, 40 personas) for evaluating how LLM agents handle genuinely unresolvable conflicts in persistent personal memory, evaluated across five response models (Claude Sonnet 5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM-4.7, GPT-4o) and four memory systems (Letta, Mem0, A-mem, MemOS). Strong preference alignment with agents/memory/evaluation/LLM preferences. Novelty is solid but not exceptional: the underdetermination framing (multiple valid responses vs single-answer conflict recovery in Table 1) is a genuine gap, yet memory-conflict benchmarks are crowded and CAAP is a modest two-stage prompt policy. Rigor is decent: dual LLM judges (Pearson r=0.838 across 2,705 responses), a 556-record human agreement study (85.8% within one point, §4.1), distractor-load ablations with paired bootstrap (§4.4), and oracle/pipeline tracks separating extraction from reasoning (§4.3: FULL-observability 91.7% Letta vs 46.2% MemOS). Weaknesses: fully synthetic data derived from Persona Hub, judge-family overlap with evaluated models (Opus judging Sonnet), moderate instance count, and key results deferred to figures. No explicit code/data release statement and truncated appendix references limit reproducibility.

primary_link.title: When Personal Memory Has No Single Answer: Evaluating LLM Agents under Irreducible Conflict

papers.summary: LLM agents increasingly maintain personal memory across sessions, but it can conflict. Preferences depend on context, behavior evolves, and sources can conflict. When a query lacks context, time, or source authority to interpret conflict, treating one memory as definitive converts unresolved conflict into an unjustified, overconfident action. Existing benchmarks recover one answer from conflicting evidence, overlooking whether agents recognize underdetermination, preserve alternatives, seek miss
papers.summary_zh: LLM代理逐漸跨對話維持個人記憶，但記憶未必一致：偏好隨情境改變、行為隨時間擺盪、不同來源可能互相矛盾。當查詢未指明情境、時間或來源權威時，把任一記憶當成定論會導致過度自信的行動。既有基準多以「單一可還原答案」為設計，忽視代理是否認知不確定性並保留替代選項。本文提出TANGLE基準，含541個實例、40個人物誌與三類衝突：情境分割衝突（CPC）、行為擺盪衝突（BOC）與來源矛盾衝突（SCC），並設oracle與pipeline兩條軌道以分離衝突推論與記憶抽取。評估涵蓋衝突感知、因果推論、信心校準、澄清提問與記憶忠實度五個維度。實驗發現：即使擁有完整策展記憶，模型「辨識衝突」仍優於「校準行動與針對性提問」，澄清提問是共同瓶頸；端到端管線中，記憶抽取常遺漏承載衝突的關聯，成為上游瓶頸，Letta的完整保留率91.7%明顯高於其他系統；固定解析規則如最近優先、多數決對不可解衝突並不足夠。作者據此提出衝突感知行動策略CAAP，依可見證據選擇行動。此工作將記憶衝突處理從「找出單一答案」轉向「認知欠定並保留張力」的可靠性問題。
papers.title: When Personal Memory Has No Single Answer: Evaluating LLM Agents under Irreducible Conflict
papers.title_zh: 當個人記憶沒有單一答案：在不可約衝突下評估LLM代理

links.title: Finding Vulnerabilities via LLM-Augmented Semantics-Aware Type-Checking

evidence: Abstract: 'achieves 87% detection precision and 88% detection accuracy' and 'identified 15 potential zero-day vulnerabilities, nine of which were confirmed by developers.'

Section VI-B, Table II: PySeType reports 0.87 precision/recall/accuracy/F1 versus CodeQL (0.67/0.39/0.83/0.49), Bandit (0.75/0.84/0.70/0.79), and Vulnhuntr (0.52/0.45/0.53/0.48) on SVEN (160 program versions).
Section VI-B, Table III: on 9 recent post-cutoff CVEs, performance drops to 0.78 precision/recall and 0.71 accuracy, explicitly used to address LLM training-data memorization concerns.

Section V: implementation uses a single backend 'Qwen3 32B model... via the Ollama API, with top_p=0.3'; no model ablation, prompt ablation, or repeated-run variance analysis appears anywhere in the paper.

Section VI-E: on 103 popular projects, 'PySeType reports 33 findings across these projects, of which 15 we confirmed as true vulnerabilities,' indicating a substantially higher false-positive rate on larger codebases than in dataset evaluations.

Appendix A: the functions inf, op, and unify 'are not formally defined. Indeed, these functions are implemented using LLMs,' so SeType is a fuzzy, non-deterministic check rather than a sound formal type system (also conceded in Section I as 'a fuzzy (non-deterministic) check').
Section VII (Limitations): Python 3.10 only, restricted language constructs/libraries, heuristic cross-language handling, and a limited CWE set bound generalizability.
Section VI-E: states 'Details of the disclosure process are provided in the ethics section,' but no ethics section is present in the supplied complete document.
Section VI-C, Table IV: PySeType averages 1470.52s and 10.28 US cents per SVEN project versus CodeQL 14.92s, quantifying the cost overhead of LLM-based analysis.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is an LLM-augmented static analyzer (Qwen3-32B backend performing natural-language 'semantic type' inference/checking over a pytype-derived CFG), squarely matching LLM, code/programming, prompting, and (partially) AI-safety/security preferences; it is a strong LLM application rather than an LLM methodology advance. Novelty is solid: framing vulnerability detection as bidirectional semantic type checking grounded in deterministic traversal is a fresh angle versus prior LLM-rule-generation (IRIS) or direct-LLM tools (Vulnhuntr), though the hybrid LLM+static-analysis pattern itself is established. Rigor is decent (three baselines, SVEN 160 program versions, a post-cutoff CVE memorization control, cost/time measurements) but weakened by a single LLM backend, no ablations (e.g., checklist strategy, prompt sensitivity), no repeated-run variance analysis despite acknowledged LLM stochasticity, a small 9-CVE validation set, and subjective manual finding inspection. Evidence is strong: consistent quantitative tables, concrete case studies, and 9 developer-confirmed zero-days provide external validation, though Section VI-E cites an 'ethics section' that is absent from the document, and the formalization in Appendix A admits inf/op/unify are not formally defined, making the 'type system' a fuzzy check. Generalizability is bounded to Python 3.10, three web frameworks, and 12 CWEs. No code-release claim is made, limiting reproducibility despite published prompts, versions, and dataset construction details.

primary_link.title: Finding Vulnerabilities via LLM-Augmented Semantics-Aware Type-Checking

papers.summary:
Vulnerability detection via static analysis traditionally relies on security experts encoding insecure coding patterns into algorithmic rules. However, this approach often focuses on syntactic patterns and overlooks deeper semantic information in the code, such as the meanings of variable and function names. As software systems grow more complex, modeling vulnerabilities using only syntactic rules becomes increasingly challenging.
  In this paper, we propose a semantics-aware approach to detecti
papers.summary_zh: 傳統靜態分析靠安全專家把不安全程式碼模式編成語法規則，難以捕捉變數與函式名稱等深層語意，例如CodeQL近五百條規則在實務上仍漏掉大量弱點。本文提出語意感知型別系統SeType：為每個變數與運算式指派以自然語言描述的「語意型別」，型別推論與檢查皆由LLM完成，型別不符即代表潛在漏洞。實作PySeType以pytype為基礎，沿控制流程圖模擬執行，在各語意關鍵指令處以約200 token的小提示查詢Qwen3 32B更新語意型別，並以檢查清單策略對照CWE規則（如路徑穿越、SQL注入、XSS）進行檢查。在SVEN真實漏洞資料集上達87%精確率與88%準確率，優於CodeQL、Bandit與Vulnhuntr；在LLM知識截止後的近期CVE上亦保持表現，顯示並非記憶訓練資料所致。實際部署於103個熱門開源專案，發現15個零時差漏洞，其中9個獲開發者確認；最大專案分析約14小時、成本約3.19美元，具實用擴展性。限制包括靜態不可達程式碼、LLM幻覺造成的漏報與誤報，以及目前僅支援Python 3.10與有限的CWE類別。
papers.title: Finding Vulnerabilities via LLM-Augmented Semantics-Aware Type-Checking
papers.title_zh: 以LLM增強的語意感知型別檢查找出漏洞

links.title: Agentic Transaction: Towards ACID-Compliant Agent Systems

evidence: Abstract: claims 'a 10.6% improvement over state-of-the-art agents, including Claude Code'
Section 3.1: KramaBench with 104 tasks; ACID-Agent uses local Qwen3-0.6B for confidence estimation; retry/divergence thresholds 0.45, 0.25, 0.50 specified
Table 2: ACID-Agent 74.6 vs Claude Code 64.0 on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B; 77.4 vs 74.2 on GLM-5.2; cost rises 0.12→0.61 ($)
Section 3.2 text: refers to 'Qwen3.5-197B-A17B' inconsistently with 397B elsewhere
Table 3: consistency only on Environment domain, three runs; Claude Code 63.9±30.9 vs ACID-Agent 88.9±18.6
Table 4: ablation — No-Isolation 78.3 vs full ACID-Agent 90.0; DA-Agent 65.2 as ACID-removed variant
Sections 2.2.1/2.2.2: skill hubs and consistency-oriented benchmarks described as envisioned rather than fully implemented
Section 2 Contributions: source code claimed at github.com/TsinghuaDatabaseGroup/ACID-Agent
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-topic paper: an ACID-inspired reliability framework for LLM agent harnesses (semantic atomicity/consistency/isolation/durability) with commit-or-retry execution, confidence-divergence validation, versioned workspaces, and transaction-aware memory — directly matching Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences. The transactional framing is a fresh systems contribution, though adjacent prior work (SagaLLM, Atomix) exists and much of the design is aspirational ('We envision' in Sections 2.2.1-2.2.2). Empirical support is real but preliminary: single benchmark (KramaBench, 104 tasks, Section 3.1), two backbones, consistency measured on only one domain across three runs with very high variance (Table 3), the headline 10.6% claim is an absolute-point gap (74.6 vs 64.0, Table 2) with a much smaller margin on GLM (77.4 vs 74.2) and ~3-5x cost/token overhead, and internal inconsistencies (Qwen3.5-397B vs '197B' in Section 3.2; abstract overstates 'including Claude Code'). Ablations (Table 4) are informative (No-Isolation -11.7; beats 3-majority Claude Code with fewer tokens). Hyperparameters and code URL (Section 2, Contributions) aid reproduction, but API-only backbones and unverified repo limit it.

primary_link.title: Agentic Transaction: Towards ACID-Compliant Agent Systems

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from conversational assistants into autonomous systems that execute long-horizon tasks through reasoning, tool use, code generation, and workspace manipulation. As agents increasingly operate over persistent environments and multi-step workflows, they face challenges analogous to those addressed by transactional database systems: reliable execution, consistent outcomes, safe concurrency, and durable state management. We introduce the concept of an a
papers.summary_zh: LLM代理正從對話助手演變為執行長程任務的自主系統，面臨與資料庫交易相似的挑戰：可靠執行、一致結果、安全併發與持久狀態。本文提出「代理交易」概念，將古典ACID性質重新詮釋為語意原子性、語意一致性、語意隔離與語意持久性：原子性要求探索—執行—驗證循環以「提交或重試」語意運作，僅驗證無誤的效果才可見；一致性整合執行錯誤、決策與程式碼的信心分歧及LLM反思回饋，觸發證據導向重試；隔離性以依賴感知策略、隔離環境與版本化工作區，防止失敗步驟污染共享狀態；持久性則透過交易感知記憶與僅追加工作區支援復原與長程推論。作者實作ACID資料代理，在KramaBench上以Qwen3.5-397B-A17B等模型評估，整體分數較Claude Code高出10.6個百分點，且多次執行的任務分數變異更低；消融實驗顯示移除失敗步驟隔離會使分數下降11.7%，而以更少token超越多數投票版Claude Code，證明增益來自ACID式框架設計而非推論預算。此工作為可靠、可擴展且自我演化的代理系統奠定交易式架構基礎。
papers.title: Agentic Transaction: Towards ACID-Compliant Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: 代理交易：邁向符合ACID的代理系統

links.title: Small Models Scout Bottleneck Order for Large-Model Data Control

evidence: Abstract: LogFloor reduces token cost by 56.2% on average across five bAbI skill slices on Qwen2.5-1.5B; 70M-to-12B replay saves 30.9% by pair mean, 39.4% pooled, 37.6% scout-inclusive.

Section 'First-Passage Efficiency' / Table 2: LogFloor hits 30/30 route targets with 95% Clopper-Pearson interval [88.4%, 100%]; Skill-It (-7.8%) and ODM (-0.9%) pooled savings are negative, with controller hyperparameters fixed in advance.
Section '70M-to-12B Transfer' / Table 3: target-probe replay 8/8 hits, 7/8 wins, paired bootstrap 95% interval [4.6%, 50.9%] for pair-mean saving; frozen target-mix control reaches only 7/8.
Section 'Order and retained information' / Table 6: static collapse retains 10.3% and reversal 6.0% pooled savings vs 60.3% for the correct ordered path, isolating order as the transferred signal.
Section 'Limitations': replay from Qwen to Mamba transfers well but Mamba to Qwen gives mixed results; controller treats skills separately without modeling interference.

Section 'Robustness and Scope' / Table 8: 72B evidence is a single-seed pilot; gains are weak at earliest pretraining checkpoints (positive only from step 16K onward), and scope is explicitly limited to monitored first-passage training.
Reproducibility: Algorithm 1 and Eqs. (1)-(9) are given with H-sensitivity (H in {1,3,5}) in a referenced Supplementary Document, but no code or artifact release is stated anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM pre-training methodology paper on small-proxy-guided data control, matching the LLM and training/scaling preferences, though it does not touch the highest-weighted Japanese/agent/reasoning topics. The first-passage skill objective and the demonstration that bottleneck ORDER (not just static mixture) transfers 70M-to-12B is a genuine contribution beyond DoReMi/RegMix/Skill-It/ODM/RegMix-D. Rigor is strong: matched uniform baselines, 5 seeds per floor, Clopper-Pearson intervals, paired bootstrap, heldout audits, scout-cost accounting, and order-destruction controls. Evidence is weakened by reliance on synthetic bAbI slices for headline numbers, a single-seed 72B pilot, mixed cross-architecture transfer (Mamba-to-Qwen), and key details deferred to an unverifiable supplementary; no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Small Models Scout Bottleneck Order for Large-Model Data Control

papers.summary: Small proxy models are commonly used to identify data mixtures for larger-scale training. We ask whether their training trajectories reveal another transferable structure: the order in which larger models should resolve skill bottlenecks. We formulate first-passage skill training, where each monitored skill has a target floor and the objective is to minimize the tokens required to reach all floors. We introduce LogFloor, a closed-loop controller that directs each round toward current bottlenecks
papers.summary_zh: 小代理模型常被用來為大型訓練挑選資料混合，本文追問其訓練軌跡是否還蘊含另一種可遷移結構：大模型應以何種順序解決技能瓶頸。作者提出「首次通過技能訓練」目標：每個受監控技能設有目標地板，訓練須持續到所有技能達標，並以消耗token數最小化為宗旨；在此目標下，對已達標技能平均投注資源是浪費。所提LogFloor控制器觀察各技能監控分數、計算地板壓力，把下一輪最大配額分配給當前瓶頸技能，形成「瓶頸解析軌跡」。在Qwen2.5-1.5B的五個bAbI技能切片上，LogFloor平均節省56.2%訓練token，且30條路線全數達標。跨規模實驗中，70M模型探勘的軌跡經三輪目標探針定位後回放至12B目標，八個目標全數命中，成對平均節省30.9%、合併計算節省39.4%，計入探勘成本後仍省37.6%；在MMLU控制設定下，凍結的70M路徑亦全數命中並省60.3%合併輪次。消融顯示將軌跡壓成靜態混合或反轉順序會失去大部分效益，僅保留瓶頸標籤序列仍有部分效用，證明可遷移的是階段有序的瓶頸解析而非靜態混合。限制為跨架構回放不保證成立，且控制器未建模技能間遷移與干擾。
papers.title: Small Models Scout Bottleneck Order for Large-Model Data Control
papers.title_zh: 小模型為大模型的資料控制探查瓶頸順序

links.title: From Positionwise Confidence to Prefix Scheduling: Verifier Skipping in Speculative Decoding

evidence: Abstract: 'all three confidence signals save 9.6% to 13.5% of verifier calls at the same observed pass@1 as Strict SDD' with DiffuCoder-7B-Instruct and Qwen3-32B on HumanEval.

Section 5.2: 'Strict SDD obtains 0.9085 pass@1. At observed points with the same aggregate pass@1, raw confidence, conditional survival, and marginal survival reduce verifier calls by 13.5%, 12.5%, and 9.6%, respectively.'

Section 5.3, Table 1: permutation diagnostic drops mean feasible prefix length from 8.75 to 1.59 (raw confidence) and 8.76 to 2.11 (conditional survival) while positionwise BCE/AUROC are unchanged by construction, supporting H1.
Section 5.3 (H2): K_min=0 lowers relative verifier calls to 0.788 but reaches only 52.83 tokens/s versus 58.54 at K_min=6, showing fewer calls do not imply higher throughput.
Section 5.1: five-fold HumanEval partition with rotated test folds; 'All main runs use two NVIDIA A100 80 GB GPUs.'
Limitations: 'The main experiments use one drafter and verifier pair on HumanEval under greedy decoding' and 'Each prompt and setting is timed once.'
Appendix A.5: transfer to MBPP+ and MATH with Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct; 95% bootstrap intervals for pass@1 differences all include zero.
Appendix A.6/A.7: full threshold grids, MLP architecture 3603-256-256-256-1, Adam lr 1e-3, seeds 0/12345 disclosed; no code or artifact availability statement appears in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM inference-efficiency work: verifier skipping for speculative diffusion decoding with a Qwen3-32B verifier and DiffuCoder drafter, evaluated on code benchmarks. It aligns with LLM, Inference & Serving, Scaling & Efficiency, and secondarily Code preferences, but not the higher-weighted reasoning/agent/alignment clusters. The contribution is genuinely new framing (whether to invoke the verifier at all, as prefix scheduling) though related to confidence-routed inference (BiLD, SPRINTER, S2D2), making it incremental-plus. Rigor is solid: five-fold protocol, shadow verifier, gate/K_min ablations, a permutation diagnostic, a proven proposition, periodic-skip and lenience/top-k baselines, and honest hedged claims. Evidence is concrete but bounded: 9.6-13.5% verifier-call reduction at matched pass@1 (Abstract, Sec 5.2), single benchmark in main results, one seed/timing per setting, and matched pass@1 on 164 problems explicitly not treated as statistical equivalence (Limitations). Generalizability is limited to one drafter-verifier pair with a small appendix transfer (A.5). Reproducibility is good via exhaustive hyperparameter grids, seeds, and timing protocol (A.6-A.8), but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: From Positionwise Confidence to Prefix Scheduling: Verifier Skipping in Speculative Decoding

papers.summary: Speculative decoding is a leading technique to reduce the cost of autoregressive generation by using a small drafter to propose several tokens, which are then verified in parallel by a larger target model. Speculative diffusion decoding (SDD) further removes sequential drafting by generating every position in a draft block in parallel with a discrete diffusion model. However, SDD still invokes the target on every block, leaving verification as a potential bottleneck. This paper recognizes that t
papers.summary_zh: 投機解碼以小起草者提出候選token，再由大目標模型平行驗證；投機擴散解碼（SDD）更以擴散模型平行生成整個草稿區塊，但每個區塊仍須呼叫目標模型驗證，成為新的瓶頸。本文提出「驗證器跳過」這個有損控制軸：依起草者端信心直接提交連續前綴而不呼叫驗證器，並將其形式化為前綴排程問題。作者在相同策略下比較三種信心訊號：原始信心、習得的邊際存活分數與條件存活分數，以Strict SDD、寬鬆接受與top-k接受為基線，在HumanEval上以DiffuCoder-7B-Instruct搭配Qwen3-32B評估。結果顯示三種訊號皆能在與Strict SDD相同的pass@1下省下9.6%至13.5%的驗證器呼叫，其中原始信心省最多。有趣的是，習得訊號在多數位置的逐位置AUROC雖較高，線上卻未勝出：跳過需要連續的高信心前綴，置換診斷證明逐位置指標無法捕捉此相依結構；且短跳過會增加起草輪次，故最少跳過長度設為6時吞吐量最佳，支援「呼叫更少不代表更快」的假設。此研究確立前綴排程而非單純token預測，才是驗證器跳過的核心挑戰。
papers.title: From Positionwise Confidence to Prefix Scheduling: Verifier Skipping in Speculative Decoding
papers.title_zh: 從逐位置信心到前綴排程：投機解碼中的驗證器跳過

links.title: MMDynOpt-Agent: Dynamic Optimization for Multimodal Large Language Model Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Abstract: 'MMDynOpt-Agent is transferable and generalizable, enabling training with one target MLLM and inference-time transfer to others' with GitHub link in footnote 1.
Section 4.2, Eqs. 14-21: Prism Reward with hierarchical gating and GRPO with token attribution mask; hyperparameters given in Appendix G (lambda_b=0.1, eta=0.8, T=5, G=4).
Table 4 (Section 5.5): removing RL drops OmniMed EM from 84.64 to 8.59; 'w/o Agent' row equals the direct-inference baseline.

Appendix J (Budget-Matched Comparison, Table 8): Self-Consistency at N=2 costs 2276.2 tokens/sample with EM 49.74 vs Ours 2773.1 tokens and EM 59.48, arguing the advantage is not budget-driven; accounting is target-MLLM-side only.

Appendix A.1 (Eq. 27): Proposition 1's proof explicitly assumes the dynamic optimization operator satisfies a Lipschitz contraction (kappa<1) and correctness preservation, i.e., convergence is assumed rather than proven.
Appendix D: only 1,280 training and 128 evaluation instances sampled per dataset; Table 2 shows high-variance gains (MedX EM 43.75±13.35, MARS up to ±22.04/±40.02).
Section 5.4 (Figures 4-5) and Appendix B.4: zero-shot transfer to four unseen MLLMs (InternVL3.5, Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, Gemma-3, Nemotron) with consistent improvements, supporting generalizability.
Appendix M: training cost of ~687 GPU-hours on 8x H100 for 90 steps, 46,080 trajectories, disclosed for reproducibility.

Reference 'Liu et al., 2025a, Prompt-R1: collaborative automatic prompting framework via end-to-end reinforcement learning' indicates the framework is a multimodal extension of the same group's prior text-only method, limiting novelty.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an RL-trained lightweight agent (GRPO) that dynamically optimizes multi-turn prompts for a frozen MLLM, hitting LLM, Agents & Tool Use, Reasoning/CoT, Prompting, Multimodal AI, and RL preferences; it is a language-methodology paper evaluated on multimodal benchmarks, not a pure CV/medical-imaging application, so no scope cap applies. Novelty is moderate: it closely extends the authors' text-only Prompt-R1 (cited as Liu et al., 2025a) to multimodal inputs, and the components (GRPO, multi-turn prompting, budget reward, hierarchical gating) are individually known. Empirical rigor is broad (15 datasets, 3 runs with mean/std, ablations, budget-matched comparison in Appendix J, image-removal and length-robustness analyses) but weakened by very small evaluation sets (128 instances per dataset, Appendix D), occasionally marginal or high-variance gains (e.g., MedX EM 43.75±13.35; FinC 57.81±0.78 vs 57.29±0.45), and target-MLLM-only token accounting in Table 5. The appendix 'theoretical proofs' are largely vacuous: Proposition 1's proof assumes the optimization operator is a contraction with correctness-preserving fixed point (Appendix A.1, Eq. 27), assuming away the core question. Evidence for the core claims (ablation drop of OmniMed EM 84.64→8.59 without RL; budget-matched gap persistence; transfer to four unseen MLLMs) is solid and unusually self-critical. Reproducibility is good: public GitHub link, full hyperparameters (Appendix G), and compute cost (687 GPU-hours, Appendix M).

primary_link.title: MMDynOpt-Agent: Dynamic Optimization for Multimodal Large Language Model Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning

papers.summary: Recently, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong potential in visual understanding and complex reasoning tasks. However, existing methods often struggle to efficiently transform visual cues from multimodal inputs and the semantics of the question into effective reasoning conditions, thereby limiting the reasoning performance of multimodal large language models. To address this challenge, we propose MMDynOpt-Agent, which models the dynamic optimization of multimodal rea
papers.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型在複雜推理上潛力可觀,但靜態提示難以因應異質的視覺輸入,多輪互動亦使品質與成本難以兼顧。本文提出 MMDynOpt-Agent,將多模態推理的動態最佳化建模為馬可夫決策過程,以端對端強化學習訓練:一個輕量多模態代理作為決策策略,把目標 MLLM 視為環境,透過多輪動態最佳化提示導引其推理。作者設計 Prism Reward,結合格式遵循、答案正確性與預算意識,以階層閘控讓代理在保證品質下自適應控制回合數與 token 用量,並以 GRPO 進行策略最佳化。在涵蓋醫療、金融與一般科學的十五個資料集上,該方法整體表現超越 SFT、GRPO、CoT、OPRO、GEPA、ToT、MARS 等基線;平均每樣本僅耗約 2.8K tokens,遠低於 ToT 的 41 萬 tokens。已訓練代理可零樣本遷移至四個未見 MLLM,在分布外資料集亦維持優勢;消融實驗驗證強化學習、代理與 Prism Reward 各自不可或缺。限制包括需多輪互動、成效受限於目標模型自身能力,以及依賴統一互動介面。此研究展示以外部輕量策略動態導引凍結大型模型的可行路徑,對成本感知的多模態推理部署深具參考價值。
papers.title: MMDynOpt-Agent: Dynamic Optimization for Multimodal Large Language Model Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: MMDynOpt-Agent:以強化學習實現多模態大型語言模型推理的動態最佳化

links.title: Retrieval Grounding Latent Reasoning for Dense Retrieval

evidence: Abstract: RGLT 'performs non-autoregressive reasoning in hidden space through an instruction-conditioned latent reasoning trajectory constructed from silent tokens' combining CoT distillation with retrieval-grounded supervision.

Section 3.4, Eqs. 10-13: defines retrieval-effect credit via normalized local document distributions with stop-gradient baselines, transferring stage-specific ranking gains from explicit CoT to latent transitions.
Section 4.2 (Table 1): RGLT (Qwen3-8B) reaches 34.20 nDCG@10 / 39.97 R@10 on BRIGHT vs LaSER 29.90/34.27 and Fair Baseline 25.70/30.45; claimed relative gains of 14.4%/16.6% match the table values.
Section 4.2 (Figure 4): RGLT outperforms LaSER on 9 of 12 BRIGHT domains; LaSER remains better on biology, earth science, and StackOverflow, indicating non-uniform gains.

Section 4.3 (Table 2): ablations - removing stage retrieval-effect matching drops nDCG@10 to 31.26; replacing effect matching with state alignment gives 30.64; naive terminal-ST readout gives 30.87 vs full 34.20.
Section 4.4 (Table 3): stage terminals progress 26.39 (base) to 32.25/32.48/33.56/34.20 (ST4-ST16), supporting progressive latent representation improvement.
Section 4.5 (Table 4): RGLT query latency 24.0 ms/query (1.12x base) vs Rewrite-then-Retrieve 4000 ms (186x) and LaSER 32.5 ms (1.51x), measured on 80 queries, batch size 8, one A100.
Section 4.1: results averaged over three independent runs; trained on 81,659 ReasonEmbed instances with Qwen3-8B, LoRA rank 32, 32x A100; no statistical significance tests or variance reported.
Appendix B (Table 5) and Appendix C: full training configuration, deterministic gradient replay, and KV-cache reuse protocol are documented, but the paper states no code or artifact release.

Section 4.1: evaluation covers BRIGHT, FollowIR (Robust04/News21/Core17), and BrowseComp-Plus; FollowIR/BrowseComp-Plus improvements over GIRCSE are small (e.g., R@5 13.42 vs 13.00) and Table 1 formatting makes per-column values difficult to verify.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: latent chain-of-thought reasoning internalized into a Qwen3-8B embedding model for reasoning-intensive dense retrieval, directly hitting high-weight preferences (Reasoning/CoT, LLMs, RAG & Knowledge via dense retrieval/grounding/embedding). The core novelty is stage-level retrieval-effect credit assignment transferring ranking gains from explicit CoT stages to latent transitions, a meaningful but incremental delta over LaSER's state alignment on a very recent line of work (Coconut/CODI-style silent tokens plus distillation). Rigor is solid: a fair contrastive baseline trained on the same 81,659 ReasonEmbed instances and backbone, component and architecture ablations, stage-evolution analysis, and latency measurement. Evidence is strongest on BRIGHT (34.20 nDCG@10 vs LaSER 29.90; gains on 9/12 domains), but FollowIR and BrowseComp-Plus gains are marginal and the result table formatting obscures verification; no variance or significance testing is reported despite three-run averaging, and one FollowIR subtask (Core17) regresses. Generalizability is limited by a single backbone and benchmark family skewed to reasoning retrieval. Reproducibility benefits from unusually detailed configs (Table 5, gradient replay, KV-cache protocol), but no code or model release is stated. Not a pure domain application; clearly within language-methodology scope.

primary_link.title: Retrieval Grounding Latent Reasoning for Dense Retrieval

papers.summary: Reasoning-intensive retrieval requires text representations to capture not only semantic similarity, but also the reasoning needed to determine relevance under a given retrieval instruction. Existing reasoning-enhanced embedding models improve retrieval by incorporating reasoning information into dense representations, yet their supervision is typically dominated by the final retrieval objective. As a result, latent reasoning trajectories may learn shortcut reasoning patterns that preserve retri
papers.summary_zh: 推理密集型檢索要求查詢向量不僅捕捉語意相似度,還需蘊含判斷相關性所需的推理。現有推理增強式嵌入模型多以最終檢索目標監督潛在推理軌跡,中間轉移可能學到捷徑模式,未能真正帶來檢索增益。本文提出 RGLT,在隱空間以非自迴歸方式進行潛在推理:於查詢後附加固定數量的靜默 token 形成有序潛在軌跡,並以檢索意圖錨點依查詢與檢索指令注入指引。訓練結合兩類監督:一是過程監督的顯式到隱式蒸餾,以階段式 CoT 重建塑造中間潛在狀態;二是檢索效應信用分配,計算各顯式 CoT 階段對相關文件相對難負樣本的排序增益,並傳遞至對應潛在轉移。以 Qwen3-8B 為骨幹,於 BRIGHT 達 34.20 nDCG@10,較 LaSER 提升 14.4%,於 FollowIR 與 BrowseComp-Plus 亦領先;查詢端延遲僅為基礎檢索器的 1.12 倍,遠低於顯式 CoT 生成的 186 倍。分析顯示檢索效用沿潛在階段逐步累積,且效應匹配優於狀態對齊。限制在於潛在預算 K 過大時最佳化變難,K=16 為本設定最佳。此工作確立「中間推理須對檢索增益負責」的設計原則,兼顧推理能力與嵌入檢索的效率優勢。
papers.title: Retrieval Grounding Latent Reasoning for Dense Retrieval
papers.title_zh: RGLT:以檢索效應為根基的稠密檢索潛在推理

links.title: CForce: Boosting Parallel Decoding for dLLMs via Consistency Forcing

evidence: Abstract/Sec 5.2: on edit-capable LLaDA2.1-mini, CForce raises average TPF from 6.94 to 9.08 and average score from 85.57 to 86.41 (Table 1).
Sec 5.2/Table 5: non-edit LLaDA2.0-mini trade-off — average TPF 3.60→6.42, average score 84.32→80.88 at tau=0.9, beating CAP (79.51/5.07).
Sec 5.3/Table 4: KL-form ablation shows CAD (80.88/6.42) between forward KL (85.75/5.07) and reverse KL (65.57/8.72); removing CE anchor drops score to 79.02.
Sec 5.3/Table 3: same-model stop-gradient target beats frozen teacher (+1.39 score, +0.51 TPF); curriculum removal lowers score 80.88→79.87.
Sec 4.4/Appendix C: theoretical support is a triangle-inequality + Pinsker bound linking forward-KL drift and reveal-boundary CE to early-stage prediction error.
Appendix B: full-parameter fine-tuning, AdamW, lr 1.0e-5, batch 64, 5 epochs, stage size 8, top-20 KL truncation, 64 H800 GPUs; code at github.com/inclusionAI/dFactory.
Limitations section: cached trajectories are fixed before optimization and may diverge from the updated model's inference distribution; only LLaDA-family models evaluated.
Sec 5.3 has a cross-reference slip: stage-size ablation is presented in Table 2 but the text says 'Table 3 studies the number of newly revealed tokens'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper on accelerating diffusion LLM parallel decoding via trajectory self-distillation; strongly matches LLM, efficiency, inference/serving, and training preferences, though not core agents/RAG/prompting topics. Novelty is moderate: consistency distillation for dLLMs exists (T3D, CDLM, d3LLM cited), with differentiation in self-rollout threshold-trajectory stages, CAD's confidence-weighted KL mix, and edit-capable T2T supervision. Rigor is solid but bounded by a simple triangle-inequality/Pinsker argument, single LLaDA model family, no variance reporting, and an acknowledged stale-trajectory limitation; the non-edit setting is an explicit quality trade-off rather than a pure win. Evidence is concrete (Table 1: LLaDA2.1-mini TPF 6.94→9.08 with score 85.57→86.41; Table 4 CAD ablation; Appendix E throughput +42.8%), but benchmark coverage is math/code only. Reproducibility is good: code link, hyperparameters, training data, and hardware specified.

primary_link.title: CForce: Boosting Parallel Decoding for dLLMs via Consistency Forcing

papers.summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) accelerate language generation by predicting multiple masks in a single forward pass. However, existing dLLMs can suffer from unreliable predictions in early denoising stages under aggressive parallelism strategies, leading to errors that can propagate to later stages. To tackle this issue, we present Consistency Forcing (CForce) for dLLMs, a distillation method to force the mask predictions of early stages to align with those of later stages. CForce train
papers.summary_zh: 擴散式大型語言模型藉單次前向預測多個遮罩位置達到高度平行解碼,但在激進閾值解碼下,早期去噪階段的預測不可靠,錯誤會向後傳播。本文提出 CForce,靈感源自一致性模型:從預訓練模型收集自身閾值解碼軌跡,按累積揭示的 token 數切分為相鄰階段,以同模型停止梯度方式,強迫早期低情境狀態對齊後期資訊更豐富的狀態。目標函數結合信心自適應 KL 散度(CAD),依後期預測信心動態混合前向與反向 KL,輔以揭示邊界的交叉熵錨定與揭示難度課程;對可編輯模型,後期的 token 對 token 修正亦回饋監督早期遮罩預測。理論上,早期預測誤差可由相鄰階段分布漂移與揭示邊界誤差之上界刻畫,正好對應 CAD 與 CE 兩項。在 LLaDA2.1-mini 上平均 TPF 從 6.94 升至 9.08,準確率由 85.57 提升至 86.41;在 LLaDA2.0-mini 上 TPF 從 3.60 增至 6.42,呈現明確的速度—品質權衡。消融確認課程、同模型目標與 CAD 皆屬關鍵。限制為使用離線預收集軌跡,訓練後可能與更新模型的推論軌跡漸偏。此法將 dLLM 加速的焦點從減少步數轉向早期預測可靠度。
papers.title: CForce: Boosting Parallel Decoding for dLLMs via Consistency Forcing
papers.title_zh: CForce:以一致性強化提升擴散式語言模型的平行解碼

links.title: Approximate Muon with low-rank adapters

evidence: Section 5, Table 1: with Moonlight-16B-A3B, sMuon best on Piqa 86.2, Winogrande 65.8, OBQA 82.4, Hellaswag 85.9, Arc-C 87.0; text states sMuon top on 6 of 11 tasks vs AdamW top on 1.
Section 5, Table 3: ReLoRA final validation loss sMuon 3.66 tied with Riemannion, all Muon-based methods below AdamW 3.83; Table 4: at r=64 Riemannion step 700ms (33% of total) vs sMuon 12ms (0.80%).
Section 4 and Appendix D, Lemma 1: closed-form delta A = B-dagger msign(H), delta B = (I - BB-dagger) msign(H) A-dagger, with proof of first-order optimality and unique realized full-layer update.
Section 5 Experiment details: 'we could not find implementations for LoRA-Muon or Riemannion, so we implemented these ourselves'; no code availability statement anywhere in the document.

Section 5 and Appendix E: learning rate swept per optimizer/model (3e-4 to 1e-2 for ReLoRA), accuracy reported at LR chosen by held-out validation loss; authors note results are 'model- and eval-dependent'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM training methodology: derives a closed-form, matmul-only Muon update for LoRA adapters (sMuon) via linearization and least squares, with a first-order optimality proof (Appendix D, Lemma 1). Preference relevance is strong (LoRA/PEFT, optimizer design, LLM fine-tuning and ReLoRA pretraining on Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-3B, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, Moonlight-16B-A3B) but it is an optimizer paper rather than an LLM-capability contribution. Novelty is moderate: the low-rank Muon problem is concurrently addressed by LoRA-Muon, Riemannion, per-factor Muon, PoLoRA; sMuon's distinct contributions are the linearized projection, parameterization-invariant momentum transport (App. A.3), and a matmul-only core avoiding QR/SVD. Rigor is solid: derivations checked, LR sweeps per method/model (App. E), timing methodology (Table 4), split weight decay analysis; but single-run results, 'best run by validation loss' selection, and acknowledged model/eval dependence weaken statistical support. Evidence concretely supports the hedged claim of moderate gains: Table 1 shows sMuon best on 6/11 Moonlight tasks (e.g., Arc-C 87.0 vs 85.6 AdamW), Table 3 shows tied-best ReLoRA val loss 3.66 vs AdamW 3.83, Table 4 shows Riemannion overhead (700ms, 33% of step at r=64) vs sMuon 12ms (0.80%). Generalizability is supported by dense/MoE, AdamW/Muon-pretrained, SFT and pretraining settings, though only transformers/LLMs and a 162M pretraining scale. Reproducibility is mixed: full algorithms (Algs 1-3), hyperparameters (r=16, alpha=32, wd 0.01, GH200, bf16/fp32) and LR grids are given, but no code release is stated and key baselines are author re-implementations (Section 5: 'we could not find implementations for LoRA-Muon or Riemannion').

primary_link.title: Approximate Muon with low-rank adapters

papers.summary: The Muon optimizer shows clear benefits versus alternatives when pretraining neural networks. However, it is used less frequently for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT). One potential reason is that the most common PEFT method, LoRA, does not naturally combine with Muon since it is not mathematically possible to orthogonalize the weight update given by a low-rank parameterization. In this paper, we address this issue by approximating the solution to a relaxed Muon objective in the low-rank s
papers.summary_zh: Muon 最佳化器透過正交化每層更新以均等奇異值,在 LLM 預訓練成效卓越,卻難與主流參數高效微調方法 LoRA 結合,因低秩參數化下無法直接正交化整層權重更新。既有折衷如 per-factor Muon 忽略整層幾何,Riemannion 則需昂貴的矩陣分解。本文對譜範數正則化的最陡下降目標做一階線性化,再以最小平方法求得 LoRA 上的閉式近似解:先將梯度投影到當前適配器可表達的子空間,再正交化並求解。作者進一步推導僅用矩陣乘法的等價演算法,避免 QR 與 SVD,把大矩陣正交化化為 2r×2r 核心運算,並採用分裂權重衰減與動量投影確保參數化不變性。實驗涵蓋四個基礎模型(含 Muon 預訓練的 Moonlight-16B-A3B)的常識與程式 SFT 基準:sMuon 在 Moonlight 上十一項任務中六項居首,顯示 Muon 類 LoRA 與 Muon 預訓練模型相得益彰;ReLoRA 預訓練中所有 Muon 系方法皆勝過 LoRA+AdamW,sMuon 與 Riemannion 並列最低驗證損失但快約 30%。結果依模型與評測而異,且方法為一階近似。此研究為譜幾何意識的低秩微調提供實用且高效的實作。

links.title: Identifiability and Order-Dimension Limits of In-Context Learning on Partial Orders

evidence: Section 1, Contributions: version-space formalization of relational ICL, exact true/false/unknown completion theorem, teaching prompts via cover labels and a blocker-set hitting problem, tight class maximum n(n-1)
Section 4, Theorem 3: open-world completion trichotomy with O(|U|^3) transitive-closure preprocessing and O(|D^-|) per-query classification cost
Section 5, Theorem 6 and Corollary 7: tau_ow(P)=|Cov(P)|+beta(P); exact chain (n-1) and antichain (n(n-1)) values; open-vs-closed-world cost gap equals beta(P)
Section 7, Definition 10 and Corollary 12: exact capability boundary for prompt-dependent monotone coordinate decoders; explicitly 'no claim is made here for approximate or error-tolerant decoding'

Section 9, Scope of the theoretical conclusions: 'we do not infer limitations for unrestricted transformers, softmax attention, general task vectors, approximate decoders, or arbitrary graph algorithms'

Supplementary Section 4, Table 2: exact ambiguity values alpha_m from exhaustive enumeration of all 219 labeled four-element posets, e.g., alpha_11=.4475, described as 'not a model evaluation or a universal poset distribution'
Supplementary Section 4, Implementation details: Python 3.13.5 with integer bit masks, ~1.6 seconds runtime, 164 MiB peak RSS, supplied script and accompanying code package claimed for reproduction

Section 2: acknowledges Dushnik-Miller dimension, divisibility-order dimension, version spaces, and teaching dimension as classical; contribution is 'their connection to a precisely restricted ICL representation class'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Pure theory paper formalizing in-context learning on partial orders via version spaces, an exact true/false/unknown completion trichotomy, a teaching-dimension characterization (covers plus blocker hitting sets), and an order-dimension capability boundary for coordinate decoders. It aligns well with high-weight ICL/prompting and reasoning preferences and motivates LLM benchmark design, but contains no LLM or transformer experiments or behavioral validation; all results are mathematical theorems plus one model-free exhaustive enumeration. Proofs are complete and carefully scoped, with explicit disclaimers that nothing is claimed about unrestricted transformers or approximate decoding. Novelty lies in the synthesis connecting classical tools (version spaces, teaching dimension, Dushnik-Miller dimension) rather than in new techniques; the individual theorems are elementary though correct. The finite-universe scope and the restricted decoder class limit generalizability, while the bundled deterministic enumeration is highly reproducible.

primary_link.title: Identifiability and Order-Dimension Limits of In-Context Learning on Partial Orders

papers.summary: In-context learning is commonly formalized as inference from examples of a function. Partial orders instead combine transitivity, antisymmetry, and incomparability, so a finite prompt may not determine a queried comparison. We develop a theory of in-context learning on partial orders that separates logical identifiability, prompt teaching cost, structural complexity, and the exact capacity of a formal coordinate-decoder class. A version-space semantics makes background knowledge and open- versus
papers.summary_zh: 情境學習的多數理論聚焦於函數學習,然而許多推理任務本質上是關係性的。本文以有限偏序集為對象,系統性探討提示在邏輯上決定了什麼。給定固定已知論域、背景理論與正負示範,作者以版本空間形式化一致假設集合,並證明開放世界提示的精確三分定理:對查詢計算自反傳遞閉包後,可判定為強制為真、強制為假或真實不可辨識,並給出逐查詢的分類成本;封閉世界(宣告完整哈斯圖)則化約為圖可達性。教學複雜度方面,證明最佳開放世界提示恰由全部覆蓋關係與最小阻塞集擊中集組成,鏈僅需 n−1 個標籤,反鏈則達類別最大值 n(n−1),而開放世界相對封閉世界的額外標籤成本正是阻塞項。結構難度以高度、寬度、序維度與正負憑證長度等獨立軸刻畫;經古典座標序等價定理,進一步確立以 s 個單調座標解碼器精確表示任務族的充分必要條件為目標偏序之序維度不超過 s,並以四元素偏序的窮舉列舉佐證歧義普遍存在。此純理論工作闡明不可辨識性、提示預算、憑證長度與表示維度是四種彼此獨立的失敗來源,對基準設計的啟示是必須明示論域與語意、並允許「未知」作為合法輸出,以區分推理與預訓練知識的回憶。

links.title: DeaMoE: Efficient MoE Structure for Fast Small-Batch Decoding

evidence: Abstract: 'reduces per-step loaded weights by up to 50.9% and achieves up to 1.33x end-to-end TPOT speedup for the pre-trained 7B model on A40, and up to 2.00x and 1.97x peak speedup for DeepSeek-V3 on A40 and H100 in microbenchmarks'
Section 4.1: 'we pre-train both MoE models with an identical size of 7.3B parameters... pre-trained with the same corpus of 110B tokens with identical software and hardware configurations'
Section 4.1: 'The code for training will be open-sourced later, which contains both forward and backward passes'

Section 4.2, Table 2: mixed accuracy results (DeaMoE-7B BoolQ 62.39 vs Baseline 61.47; Baseline wins OBQA 37.6 vs 34.8, PIQA 74.43 vs 73.39); Table 3: perplexity comparable (PTB 61.91 vs 64.33, WikiText-103 20.31 vs 20.18)
Section 5.1: 'under a TPOT budget of 30 ms, the baseline and DeaMoE sustain batch sizes of 64 and 96, respectively, corresponding to a 1.50x throughput improvement'
Section 5.2: 'the gains for Baseline-7B are noticeably smaller and even show mild regressions at very small and very large batch sizes' on H100
Section 3.3/Figure 2: 'For the configuration matched to DeepSeek-V3, the loading ratio stays between 49.1% and 62.8% when the number of tokens is between 4 and 64'
Appendix A, Table 4: 5B-scale ablations over 12.4B tokens; identity init lowers last-200-step loss from 2.530 to 2.504; strict department top-k raises loss from 2.504 to 2.519
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-systems work on MoE architecture and small-batch decoding efficiency, squarely within LLM/transformer/inference-serving preferences. Novelty is moderate: department-shared backbones with private expert transforms echo existing expert-factorization ideas (MoBE, MoLAE, MoE-SVD cited by authors), and two-stage/group routing resembles DeepSeek-style group-limited top-k; the pre-training-first framing and decoding-latency objective are the freshest parts. Rigor is decent: a budget-matched 7.3B pair pre-trained on identical 110B tokens, 10 downstream tasks plus perplexity, and a 5B-scale ablation suite (activation, init, routing strictness). However, router load-balancing losses and full training hyperparameters are unspecified, no SFT/instruction-tuned evaluation, and results are single-run without variance. Evidence is credible for the 7B model (1.33x end-to-end TPOT, mixed-but-comparable accuracy) but the headline 2.00x/1.97x DeepSeek-V3 figures are per-layer microbenchmarks of hypothetical re-trained configurations with no quality validation for those adaptations; honest reporting of H100 regressions for the small model helps. Generalizability is limited by the requirement to pre-train from scratch (no post-hoc path), though two GPU generations are covered. Reproducibility is weak: code only promised 'later' and key training details are missing.

primary_link.title: DeaMoE: Efficient MoE Structure for Fast Small-Batch Decoding

papers.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have been widely adopted in real-time interactive applications such as coding assistants, real-time audio-video interaction systems. To meet the extremely low response latency requirements of these scenarios, practitioners commonly employ small-batch decoding, under which MoE inference becomes memory-bound and is severely bottlenecked by expert weight loading. However, this bottleneck has received limited attention, and existing solutions such as post-training wei
papers.summary_zh: MoE 模型廣泛部署於即時互動應用,但小批次解碼下推論呈記憶體瓶頸:每步僅處理少量 token,路由卻散落啟用多個專家,權重重複載入使延遲由頻寬主導。既有訓後壓縮或預訓練細粒度專家設計皆非直接針對此負載問題。本文提出 DeaMoE:將專家分組為數個部門,同部門專家共享大型骨幹參數,各自僅保留少量私有轉換矩陣以保留特異性;並設計兩階段路由,先將 token 匯入所選部門統一計算共享參數,再交由專家私有參數差異化處理,大幅減少重複載入。訓練採 SiLU 介面非線性、專家矩陣恆等初始化與軟性部門 top-k 約束,消融顯示嚴格部門覆蓋反而傷害品質。作者以 110B tokens 從頭預訓練 7.3B 模型,下游任務與困惑度與同預算標準 MoE 基線相當;小批次情境下每步載入權重最多減少 50.9%,7B 模型於 A40 端對端 TPOT 加速達 1.33 倍,DeepSeek-V3 微基準於 A40 與 H100 峰值加速分別達 2.00 與 1.97 倍。限制在於效益依賴專家權重載入為主瓶頸的情境,小專家模型於高頻寬硬體上增益有限。此架構為低延遲 MoE 服務提供由設計端解決的新方向。

links.title: From Errors to Proofs: Minimal-Core-Guided Repair for Neuro-Symbolic Constraint Solving

evidence: Section 3.4: typed+core and generic repair settings use the same pipeline, model, iteration budget, and decision contract, differing only in feedback content, isolating the core's effect
Section 6, Table 3: on deepseek-v3.2, generic repair fabricates on 11/14 infeasible instances (79%) vs 1/14 (7%) with core repair, two-sided Fisher exact p<1e-3

Section 6, Table 1: on gemma4:31b over 77 instances, chain-of-thought reaches 98.7% feasibility accuracy vs 89.6% for typed+core pipeline; direct prompting fabricates 21.4% vs 0% for all pipeline settings
Section 6, Table 2: ASP pipeline scores 100% on six of seven domains and 0% (no repair) / 33.3% (+core) on scheduling, localizing the translation tax to aggregate-coverage encoding

Section 8 (Limitations/Threats): core benefit over bare error message demonstrated on one of two models; benchmark uses templated descriptions and a single assign/2 relation; scheduling diagnosis is fixed-prompt

Section 4: 77 instances across seven domains with a deterministic encoder independent of the language model and a separate scoring oracle; Section 9 claims release of benchmark and oracle without a URL
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: an LLM-to-ASP translation pipeline with a solver-in-the-loop repair cycle, CoT and prompting baselines, structured output, and a new oracle-scored benchmark, hitting the LLM, Reasoning/CoT, Agents/Tool-Use, and Evaluation preferences without being a pure domain application. Novelty is genuine but incremental: deletion-filtered minimal unsatisfiable cores (classical QuickXplain machinery, Section 3.3) are ported into an LLM repair loop, which the paper plausibly claims is new (Section 2). Rigor is above average for a workshop paper: the typed+core vs generic settings are identical except feedback content (Section 3.4), a deterministic encoder provides an exact oracle (Section 4), and key claims carry statistical tests (paired sign test p=1.0 on the strong model; Fisher exact p<1e-3 for the fabrication effect, Section 6). Evidence is internally consistent: Table 1 (CoT 98.7% vs pipeline 89.6%), Table 2 (scheduling 0% no-repair), Table 3 (79%->7% fabrication on the weak model), plus a worked Appendix A trace. Limits: only 77 templated instances, one fixed decision relation, two models with the headline effect demonstrated on just the weaker one, and an accuracy crossover resting on a single xl instance (Section 8 threats to validity). Release of benchmark and oracle is claimed but no URL or code artifact is given, capping reproducibility.
topics: minimal unsatisfiable cores as repair feedback

primary_link.title: From Errors to Proofs: Minimal-Core-Guided Repair for Neuro-Symbolic Constraint Solving

papers.summary: Making language models solve constraint problems reliably often means having them translate the problem into a formal specification and delegating the search to a sound solver. But the translation is itself a language-model task, and an unfaithful translation makes the solver faithfully solve the wrong problem. Existing pipelines repair only translations that crash, returning the solver's error message and falling silent when the program runs but is wrong. We replace the error message with a pro
papers.summary_zh: 將約束問題翻譯成形式規格再交由可靠求解器搜尋,是語言模型處理離散推理的常見方案,但翻譯本身可能不忠:過度約束會使可解問題誤判為不可滿足,而現有管線僅在程式崩潰時回饋錯誤訊息,形式正確卻錯誤的翻譯便無聲存留。本文改以證明取代錯誤:當 ASP 程式不可滿足時,以刪除過濾法在模型自身的完整性約束上抽取極小不可滿足核心,僅回饋無法共存的那組約束,此訊號具結構性且無標準答案洩漏。作者建立含精確 oracle 的 77 題七領域基準,發現翻譯在六個領域近乎全對,唯獨需要聚合覆蓋計數的排程領域崩潰,將「翻譯稅」定位到特定形式化模式。實驗顯示在較弱模型 deepseek-v3.2 上,泛用錯誤訊息修復會使其刪除真約束、對 14 個不可行題有 79% 捏造解,而極小核心修復降至 7%,差異顯著;在強模型上兩者差距則在雜訊內。同時,強鏈式思考基線在準確率上與符號管線相當,顯示符號路線的價值在於最佳性與不可行性憑證、以及絕不捏造,而非單純準確率。限制包括模板化描述、ASP 難以認證大型數值最佳化,以及迴圈內缺乏驗證器。此工作主張將求解器端證明工件視為一級修復回饋。

links.title: MINT: Min-Selection Preference Distillation for Balanced Multi-Objective Alignment

evidence: Abstract & Sec 4.1 (Fig. 2): on ESConv held-out turns (n=406 across 30 conversations), min(AQ,EQ) rises 0.37 to 0.64 vs the SFT reference (Wilcoxon p≈3e-43, higher on 79% of matched turns); imbalance |AQ-EQ| falls 0.26 to 0.16.

Sec 4.1 (Fig. 3): on CraigslistBargain with DPO applied directly to Gemma-3-27B (no SFT stage), min(AQ,EQ) improves 0.583 to 0.657 (p=0.0002, n=103 turns) and the objective gap tightens 0.177 to 0.135.

Sec 4.2 (Table 1): depth-resolved self-play rollouts show the ESConv advantage persists at every depth (delta-min +0.235 to +0.145, all p<1e-4) while the Craigslist advantage decays to +0.001 by turn 8 (pooled p=0.43), supporting the central claim that gains track reference imbalance.

Sec 4 / Figs. 2-3: baselines are limited to the base model, SFT, and an unmatched human row; no empirical comparison against the additive p=1 selection rule depicted in Fig. 1(b) and no ablation over p, K=8, or margin delta=0.25, despite the additive-vs-min contrast being the core claim.

Appendix B & Fig. 2/3 captions: all scores come from a single frozen Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct judge with weighted rubrics, greedy decoding, and axis-independence probes (B.4); captions state 'All scores are quality as assessed by the reward model' and no human evaluation is reported.

Appendix A.1-A.2: full training detail is given (ESConv LoRA r=16/alpha=32 on Llama-3.1-8B, 1,956 pairs; Craigslist r=8/alpha=16 on Gemma-3-27B 4-bit QLoRA, 725 pairs; beta=0.1, lr 1e-5, margin 0.25) with training-dynamics figures; B.4 says prompts are 'reproduced verbatim in our released code' but no repository URL appears in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-alignment work (best-of-K DPO distillation with an LLM judge) that fits the preference profile squarely; the min-selection rule is a clean Chebyshev/generalized-mean reframing of pair selection, but the paper itself concedes the contribution is empirical rather than algorithmic. The decisive ablation is missing: results never compare head-to-head against the additive (p=1) selection rule shown in Fig. 1(b), nor sweep p, K, or the margin delta, and no prior multi-objective method (MODPO, Rewarded Soups) is run as a baseline. All quality numbers come from the same frozen 8B judge used to construct training pairs, with no human validation and small judge-scored samples (406/103 static turns, ~280 rollout turns), though the statistics (paired Wilcoxon), held-out splits, and unusually honest depth-resolved null/decay reporting (Table 1) are strengths. Two structurally distinct domains and two policy models support transfer, but only m=2 objectives and dialogue tasks are tested. Reproducibility is strong on hyperparameters and verbatim rubrics with a claimed code release, though no URL is provided.

primary_link.title: MINT: Min-Selection Preference Distillation for Balanced Multi-Objective Alignment

papers.summary: Aligning a language agent to several objectives at once is a persistent failure mode of preference-based training: when objectives are combined additively, optimization collapses onto whichever is cheapest to improve and sacrifices the rest, so a support agent learns to sound warm while giving no real help. The root issue is that an additive reward has no notion of balance. We introduce Mint (MIN-selection preference disTillation), a one-line change to preference distillation: rather than rankin
papers.summary_zh: 多目標對齊中,加權總和式獎勵缺乏平衡概念,最佳化常塌縮到最易改善的目標而犧牲其餘,例如支援代理學會語氣溫暖卻無實質幫助。本文提出 MINT,僅改動 best-of-K 偏好蒸餾中的選配步驟:以廣義平均的 p→−∞ 極限(即各候選的最弱目標值)排序,選出最平衡者為 chosen、最偏頗者為 rejected,再以不變的 DPO 目標蒸餾;平手時以總分決勝。在合作式情緒支持(ESConv)與對抗式議價(CraigslistBargain)兩個對比領域,以凍結的 Llama-3.1-8B 評審分別評分任務成就(AQ)與情緒品質(EQ):情緒支持上 min(AQ,EQ) 自 0.37 升至 0.64(顯著性 p<10⁻⁴⁰),超越人類專家,且不平衡度同步下降;議價上最弱軸由 0.583 升至 0.657。逐輪分析揭示核心發現:min-selection 對不平衡的修正幅度與參考策略的不平衡程度成正比,其優勢恰在參考策略持續失衡時隨互動深度延續——面對逐輪崩壞的 SFT 參考增益大而持久,面對本已平衡的強基線則僅在配對情境顯著並隨軌跡分歧衰減。方法貢獻屬實證性質,實驗限於兩目標與兩領域。此研究將 min-selection 定位為針對參考失衡的精準矯正器,對多目標 RLHF 設計深具啟發。

links.title: Rethinking Automated Program Repair: The Impact of Bug Complexity, Fault Localization, and LLM Cost-efficiency

evidence: Abstract/Conclusions: GPT-5 repairs '7 and 39 more complex bugs' than DeepSeek-V4-pro and DeepSeek-V3.2, while DeepSeek-V3.2's total cost is 'approximately 4.6% and 7.7% of GPT-5 and DeepSeek-V4-pro'.
Section 3.3 Dataset: 1,914 C++ AtCoder submissions collected October 2025; threshold of five fixed lines leaves 640 bugs, explicitly motivated by data-contamination concerns with Defects4J/QuixBugs.
Section 4.1 Table 3: DeepSeek-V3.2-chat repairs 295/640 (CodeCorrector) vs GPT-4o-mini 126/640; Repaired Bugs/$ 47.62 vs 17.86 under line-level FL.
Section 4.2 Table 6: repair gap between ChatRepair (237/640) and CodeCorrector (179/640) grows to 93 bugs (205 vs 112) under no-FL; Table 7 shows CCR drops to 0.54 for CodeCorrector w/o FL.

Section 4 Tables 4-5: pairwise chi-square tests (SHSL vs SHML p<0.0001); four-operation bugs significantly harder (p<0.05); Section 4.2 Table 8 logistic regression ORs with p-values for FL degradation.

Section 3.6: three-stage design, 211-bug filtered benchmark for advanced LLMs, reasoning disabled for first 10 rounds then enabled for 3; token consumption (e.g., DeepSeek-V3.2: 116.5M input / 42.7M output) and 30-60 minute reasoning response times reported.

Section 4.3 Table 9: GPT-5 repairs 175/211 non-reasoning but only 3 additional with high reasoning effort, vs +64 (DeepSeek-V3.2) and +81 (DeepSeek-V4-pro), supporting the family-dependent reasoning claim.

Limitation noted from Section 3.3/3.5: single language (C++), <=5 fixed lines, temperature fixed at 1.0, prompts retained from original studies with no model-specific tuning; no explicit code or dataset release statement appears in the provided text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed empirical evaluation squarely aligned with core preferences: it tests multiple LLMs (GPT-5, DeepSeek-V3.2/V4-pro, Llama-3.1) on automated program repair, explicitly varies reasoning settings/modes, and adds cost-efficiency analysis. Novelty is moderate: it introduces a contamination-resistant AtCoder bug dataset with a two-axis complexity taxonomy (hunk-line, AST operations) and standardized $-denominated cost metrics, but uses existing APR frameworks (ChatRepair, CodeCorrector) and no new repair methodology. Rigor is decent: chi-square tests, logistic regression with odds ratios, three-stage design, and token-usage reporting; however, single-run experiments at fixed temperature 1.0, no variance estimates, an ambiguous repaired-vs-plausible definition, no multiple-comparison correction across many pairwise tests, and a stage-3 filtering strategy weaken confidence. Evidence is internally consistent and quantitatively detailed but rests on single runs and point-in-time API prices. Generalizability is limited to small-scope (<=5 fixed lines) C++ competitive-programming bugs in a single language. Reproducibility is aided by detailed configurations, model versions, and token counts, but no artifact/code/data release is stated in the text.

primary_link.title: Rethinking Automated Program Repair: The Impact of Bug Complexity, Fault Localization, and LLM Cost-efficiency

papers.summary:
Background: Software bugs remain a critical challenge in development, necessitating effective Automated Program Repair (APR) techniques. While Large Language Model (LLM)-based APR systems have shown promise, prior studies primarily focus on overall repair effectiveness. The effects of bug complexity, fault localization, reasoning settings, and repair cost-effectiveness remain insufficiently explored.
  Aims: This study presents a comprehensive empirical analysis of LLM-based APR, focusing on how
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對 LLM 型自動化程式修復（APR）缺乏細緻實證分析的問題，系統探討錯誤複雜度、故障定位（FL）精確度與成本效益如何影響修復表現。作者從 AtCoder 競程平台收集 1,914 份 C++ 提交，經篩選後建立 640 個錯誤的資料集，並利用 Git、srcML 與 GumTreeDiff 自動將錯誤分類為不同複雜度層級（如單區塊單行 SHSL 到多區塊多行 MHML，以及 AST 操作型態複雜度）。研究評估 ChatRepair 與 CodeCorrector 兩種 APR 技術，搭配 DeepSeek、GPT 與 Llama 三個模型家族的多個版本與推理設定，並採用多維度指標（可編譯修補、合理修補、修復數、Top-k、一致性）與統計檢定（卡方檢定、邏輯迴歸），另定義「每美元修復錯誤數」與「每美元嘗試次數」等統一貨幣單位的成本效益指標。主要發現包括：(1) 結構複雜度較高的錯誤雖較難修復，但超過 50% 的中等複雜度錯誤仍可被低成本 LLM 修復；(2) 故障定位越不精確，不同 APR 技術間的效能差距越大，ChatRepair 在無 FL 情境下比 CodeCorrector 多修復 93 個錯誤；(3) 更昂貴的模型與更強的推理設定不一定帶來更好的成本效益：GPT-5 比 DeepSeek-V3.2 多修復 39 個複雜錯誤，但 DeepSeek-V3.2 的總修復成本僅約 GPT-5 的 4.6%；(4) 推理策略的效果因模型家族而異，GPT-5 開啟推理僅多修復 3 個錯誤，而 DeepSeek 系列則獲益明顯。研究的限制在於資料集聚焦 C++ 與小型演算法類錯誤，且溫度、提示詞等超參數未進行模型微調。整體而言，本文為 LLM 型 APR 的務實部署提供了複雜度、定位精確度與成本之間的權衡地圖，對 end-to-end 修復場景的可行性與模型選擇具有重要參考價值。
