links.title: Scaling Creative Writing Beyond Story-Centric Data with Attribute-Guided Genre Expansion

evidence: Section 2 (Source Dataset Selection / Step 3): pipeline uses GPT-5-mini for safety filtering (686 instances removed), irrelevant-content removal (861 instances), and query generation; Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking for responses; Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct as quality judge filtering scores below two standard deviations.
Section 2 (Step 2): 5–15 manually reviewed genre attributes per genre, sampled k~Uniform(0,|A_g|) to vary instruction specificity; attribute construction relies on human curation.
Section 3.1 (Models): Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, EXAONE-3.5-7.8B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B fine-tuned via SFT with LoRA rank 128, 2 epochs, lr 1.0e-5, warmup 0.1, batch 128, cutoff 4096 via LlamaFactory.
Section 3.2, Table 1: SFT gains, e.g., Llama 2.9→33.0 on Arena Hard, Qwen3 8.0→34.2; all fine-tuned models exceed LongWriter-glm4-9B baseline.
Section 3.2, Table 2: matched 2K-subset comparison—Multi-Genre (7.5/59.1/71.4) beats DeepWriting (4.9/55.5/65.9) and LongWriter (7.0/56.4/69.6) with Qwen3-8B.
Section 3.2, Table 3: genre-count ablation shows NoveltyBench Distinct rising 3.87→4.81 from 0 to 13 genres; no variance or per-condition instance counts reported.
Section 3.2, Tables 4–5: independent judges (DeepSeek v3.2, Gemini 3 Flash) and human evaluation on 50 WritingBench prompts (59.3 vs 57.7 LongWriter, 56.9 DeepWriting) corroborate gains.

Section 3.1 (Benchmarks, item 3): in-distribution Multi-Genre test set scored by GPT-4.1 against Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking references generated within the same pipeline, a potential circularity; no statistical significance or seed variance reported anywhere; no dataset/code release statement found in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A genuinely LLM-centric paper: synthetic data generation for creative-writing instruction tuning, using frontier LLMs (GPT-5-mini query generation, Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking responses) and SFT/LoRA fine-tuning of three open LLMs (Section 2, Section 3.1), which aligns with the high-weight LLM, NLP, training, and data preferences, though it is an applied data-engineering contribution rather than core LLM methodology. Novelty is moderate: the control-axis shift from task-complexity evolution (Self-Instruct/Evol-Instruct) to separating thematic seeds from manually curated genre-form attributes is a clear but incremental twist, and multi-genre corpora fill a real gap versus story-centric resources (Section 4). Rigor is solid: three base models, OOD/ID benchmarks, a matched-2K-subset comparison against DeepWriting and LongWriter corpora (Table 2), a genre-count ablation (Table 3), independent-judge re-evaluation with DeepSeek v3.2 and Gemini 3 Flash (Table 4), and human evaluation (Table 5); however, no variance, seeds, or significance testing are reported, the in-distribution test set is scored by GPT-4.1 against references produced by the same pipeline model (Section 3.1, Benchmark 3), and the human eval covers only 50 prompts. Evidence strength mirrors this: concrete quantitative tables with large gains (e.g., Qwen3 Arena Hard 8.0→34.2, Table 1) corroborated across judges, but judge-dependent and without error bars. Generalizability is decent: gains hold across Llama, EXAONE, and Qwen3 families and the seed-plus-attribute recipe is domain-portable, though demonstrated only on English. Reproducibility is weaker: hyperparameters and a meta-prompt template are given, but attribute lists were manually curated, closed models are required, and no dataset or code release is stated anywhere in the document. Not out-of-scope; scores reflect a competent, moderately novel data paper with judge-centric evidence.

primary_link.title: Scaling Creative Writing Beyond Story-Centric Data with Attribute-Guided Genre Expansion

papers.summary: High-quality creative writing data for large language models (LLMs) remains dominated by story-centric data, limiting models' ability to follow the structural and functional conventions of diverse creative formats. We propose an attribute-guided genre expansion framework for scaling creative writing data beyond story generation. By separating thematic breadth from genre-form control, our framework leverages human-authored story prompts as diverse creative seeds, while utilizing manually curated
papers.summary_zh: 本文指出高品質創意寫作資料長期以故事生成為主，導致語言模型難以遵循說唱、劇本、遊戲設計文件等非故事文類的結構與功能慣例。作者提出「屬性引導的文類擴展」框架，將主題廣度與文類形式控制分離：以 Reddit r/WritingPrompts 的人類創作故事提示作為多樣化的創意種子，並利用人工整理的文類屬性（如 rap 的押韻格式與節奏、劇本的敘事弧線與對白）注入結構性約束。流程分三步：先隨機抽樣五組少樣本範例作為主題種子；再從每個文類 5 至 15 個屬性中隨機取樣子集（k 服從 Uniform(0,|A_g|)）以控制指令的具體程度；最後以 GPT-5-mini 產生文類忠實的查詢，並以 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking 生成回應，再以 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct 擔任 LLM-as-a-judge 進行品質過濾。最終建立涵蓋 13 種創意文類、50,000 筆資料的 Multi-Genre Collection 語料庫。實驗以 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、EXAONE-3.5-7.8B 與 Qwen3-8B 三個基礎模型進行 SFT 微調（LlamaFactory + LoRA rank 128），結果顯示微調後模型在 Arena Hard (Creative Writing)、WritingBench 與自建的 Multi-Genre 測試集上全面超越基礎模型與寫作專精的 LongWriter-glm4-9B 基線；與既有寫作語料（DeepWriting-20k、LongWriter-6k）在 2K 抽樣公平比較下亦全面勝出，例如 Arena Hard 上 7.5 vs 4.9/7.0。文類數量消融顯示，訓練文類從 0 增至 13 時，NoveltyBench 新穎性指標由 3.87 單調上升至 4.81，證明文類多樣性是輸出多樣性的關鍵驅動力。為排除評審偏好偏差，作者改用 DeepSeek v3.2 與 Gemini 3 Flash 等獨立評審及人類評估，結果一致確認品質提升。限制在於資料僅為英文、屬性抽取依賴 GPT-5 的自動化流程，且「Etc.」長尾文類未被完整建模。整體而言，本文示範了以人類引導的屬性控制來系統性擴展非故事文類創意資料的可行路徑。

links.title: Geometric Filtering of LLM-Generated Samples for Few-Shot Text Classification

evidence: Abstract: claims +2.61pp over SMOTE (p<0.0001, d=0.95, 88.9% win rate) and NER extension +9.26pp with 100% win rate across 5 LLMs from 4 providers.

Section IV-A, Table I: 'No augmentation' row shows +0.64pp over SMOTE, so the method's true gain over no augmentation is +1.75pp (binary filter, p<0.0001, d=0.63); soft weighting vs binary filtering is +0.22pp, p=0.053 (non-significant).

Section III-F: prespecifies 5 seeds [42,123,456,789,1011], paired t-tests with Bonferroni correction, Cohen's d thresholds, 10,000-resample bootstrap CIs, win rates, and two documented protocols (1,890 and 3,675 runs).

Section IV-D: in NER, unfiltered LLM generation already yields +8.40pp while geometric filtering adds only +0.86pp that does not reach significance with 9 configurations (p=0.27); combined filter fails with 0% acceptance in 6 of 9 configurations.
Section V-C: benefit turns negative at 77 classes (banking77 −0.99pp) and neutral at 150 classes (clinc150 +0.01pp), Spearman ρ=−0.260 (p=0.003) between class count and gain.

Section V-F (Limitations): English-only; 50-shot difference non-significant under the 5-classifier protocol (p=0.16); MD5 response caching produces zero cross-seed variance for deterministic classifiers, though restricted analysis remains significant (+1.79pp, p=0.0015, d=0.52).

Section III-E: classifiers are logistic regression, linear SVC, Ridge, random forest (100 trees), and MLP (100 hidden units) — no fine-tuned transformer or LLM-based classifier baselines are evaluated.

Section III-B/III-C: generation uses Gemini 3 Flash with 3× surplus candidates, robustness over GPT-5-mini, Claude 4.5 Haiku, Kimi K2.5, GLM-5; Section V-A reports Friedman test χ2=8.15, p=0.086 (no significant LLM effect), supporting model decoupling.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM/NLP methodology paper: post-generation filtering of LLM-generated synthetic training data via Euclidean distance to real class examples in a sentence-embedding space, plus soft sample weighting, evaluated on few-shot text classification and NER. Empirical protocol is unusually thorough (13 datasets, 10 augmentation methods, 5 classifiers, 6,700+ configurations, Bonferroni-corrected paired tests, Cohen's d, bootstrap CIs, multi-seed, 5-LLM/4-provider and 4-embedding-model ablations) with candid limitations. However, the headline +2.61pp is measured against a weak SMOTE reference that is itself outperformed by no augmentation (+0.64pp); the honest gain over doing nothing is +1.75pp (d=0.63). The soft-weighting contribution is marginal and non-significant (+0.22pp, p=0.053), and in NER the filtering increment (+0.86pp) does not reach significance (p=0.27). Novelty is modest (a simple distance filter with a monotonicity argument for why it beats multi-criteria filters). Generalizability is constrained: English-only, negative at 77 classes (−0.99pp), non-significant at 50-shot under the 5-classifier protocol (p=0.16), and only shallow classifiers (no fine-tuned transformer baselines). Reproducibility is aided by fixed seeds, MD5 response caching, and named models/hyperparameters, but no code or prompt release is stated.

primary_link.title: Geometric Filtering of LLM-Generated Samples for Few-Shot Text Classification

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate synthetic training data for text classification, but the quality of generated samples is heterogeneous: some fall in correct class regions of the embedding space while others land in peripheral or cross-class zones. We propose a geometric filtering framework that evaluates each LLM-generated sample by its Euclidean distance to real class examples in a sentence embedding space, selecting only geometrically consistent candidates. A soft weighting mechanism
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對 LLM 合成訓練資料品質參差不齊的問題：部分生成樣本落在嵌入空間中正確的類別區域，部分則落在邊緣或跨類別區域，若不加篩選地納入會損害分類器表現。作者提出幾何過濾框架，以歐氏距離衡量每個合成樣本與真實類別範例在 all-mpnet-base-v2 句嵌入空間中的幾何一致性，並搭配軟性加權機制，將過濾分數轉為連續樣本權重（溫度 T=0.5）傳入分類器訓練。研究在 13 個資料集、5 個分類器（logistic regression、Linear SVC、Ridge、隨機森林、MLP）、10 種資料擴增方法與超過 6,700 種配置上評估，並以配對 t 檢定與 Bonferroni 校正進行統計推論。主要結果顯示，軟性加權法相較 SMOTE 提升 2.61 個百分點（p<0.0001，Cohen's d=0.95，勝率 88.9%），二元過濾亦有 +2.39pp；而 T5 改寫、BERT 情境擴增與嵌入 mixup 等現代方法均未能超越 SMOTE。效益隨樣本數增加而遞減：10-shot 時 d=1.48，50-shot 時降至 0.76。方法可直接泛用於 NER 任務（+9.26pp，100% 勝率）而無需修改過濾器。最有實務意義的發現是「最簡單的距離過濾器持續優於複雜的多準則方案」，原因有三：L2 正規化向量上歐氏距離與餘弦相似度單調等價，後者無新增判別資訊；多準則交集造成多樣性損失；以及 LOF 在 10-shot 場景（僅 9 個真實樣本）下密度估計退化。課程式實驗進一步顯示保留幾何分數前 50% 的候選樣本最佳，說明約半數 LLM 生成樣本屬雜訊。限制包括僅評估英文、過濾與分類使用同一嵌入模型存在潛在循環性、類別數達 77 或 150 時效益轉為負值或中性，以及困難類別（基線 F1 低於 30%）獲益最大（平均 +10.44pp）凸顯其對少數群體類別的價值。

links.title: Bootstrapping Niche Multilingual Code Translation via Reinforcement Learning with Execution-Based Verifiable Supervision

evidence: Section 3.2: reward model is a cross-encoder trained with Bradley-Terry objective on Stage-3 preference pairs; policy optimized with GRPO using group-relative advantages over 25x24=600 directions, replacing per-language sandboxes at rollout time.

Section 5.1 'Other Settings': 'we performed only a single hyperparameter sweep for the pipeline. Consequently, all experimental results are based on a single run and are reported without statistical measures.'

Section 5.2 vs Table 3: text reports thinking-mode gains '4B: 44.59 -> 59.15, 9B: 52.31 -> 63.11', but Table 3 lists GRPO thinking-mode averages of 56.18 (4B) and 62.07 (9B), an unexplained inconsistency.

Section 5.3: failure analysis on 22,755 common translations attributes gains mainly to compile-error reduction (4,222 -> 2,538 cases, over half of the 3,129 additional successes); long-tail languages Ada, OCaml, Clojure, Racket show little or no gain.
Table 2: per-language Stage-2 verified rates range from 15.9% (Ada) to 100% (Python); Stage 3 yields 3,734,461 positive and 6,284,293 negative rollouts compressed to 717,083 preference pairs.

Section 5.2/Tables 3-4: baselines are only untrained Qwen3.5 4B/9B (plus Qwen2.5 Coder reference rows); no comparison against prior translation methods (e.g., BootTrans, CodePivot) and no ablation isolating the learned reward model versus direct execution reward, the paper's central scalability claim.

Section 5.1: full training/evaluation hyperparameters given (LoRA rank 16/alpha 32 on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B reward model, GRPO group size 4, verl default rollout config, GH200 hardware), but no release of the authors' code, data, models, or HumanEval-X++ is stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: LLM post-training via GRPO with a Bradley-Terry reward model on execution-verified code-translation data (matches LLM, Code & Programming, RLHF/Alignment, and RL preferences). The core methodological contribution - decoupling RL reward from per-language sandboxes via a learned cross-encoder reward model to scale to 600 directed pairs - is genuine but incremental, combining KodCode, MultiPL-E transpilation, and standard GRPO; HumanEval-X++ is a mechanical benchmark extension. Rigor is limited by absent ablations (no RM-based vs direct execution-reward GRPO comparison, no SFT/best-of-n baseline, no reward-model accuracy report), single runs with no statistical measures, and a text-vs-table numerical inconsistency in thinking-mode results. Evidence includes detailed per-language tables and a concrete failure analysis, but baselines are only the untrained base models from one model family. No artifact release statement is made despite full hyperparameter disclosure.

primary_link.title: Bootstrapping Niche Multilingual Code Translation via Reinforcement Learning with Execution-Based Verifiable Supervision

papers.summary: Code translation must preserve executable behavior across many programming languages, yet neural code translation has largely focused on a few popular languages such as C++, Java, and Python. This leaves a niche, many-to-many setting where parallel supervision is sparse, producing plausible but non-executable translations. We address this setting with preference-based reinforcement learning driven by execution-based supervision. Our pipeline firstly expands verifiable seed Python programs into a
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對神經程式碼翻譯偏重大眾語言（C++、Java、Python）、在語言監督稀疏的長尾多對多場景中易產生看似合理卻無法執行的翻譯之問題。作者提出 NicheCodeTranslator，以執行驗證為基礎的自舵管線建立可擴展的監督訊號：Stage 1 從 KodCode 挑選 Python 種子程式，由 LLM 合成沙盒執行驗證的斷言並以 AST 分析補上型別標註；Stage 2 透過 MultiPL-E 的規則式轉譯器將測試與介面確定性地匯出至 24 種其他語言，只接受通過沙盒執行的候選，產出 184,626 個執行驗證的原始程式；Stage 3 讓基礎模型在 25×24=600 個有向語言對上生成翻譯候選，依執行結果標註正負例，得到 717,083 個偏好配對。訓練分兩步：先以 Bradley–Terry 目標在 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 上訓練跨編碼器獎勵模型，再用 GRPO 以群組相對優勢最佳化 Qwen3.5 4B/9B 政策模型，避免 RL 過程需為每種語言維護沙盒。評測方面，作者提出 HumanEval-X++，將 HumanEval-X 的 6 種源語言擴展至 25 種目標語言，並依 GitHub Innovation Graph 推送者數量將目標語言分為 Popular、Mid-tier 與 Long-tail 三層。結果顯示 GRPO 訓練在所有條件下皆帶來增益：4B 模型在 Non-Thinking 模式平均提升 13.21 分（45.08→58.29），9B 模型提升 13.62 分；Mid-tier 語言增益最大（4B +21.54）。個別語言分析顯示最大改善來自 Perl（9.2→67.8）、Ruby（29.9→86.8）、Lua（26.7→76.4）等原先極差的語言，主因是編譯錯誤大幅減少（4,222→2,538 案例）。然而 Long-tail 語言中 Ada、OCaml、Clojure、Racket 等功能式或宣告式語言改善有限。在 CodeScope 上亦有 14.58→15.52（4B）與 26.76→28.78（9B）等增益。限制包括資源受限僅做單次超參數掃描、結果無統計顯著性報告，以及獎勵模型可能繼承執行驗證標籤的偏差。本文示範以學習型獎勵取代逐語言沙盒，穩定擴展至 25 語言的策略訓練，為長尾程式語言翻譯的自舵式改進奠定基礎。

links.title: Skill Blocks: How Should an Agent Load Its Skill? A Caching-Correct Comparison of Pre-load, On-Demand Tool-Loading, Progressive Disclosure, and Hybrid

evidence: Abstract: on SearchQA (n=1,400) hybrid reduces input by 27.4% while Skill Block increases it by 48.4%; on ScienceWorld (n=84) Skill Block and hybrid reduce effective input by 62.5% and 52.8%

Section 3.1: 'the estimand is packaging plus required scaffolding, not a byte-identical prompt intervention'; four mechanisms retain same available content but differ in tool schema, catalogs, and stubs

Section 4.1: primary experiments used a GitHub Copilot production endpoint reported as gpt-5.5; 'the absolute scores apply to this endpoint'; 'logs likewise do not retain provider-returned model identifiers'

Section 5.2: cache reads constitute 74–94% of raw input; SynthProc reference raw input 70,528 exceeds full's 65,380 while effective input 18,428 is 14.8% below full's 21,617 — an accounting inversion motivating the effective-input metric

Section 7 Limitations: non-significant McNemar tests 'do not prove equivalence'; SearchQA/SpreadsheetBench evaluated iteratively on final cases making outcome family exploratory; n=84 primary analysis excludes six abort-affected IDs from a historical run with incomplete call telemetry

Section 5.3: configured gpt-5.6 ScienceWorld rerun (n=90) gives hybrid −68.8% / Skill Block −67.8% / reference −58.5% effective input with Holm-adjusted p=.116, framed as same-provider configuration transfer only

Appendix A.1: commands, file layouts, public harness locations, retained result bundles, and analysis-script usage documented in repository README, but SpreadsheetBench correction replay requires prediction workbooks and trajectories omitted from the public repository for size
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly aligned with agent/tool-use and LLM inference-efficiency preferences: a systems study of how agent skills (instruction documents) should enter context across pre-load, on-demand tool loading, progressive disclosure, and hybrid mechanisms. Methodological care is high (paired item designs, bootstrap CIs, exact McNemar with Holm correction, cache-correct 'effective input' accounting, extensive confound disclosure), but novelty is modest: no new method, a post-hoc cost model, and a mechanism comparison whose estimand conflates packaging with required scaffolding. Evidence for token savings is robust and replicated across two configured endpoints on large-skill regimes, yet outcome equivalence is not established, model identity is not provider-attested, all runs are same-provider/single-run, and key comparisons carry disclosed confounds (aggressive SearchQA nudge, non-content-parity static control, SynthProc refusal loop, exploratory reuse of final splits). Generalizability and reproducibility are limited by an opaque production endpoint, unverifiable model identifiers, and partially omitted artifacts.

primary_link.title: Skill Blocks: How Should an Agent Load Its Skill? A Caching-Correct Comparison of Pre-load, On-Demand Tool-Loading, Progressive Disclosure, and Hybrid

papers.summary: Agent skills are often injected in full on every request, increasing token cost. We compare four content-preserving loading methods: Full, Skill Block, Reference, and Hybrid. Across SearchQA, SpreadsheetBench, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SynthProc, we measure token usage using raw input for single-turn tasks and cache-correct effective input for multi-turn tasks. Results show no universal winner. Hybrid reduces input by 27.4% on SearchQA and 39.8% on SpreadsheetBench. On large multi-turn skills,
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究一個務實的系統問題：在技能內容固定的前提下，何時應將技能的各部分呈現給模型。作者比較四種載入機制：full（完整預載）、Skill Block（只保留小型核心，模型可透過工具載入可選區塊）、reference（以目錄搭配漸進式揭露）與 hybrid（先給精簡摘要、不足時才載入完整區塊）。評估涵蓋 SearchQA、SpreadsheetBench、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 與自建合成基準 SynthProc 五個場景，並區分單輪（以 raw input 為主指標）與多輪（多數 token 為快取讀取，故另採 effective input，將快取讀取以 d=0.1 折價計入）兩類會計。主要發現：單輪任務中，小技能的 SearchQA 上 hybrid 減少 27.4% 輸入，而被強烈鼓勵載入的 Skill Block 反而增加 48.4%（載入率 2.05 次/查詢），顯示工具 schema 與往返開銷可能超過未使用內容的節省；大技能的 SpreadsheetBench 上 hybrid、Skill Block、reference 分別減少 39.8%、35.6%、31.7%，而靜態修剪的 original8 達 55.5%，但因不具內容對等性僅屬探索性比較。多輪任務中，小而必需的 ALFWorld 上 Skill Block 僅省 12.6%，考量輸出成本後近乎持平；大且可壓縮的 ScienceWorld 上 Skill Block 與 hybrid 分別減少 62.5% 與 52.8% 的有效輸入，SynthProc 上達 73.0% 與 66.6%。配對 McNemar 檢定在主要比較中未偵測出品質差異，但作者強調這不等於等價或無退化。以 gpt-5.6 設定重跑 ScienceWorld 與 SynthProc 保留大技能模式，惟受限於同提供商測試、無法取得提供商確認的模型身分，以及 SynthProc 上「SECRET KEY」拒答混淆因素。貢獻在於提出未使用內容質量與往返開銷的損益平衡模型、快取校正會計，以及情境化的決策規則：單輪小技能若需完整內容用 hybrid，大而可壓縮的多輪技能則優先評估 Skill Block 與 hybrid。

evidence: Abstract: 'BGE-M3 reaches Recall@20=0.86 but only F1@5=0.254, and even the visual retriever ColPali reaches only F1@5=0.332'
§4.2 Table 1: cross-pool isolation, ColPali+ann.+rerank F1 0.581 vs PageIndex 0.480; all five reranked pools exceed PageIndex
§4.3 Table 2: snippet-only LLM rerank MRR 0.524→0.523 (BGE-M3) and 0.692→0.598 (ColPali); caption-only recovers MRR 0.692/0.744
Appendix I Table 9: drop concept_hits on ColPali F1 +0.013, drop entities +0.007; caption-only −0.027 from full
Appendix F: 'None of the pairwise comparisons between top-tier pipelines ... reach p<0.05 at N=300'; retrieval Wilcoxon p<0.001 vs raw baselines
Appendix K: caption leakage audit 22/238=9.2% exact substring, 0/238 bigram Jaccard≥0.3
Appendix H Table 8: offline indexing $0.256 per 100-page doc; per-query rerank $0.010
Appendix L: inter-judge Cohen's κ=0.913 (GPT-4.1 vs Claude Sonnet 4.5), no human evaluation performed
§4.1: 'Retrieval metrics are reported on the N=830 answerable subset... End-to-end accuracy is reported on a 300-QA stratified subset'
Appendix M: 'we leave a full small-reranker / open-source-reranker sweep for follow-up work due to budget constraints'
§5 Limitations: 'most lift comes from visual captions, a caption-first variant is preferable when other fields are costly'
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM/RAG/multimodal document QA work (LLM rerankers, RAG, VLM captioning; not pure CV). Preference match is strong for LLM (GPT-4.1 reranker), RAG & Knowledge, and Multimodal AI. Novelty is moderate: the paper itself concedes caption-based reranking is 'common in industry RAG systems but academically underexplored' (§2), and its own ablations (Appendix I, Table 9) show caption-only recovers ~90% of the lift (−0.028/−0.027 F1 from full), while dropping concept_hits/entities on ColPali slightly improves F1 (+0.013/+0.007), undercutting the multi-aspect framing. Rigor is above average: cross-pool isolation over five retrievers (§4.2, Table 1), mechanism ablations (§4.3, Table 2), bootstrap/Wilcoxon/McNemar tests (Appendix F), cost accounting (Appendix H), and a caption-leakage audit (Appendix K, 9.2% substring, 0% bigram). However, end-to-end claims rest on a 300-QA subset where 'none of the pairwise comparisons between top-tier pipelines reach p<0.05' (Appendix F), only GPT-4.1 is tested as reranker (Appendix M defers open-source sweep), and the router contributes only −0.003 F1 (Appendix D). Evidence is strong on retrieval (ColPali 0.332→0.581 F1; all pools beat PageIndex 0.480) and consistent across two judges (κ=0.913, Appendix L) but weak on generation. Generalizability is partially validated: five pools on one benchmark plus a LongDocURL transfer check (§4.5, Table 4), but reranker-agnostic and parser-substitution claims are untested. Reproducibility is aided by full prompts (Appendices B–D), token-level costs, and stated code/QA-id release, yet depends on proprietary APIs (GPT-4.1, GPT-4o-mini, PageIndex API).

papers.summary: Long-document visual question answering (VQA) over documents of tens to hundreds of pages mixing text, tables, charts, and figures typically follows retrieve-then-read pipelines. In our setting, the bottleneck shifts from retrieval recall to reranker-side evidence selection: on MMLongBench-Doc, BGE-M3 reaches Recall@20 = 0.86 but only F1@5 = 0.254, and even the visual retriever ColPali reaches only F1@5 = 0.332; a text-only rerank LLM seeing only raw snippets misses table, chart, and layout evid
papers.summary_zh: 本文指出長文件視覺問答（VQA）的瓶頸已從檢索召回轉移到重排序端的證據選擇：在 MMLongBench-Doc 上，BGE-M3 雖達 Recall@20=0.86，但 F1@5 僅 0.254，連視覺檢索器 ColPali 也只有 0.332；若僅給文字型 LLM 重排序器原始片段，不僅無法提升首名命中率（BGE-M3 的 MRR 由 0.524 微降至 0.523，ColPali 更由 0.692 跌至 0.598），因為文件證據常鎖在表格、圖表與版面中。作者提出 Trident 框架，包含兩個互補元件：Trident-R 是檢索器無關的 LLM 重排序器，先離線將每頁轉為 LLM 可讀的語意記錄（VLM 生成的視覺標題、章節路徑、實體標籤、主題/實體/結構三軸概念命中與文字片段），再以單次自適應 K≤5 的重排序呼叫完成選擇；Trident-S 則在生成端以主題、實體與結構三種視角平行提示 VLM，再由合成呼叫整合答案。離線索引成本約每 100 頁文件 0.256 美元。實驗在 MMLongBench-Doc 五種異質候選池（BM25、BGE-M3、RRF、ColPali、多軸 xKG）上進行跨池隔離測試：所有池經標註+重排序後 F1 全面超越最強的自適應 K 基線 PageIndex，例如 BGE-M3 由 0.254 提升至 0.546，ColPali 由 0.332 提升至 0.581，顯示效益並非僅補足文字檢索器的視覺資訊。消融分析顯示僅視覺標題即可恢復大部分提升（兩池 caption-only 與 full 僅差 0.028/0.027），而移除標題在 BGE-M3 損失更大（−0.130 vs −0.083）。端到端 QA 上，最佳配置（ColPali+標註+重排序+Trident-S）在 300-QA 子集達 53.7% Gen Acc，且排名在 GPT-4.1 與 Claude 兩位評審間一致（κ=0.913）；LongDocURL 轉移檢測亦確認趨勢。Trident-S 主要對開放式綜合題有效（+1.7 至 +6.6 分），對選擇與短抽取題貢獻近零，故定位為依題型條件啟用的延伸。限制包括離線索引成本、以 PageIndex 作為章節解析器的角色重疊疑慮，以及重排序模型僅測試 GPT-4.1。

evidence: Abstract and Section 5.4/Table 1: logistic probe 0.959±0.039 at layer 15 for honorifics vs 0.641 random baseline; isr/io pre-token probes 0.476/0.376 at or below chance across five stratified splits.

Section 5.5/Table 2: length-normalised teacher-forced flip rates 0.929 (hon), 0.768 (isr), 0.786 (io), 0.429 (ref); Section 5.7 shows raw ref Δ = -34 nats collapsing after normalisation, exposing the probe as a dataset artefact.

Section 5.6: PRS is evaluated only indirectly via the CAA baseline (0.947 vs 0.959 on honorifics); the (ℓ,α) grid search, MMLU/HellaSwag capability-preservation controls, and Llama-3.1-Swallow-8B transfer are 'the core of the continuing programme', not this paper.

Section 5.2: J-PragEval-v0 items are author-written by the single author with annotator_agreement tags; 56 items per feature (224 total); batch 02 with independent native-speaker annotation and adversarial filtering is 'in preparation'.
Section 5.1: all experiments run on TinySwallow-1.5B-Instruct only; the 8B cross-model reference and English-first baselines were 'outside the compute budget of this study'.

Section 5.8: Docker image, poetry-locked environment, fixed seeds, and release of probe weights, cached activations, and per-chunk results on Hugging Face Hub are claimed, though no release URL is present in the document.
Section 7.1: authors acknowledge n=56 per feature is 'small by contemporary probing standards' and that isr/io likely need non-linear probes, SAEs, or token-by-token probe positions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: High preference fit: Japanese SLM (TinySwallow-1.5B) interpretability, linear probing, a new Japanese pragmatic minimal-pair benchmark, and activation-steering specification align strongly with Japanese LLM/NLP and interpretability preferences. The paper is commendably honest (reports sub-chance probes, diagnoses the indirect-refusal probe as a length/leakage confound) and includes random-direction baselines, 5-split averaging, and a length-normalisation ablation. However, the headline intervention (PRS) is only specified with an indirect CAA feasibility argument, activation/path patching is deferred, the 224-item benchmark is self-annotated (n=56 per feature, no independent native-speaker annotation yet), all results come from a single 1.5B model, and the 8B transfer, MMLU/HellaSwag capability controls, and (l, alpha) search are explicitly future work, which caps evidence strength, novelty (established probe/CAA/steering toolkit applied to a new domain), and generalizability.

primary_link.title: Interpretable Cross-Lingual Alignment in Small Language Models: Probing Cultural and Pragmatic Reasoning in Japanese-English Bilingual LLMs

papers.summary:
Large language models work well on English and behave in poorly understood ways on languages typologically far from it. Japanese is a clean example, where evaluation still leans on translation quality and JGLUE-style benchmarks, which roll lexical, syntactic and pragmatic competence into a single score. The phenomena on which general-purpose models fail Japanese users are pragmatic: honorifics, in-group and out-group reference, context-sensitive politeness, zero anaphora.
  I introduce J-PragEva
papers.summary_zh: 本文聚焦日英雙語小型語言模型（SLM）在語用與文化面向的內部表徵，針對現行以翻譯品質與 JGLUE 類基準為主的評測無法反映敬語、隱含主語、內外集團指涉與間接拒絕等日語語用能力之問題。作者提出 J-PragEval-v0，一套每特徵 56 題、共 224 題的最小對比（minimal-pair）基準，確保正確答案由語用而非語意決定，並附標註者一致度標籤。方法上結合線性探針（logistic 迴歸、CAA 類均值差方向、隨機方向基線）、教師強制的長度正規化 log 機率評估，與情境翻轉率等行為指標，探測 TinySwallow-1.5B-Instruct（28 層、隱藏維度 1536，建於 Qwen2.5 架構）的殘差流。關鍵發現呈三組分化：(1) 敬語登錄在殘差流中線性可解碼，探針在第 15 層達 0.959 平衡準確率，情境翻轉率高達 0.929；(2) 隱含主語與內外集團指涉在最終提示 token 處不可線性解碼（0.476 與 0.376，低於隨機基線），但行為翻轉率分別為 0.768 與 0.786，顯示這些對比在生成過程中動態運算而非儲存於提示端表徵；(3) 間接拒絕是負面案例：探針雖達 0.953，但長度正規化後翻轉率僅 0.429，作者診斷為資料集設計缺陷（續寫長度偏差與殘餘情境洩漏）而非模型能力問題。在介入方面，作者提出 Pragmatic Representation Steering（PRS），一種無參數的推論期方法，沿探針識別的類均值差方向編輯殘差流激活，並透過 CAA 基線（與 logistic 探針差距僅 1–2 分）間接論證其可行性。完整的 PRS 行為評估、向 Llama-3.1-Swallow-8B 的跨模型遷移，以及 MMLU/HellaSwag 上的能力保持測量，留待後續計畫。限制包括僅測試單一 1.5B 模型、n=56 每特徵樣本偏小，以及語用金標反映有限標註者偏好。本文的價值在於將文化勝任力視為可探測、定位與編輯的表徵屬性，並警示線性探針在小型最小對比集上易受資料混淆影響，只有行為檢驗才能揭示。
papers.title: Interpretable Cross-Lingual Alignment in Small Language Models: Probing Cultural and Pragmatic Reasoning in Japanese-English Bilingual LLMs
papers.title_zh: 小型語言模型中的可解釋跨語言對齊：日英雙語 LLM 的文化與語用推理探針

links.title: Wyvern: An Agentic Framework for Generating Grounded Multimodal Reports

evidence: Abstract & Sec. 3: multi-agent LLM framework with search, report generation, and grounding modules; claims auto-revision stage
Sec. 4.1: DeepSeek-R1 for reasoning agents, DeepSeek-V3 otherwise, temperature 0; Serper API; thresholds lambda_comp=lambda_search=5, lambda_link=7, lambda_sim=0.9; LangChain implementation
Sec. 4.2: baselines STORM, WebThinker, WikiAutoGen, with proprietary models replaced by open-source alternatives, which may weaken baseline comparability
Sec. 4.3: human study, 27 volunteers, 23 completed questionnaires, 9 comparisons per baseline, randomized and blinded order; no statistical significance testing reported
Table 2 / Sec. 5.2.1: claims revision ablation, citation recall 60.92±6.10% -> 73.79±5.44%, precision 67.15% -> 75.45%
Sec. 5.2.2: automatic evaluators fail on WebThinker trends; ordering bias in 36.11% (DeepSeek-V3) and 30.56% (Qwen3-32B) of comparisons
Appendix B.3: 60 randomly sampled claims manually checked, 93.33% agreement with LLM grounding judgments
Sec. 4.4.1: citation recall/precision defined via an 'NLI model' whose identity is not specified in the main text
Limitations: English-only topic evaluation; search-API nondeterminism limits reproducibility; Conclusions: code and data at github.com/huawei-csl/wyvern
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic LLM framework (DeepSeek-R1/V3 agents) for grounded multimodal report generation with web retrieval, citation verification and auto-revision squarely in-scope for agents/LLM/RAG preferences. Contribution is primarily systems integration: outline-then-expand (STORM-style), image insertion (WikiAutoGen-style) plus a claims verification/revision stage (Table 1 claims only the combination is new); no new modeling methodology. Rigor is moderate: blinded, order-randomized human study (23 of 27 questionnaires; only ~9 comparisons per baseline) with no significance testing, an ablation showing claims revision lifts citation recall 60.92%->73.79% (Table 2), automatic metrics on just 9 reports per baseline, a 60-claim manual agreement check (93.33%, App. B.3), and honest LLM-as-judge bias analysis (ordering bias 36.11%/30.56%, Sec. 5.2.2). Headline 2.3x recall is consistent with reported deltas (73.79 vs ~31.45 for WikiAutoGen) but rests on small samples. Generalizability limited: English-only topics, many hand-set thresholds (Sec. 4.1), DeepSeek-specific, search-API dependence. Reproducibility aided by released code and detailed hyperparameters, but the NLI model used for grounding metrics is not named (Sec. 4.4.1) and search results are nondeterministic (Limitations).

primary_link.title: Wyvern: An Agentic Framework for Generating Grounded Multimodal Reports

papers.summary: In the current artificial intelligence-driven innovation era, the pace of knowledge growth is accelerating, and is hard to keep up with. While generative models are increasingly used to synthesize content, they often lack in information grounding. To address these peculiarities of our time, we propose Wyvern, a multi-agent framework for the automated generation of grounded, multimodal technical reports. Wyvern allows for the generation of multimodal outputs, integrating images, tables, and text
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出 Wyvern，一個自動生成有依據（grounded）、多模態技術報告的多代理框架，回應生成模型內容缺乏資訊依據的問題。框架由多個 LLM 代理協同運作：(1) 搜尋模組透過 Serper API 檢索網頁，以多代理評分機制過濾內容完整度、補充搜尋、提取嵌入連結、Jaccard 相似度去重，並以 Chain-of-Thought 代理偵測語意離題文件；(2) 報告生成模組採大綱建立與章節擴展的兩階段流程，並設計圖片選擇與插入管線：先為來源文件中的所有圖片生成描述，再由推理代理選出最相關且資訊豐富的圖片並分配到適當章節，另自動插入概覽表格與進行最終潤飾；(3) 依據模組將報告文字分解為原子級主張，先對照參考文獻摘要、再對照全文進行兩階段 NLI 驗證，不支援的主張由修訂代理修正或移除，最後統一修訂標題與內容一致性。所有代理以 DeepSeek-R1（推理）與 DeepSeek-V3（一般）實作。人類評估邀請 27 位志願者（完成 23 份問卷），結果顯示 Wyvern 報告的圖片資訊性在 87% 的情況下優於 WikiAutoGen，相較 STORM、WebThinker 與 WikiAutoGen 的有用性偏好率分別為 100%、62.5% 與 87.5%；事實性與概覽表格的絕對評分達 4.22 與 4.25（滿分 5）。自動評估方面，Wyvern 的引用召回率達 73.79%（較 STORM 與 WikiAutoGen 高 21.50 與 42.34 個百分點），主張修訂模組使引用召回率從 60.92% 提升至 73.79%、引用精確率達 75.45%，相對基線最高達 2.3 倍召回與 1.6 倍精確。研究亦揭露自動評估的局限：DeepSeek-V3 與 Qwen3-32B 在 36.11% 與 30.56% 的比較中出現順序偏見，Prometheus 2-7B 則始終偏好首位報告，顯示 LLM 自動評估與人類判斷仍有落差。限制包括依賴搜尋 API 導致再現性受限、僅支援英文主題、以及框架不過濾來源本身的偏誤或錯誤資訊。
papers.title: Wyvern: An Agentic Framework for Generating Grounded Multimodal Reports
papers.title_zh: Wyvern：生成有依據多模態報告的代理式框架

links.title: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation

evidence: Abstract/Table 2: S2VOPD improves Qwen3.5-4B from 70.68% to 77.44% average over six perception benchmarks, above Qwen3-VL-Instruct-235B (75.75%) and GPT-5.4 (72.77%).

Section 4.3: base 70.58% vs symmetric self-distillation 65.21%; each augmentation family improves (information reduction 75.65%, photometric 74.40%, geometric 74.30%, occlusion 72.44%); accuracy peaks at teacher-student JS gap ~0.014.
Section 4.3: strong cropping monotonically degrades (71.53% -> 67.44%) because the gap becomes task-inconsistent, showing the 'larger gap is not better' analysis.
Table 3: on identical Vision-OPD-6K data, S2VOPD averages 75.33 (4B) and 76.35 (9B), exceeding TTRL (73.30), Intuitor (70.51), RENT (70.61) at 4B and privileged Vision-OPD (74.77).

Table 4/Section 4.4: w/o Aug. collapses to 70.52%; frozen teacher reaches 75.95% (0.40% below default), indicating supervision comes from view asymmetry rather than EMA; note Table 4's 4B avg 76.35 conflicts with Table 3's 75.33, and the text cites Table 6 for EMA decay values shown in Table 5.

Section 4.1: full protocol given (batch 96 prompts, n=8 rollouts, lr 2e-6, EMA eta=0.05, 65/130 steps, FineVision 12K, decoding settings); project website given but no explicit code/data release stated; no variance or significance reporting.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A VLM post-training methodology paper: on-policy token-level distillation where teacher-student asymmetry is created by degrading the student's image view instead of adding privileged information. Clearly within LLM-adjacent territory (on-policy distillation over token distributions, math reasoning gains) and Multimodal AI, not a pure CV/domain application. The core inversion is a clean idea, but it is closely related to semi-supervised consistency regularization (FixMatch-style weak/strong views) and existing augmented-view RL work (NoisyRollout, VPPO), so novelty is solid but incremental. Experimental coverage is strong: same-data comparisons against privileged-distillation and self-rewarding RL baselines, systematic augmentation-family/strength/divergence/EMA ablations. Evidence is weakened by single-run results without variance, analysis runs at a reduced 2,048-token budget, and internal inconsistencies (Table 4's 'S2VOPD-4B' avg of 76.35 exceeds Table 3's 4B row of 75.33 under a supposedly identical setup; Section 4.4 cites Table 6 for EMA decay values that appear in Table 5). Reproducibility is decent for hyperparameters and data but no code artifact is explicitly stated. Headline claims (beating GPT-5.4, matching Qwen3.5-397B) are benchmark-average specific and should be read cautiously.

primary_link.title: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation

papers.summary: Visual on-policy distillation relies heavily on an informative teacher-student asymmetry, through either a larger, stronger teacher or privileged supervision, such as reference answers or ground-truth regions of interest. This raises a fundamental question: where can informative asymmetry come from when nothing privileged is available? We answer this by inverting where the asymmetry comes from. Rather than adding privileged information to the teacher, we subtract information from the student. Th
papers.summary_zh: 視覺 on-policy 蒸餾（OPD）仰賴教師與學生間的資訊不對稱，傳統做法需要更強的教師模型或特權監督（如標準答案、關注區域標註）。本文反向思考：不替教師增加資訊，而是從學生端扣減資訊。作者提出 S2VOPD，以 EMA 教師觀察原始影像，學生則在強增強視圖（降解析度至 0.3–0.6 倍並加上高斯雜訊）上產生軌跡，再以 top-k 廣義 Jensen–Shannon 散度將教師分布蒸餾給學生，全程無需標註、獎勵或額外教師模型。透過大規模增強空間搜尋，作者歸納三項準則：不對稱性必須存在（對稱自蒸餾反而使效能退化）、強度須適中、資訊差須保留與問題相關的證據（過度裁切會製造無意義的落差）。在六項細粒度感知基準上，S2VOPD 將 Qwen3.5-4B 由 70.7% 提升至 77.4%，超越 Qwen3-VL-Instruct-235B 與 GPT-5.4，並在相同訓練資料下達到特權監督方法約 96% 的增益。限制在於增強設計需謹慎，不當增強會削弱監督訊號。此研究顯示自建不對稱性可免費產生有效的感知對齊訓練訊號。
papers.title: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation
papers.title_zh: S2VOPD：自監督式視覺 On-Policy 蒸餾

links.title: AutoSchema: Live Schema Grounding for Agentic Text-to-Sparql over Heterogeneous Knowledge Graphs

evidence: Abstract: 'autoschema improves mean factoid accuracy over TogoMCP in the biomedical KGQA tasks... It also reduces iteration budget exhaustion and uses fewer tool calls on average in the core evaluation.'

Section 4.4: 'We evaluate two models with open weights, gpt-oss-120b and gemma4-31b. Each model is served locally through vLLM on one NVIDIA A100 GPU... We use a limit of 20 iterations in every compared setting.'
Section 4.4: 'Predictions are matched to gold synonyms using exact matching, lexical matching, and an LLM judge for unresolved pairs' — introduces judge-dependent scoring without significance tests.
Table 2: gpt-oss-120b factoid acc AutoSchema 0.260±.005 vs TogoMCP 0.198±.009; limit rate 33.5% vs 44.0%.

Section 4.3: benchmark questions built by graphlet-anchored generation — 'ask a language model to express the fragment as a natural language question without seeing the answer' — a self-constructed evaluation rather than standard benchmarks.
Section 4.9: TogoMCP MIE creation 'takes 28.2 minutes, 221,834 model tokens, and 106 tool calls. Live indexing takes 37.4 seconds and no model tokens'; Table 6 transfer results are 'from one run'.
Section 5: 'The dedicated bridge capability was rarely selected, some multi resource gains are noisy, and the external transfer experiment contains only one run.'

Appendix A.1: 'surveys at most 25 classes and 40 properties per class' with cached live index; Appendix A.3 gives the full evaluation prompt policy, but no code/data release is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic text-to-SPARQL framework (MCP server exposing four live schema-grounding tools) evaluated against TogoMCP and a no-schema baseline with two open-weight LLMs, which aligns well with high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RAG/knowledge grounding); it is not a pure domain application since the framework is domain-agnostic and includes an out-of-domain chemistry transfer, though evaluation is heavily biomedical. Novelty is moderate: live question-time endpoint grounding instead of curated MIE files is a sensible reframing, but it builds on the authors' own SAGA work and sits near existing agentic-SPARQL/MCP and schema-retrieval lines (Dobriy et al. 2026; SG-KBQA; Interactive-KBQA). Rigor is solid: controlled same-model/same-budget comparison, three runs with std, a single-shot ablation, cost/latency analysis, and honest limitation discussion (bridge tool rarely used, noisy multi-resource gains, one-run transfer). Evidence is decent but not definitive: consistent directional gains (e.g., Table 2 factoid 0.260 vs 0.198 for gpt-oss-120b; positive across six BioASQ years) coexist with overlapping confidence ranges in Table 3, LLM-judge-based answer matching, and a self-constructed graphlet benchmark whose questions are LLM-generated; no statistical significance testing. Generalizability is plausible but only preliminarily demonstrated beyond RDF Portal graphs. Reproducibility is middling: Appendix A details tool signatures, sampling limits (25 classes/40 properties/class), and the prompt policy, and models/endpoints are public, but no code or benchmark release is stated.

primary_link.title: AutoSchema: Live Schema Grounding for Agentic Text-to-Sparql over Heterogeneous Knowledge Graphs

papers.summary: Life science knowledge graphs make large collections of structured data available through SPARQL, but each resource uses its own schema, identifiers, and links. TogoMCP helps language model agents query these resources by providing curated Metadata Interoperability Exchange files. Creating and maintaining these files still requires language model assisted drafting, validation, and manual review. We study \emph{live schema grounding}, where an agent obtains the schema evidence needed for a questi
papers.summary_zh: 生命科學知識圖譜各自擁有不同的 schema、識別碼與連結方式，語言模型代理在產生 SPARQL 查詢時常因缺乏結構證據而虛構述詞或識別碼。現行 TogoMCP 仰賴經人工審核的 MIE 描述檔，建立與維護成本高且容易過時。本文提出「即時 schema 定位」問題與 AutoSchema 框架：不需訓練，由代理在問題當下直接檢視線上端點，透過四項工具——來源摘要、實體解析、關聯與路徑探索、跨資料庫橋接——取得結構證據後撰寫並執行查詢。評估採用開源權重模型（gpt-oss-120b 與 gemma4-31b），在單資源與多資源生物醫學 KGQA 上，AutoSchema 的事實型題準確率均高於 TogoMCP，並降低迭代上限觸發率與平均工具呼叫次數；跨六個年度的 BioASQ 測試集亦呈現一致增益。轉移實驗顯示其可處理無預建描述檔的 tmQM-RDF 化學圖譜，但僅為單次初步結果。整體而言，此研究證明以問題時刻的端點觀測取代靜態 schema 檔案，可讓知識圖譜代理在資料持續變動下保持可用，惟橋接模組使用率偏低，部分多資源增益尚待驗證。

links.title: Training Fair Tabular Foundation Models

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: proposes FairTFM with 'synthetic fairness tasks and a fairness-aware architecture using a gradient reversal layer'; claims 'improving fairness by 32-75% relative to the strongest TFM baseline at accuracy costs of 2-11%'.

Section 3.3 and Algorithm 1: pretraining objective L = CE(y_hat, y) + lambda * CE(s_hat, s) with GRL reversing gradients from the sensitive-attribute head; lambda in {0.1, 0.7, 10, 25} controls the trade-off.

Section 4.1: benchmark of 120 tasks from ACS PUMS via folktables as 5 prediction problems x 3 sensitive attributes (Gender, Age, Race) x 8 US states, plus 12 tasks from six non-ACS fairness benchmarks (Appendix E.6).
Section 4 (reproducibility): 'we provide the inference code, pretrained checkpoints, and scripts for reproducing the main results at github.com/patrikken/FairTFM-inference'.

Appendix D: backbone has 6 transformer layers, 6 heads, embedding dim 192; pretraining on 300,000 synthetic datasets from TabICL's prior, 150 datapoints, 6 features, 2 classes, batch size 32, Schedule-Free AdamW lr 1e-4.
Table 2 (Appendix E.1): FairTFM-0.7 accuracy 0.729+/-0.07 and DP 0.077 vs TabPFNv2.5 accuracy 0.770+/-0.05 and DP 0.121; FairPFN attains lowest DP (0.043) but lowest AUCROC (0.695).
Table 1 (Section 4.2): linear-probe AUC for sensitive attribute drops from 0.783 (raw) to 0.542 (FairTFM-25) while label AUC declines 0.834 to 0.787, supporting selective information suppression.

Limitations section: pretraining relies only on TabICL's prior; model does not dominate EG fairness baselines for age as sensitive attribute (Section 4.2, Figure 11); uses lightweight nanoTabPFN backbone, with scaling to TabPFNv2.5/TabICLv2 left as future work.
Appendix E.7: EG baselines require retraining 33x12x3 configurations and drop XGB AUCROC from 0.803 to ~0.70, whereas FairTFM-0.7 keeps AUCROC at 0.803 with better targeted fairness metrics.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solid, well-executed empirical work on injecting statistical group fairness (DP/EOD/EOP) into tabular foundation model pretraining via synthetic fairness tasks plus a gradient-reversal adversarial head, but it is tangential to the curator's LLM/NLP/agents-centered preference profile. Genuine overlaps exist with AI Safety (fairness, bias, adversarial), in-context learning, and transformer pretraining, though no language-model methodology is involved and it is not in any listed out-of-scope category. Methodologically it combines established tools (GRL adversarial fairness, TabICL-style synthetic priors) in a new TFM setting; the paper credibly claims to be the first TFM pretrained for statistical group fairness, with FairPFN (causal fairness) as the only prior. Rigor is strong: 120 ACS tasks (5x3x8 factorial design), 12 non-ACS tasks, classical and fairness-aware baselines (EG reduction), representation-learning comparisons, probing, 3 seeds with stds, and an honest limitations section (does not dominate EG on age-as-sensitive; lightweight nanoTabPFN backbone; uncontrolled FairPFN comparison). Evidence is quantitatively supported (e.g., 32-75% fairness gains at 2-11% accuracy cost, Table 3; probing AUC 0.783 to 0.542 for sensitive attribute, Table 1). Generalizability is confined to small tabular classification (3.5k-12k samples); extension to larger backbones is left to future work. Reproducibility is good: public inference code, checkpoints, and result scripts with full hyperparameters (Appendix D), though pretraining-code availability is not explicitly stated.

primary_link.title: Training Fair Tabular Foundation Models

radar.summary: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) have emerged as leading methods for tabular predictive tasks, leveraging in-context learning to predict on new data without task-specific training. Despite the increased use of TFMs in high-stakes decision-making, their fairness properties remain largely unexplored. In this work, we incorporate fairness constraints directly into TFM training, enabling fair predictions in a single forward pass. Our approach addresses two key challenges: limited access to sensitive
radar.summary_zh: 表格基礎模型（TFM）如 TabPFNv2、TabICLv2 透過 in-context learning 在單次前向傳播內完成預測，廣泛用於高風險決策，但其偏見問題少有探討，且傳統公平性技術難以套用於此推論範式。本文提出 FairTFM，首次將統計群組公平性（demographic parity、equalized odds 等）納入 TFM 預訓練。方法包含兩部分：（1）合成公平任務——對預訓練取樣的資料集隨機指定一個特徵為敏感屬性，並以 stick-breaking 量化方式離散化，毋需真實敏感標籤；（2）公平感知架構——擴充 nanoTabPFN，加入敏感屬性編碼器與經梯度反轉層（GRL）連接的對抗預測頭，促使表示學習對敏感屬性不變，推論時再以可學習遮罩取代敏感輸入。在 120 個 ACS 公平任務與 12 個非 ACS 基準上，FairTFM 相較 TabPFNv2.5 將公平性指標改善 32–75%，僅付出 2–11% 準確率代價，並在公平—效用權衡上支配 FairPFN；參數 λ 可控制權衡強度，線性探針證實敏感資訊被選擇性壓抑。限制包括僅使用合成先驗、採用輕量骨幹，且在年齡等嚴格設定下未必全面勝出。此研究證明公平性可直接內建於預訓練階段。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic LLM-for-code paper: repository-level Java→Kotlin/Scala and C#→F# migration using GPT-5.3 Codex, Claude Opus 4.6, and GPT-5.4, matching LLM and Code preferences, though it applies off-the-shelf LLMs rather than advancing language-model methodology. The core idea — raising the translation unit from files to dependency-consistent batches via SCC collapsing with compile/test-driven feedback — is a sensible but incremental systems contribution over AlphaTrans-style dependency-aware ordering, and SCC-based batch compilation is a classic technique. Evaluation is solid for a tooling paper: two baselines plus an ablation, six OSS repos, one 51K-LOC industrial system, three language pairs, three models, error-signature analysis, iteration-budget convergence, and token-cost analysis; internal numbers are mutually consistent. Weaknesses: single runs with no variance or significance testing, small N in RQ2/RQ3 (three repos each), asymmetric iteration budgets (10/file vs. unbounded), correctness capped by test-suite quality, and results confined to interoperable pairs with buildable, well-tested systems. Authors honestly report the non-100% commons-csv result (91.67%) and the batching-alone STAR failure (7.84%). A replication package (scripts, prompts, OSS repos) is released; the industrial codebase is withheld for confidentiality. Calibrated: useful, well-evidenced engineering work with moderate novelty.

primary_link.title: DepWareTrans: Dependency-Aware Incremental Repository Migration across Co-executable Languages

radar.summary: Repository-level code translation is critical for modernizing legacy systems, yet existing approaches based on large language models (LLMs) operate at the file level and fail to scale to codebases with complex inter-file dependencies. This limitation is evident in our industrial setting, where we aim to migrate a production repository (STAR) from Java to Kotlin, but file-level approaches produce fragmented results and fail to achieve end-to-end correctness. In this paper, we show that the primar
radar.summary_zh: 以大型語言模型進行儲存庫層級程式碼翻譯時，逐檔處理的方法難以應付複雜的跨檔相依。作者以企業內部 51K 行 Java 系統 STAR 遷移至 Kotlin 為動機，經實證分析指出失敗主因並非翻譯品質，而是相依不一致：錯誤訊息壓倒性地集中於「找不到符號」等連結失效。本文提出相依感知遷移框架：建構檔案級相依圖、以強連通元件（SCC）摺疊循環相依形成 DAG、將互相依賴的檔案組成相依一致的批次，再以 LLM 進行批次翻譯，配合編譯與原始測試套件驅動的迭代修正，逐步增量遷移並維持系統可編譯、可執行。在 STAR 上，逐檔基準僅達 38.16% 編譯與 9.39% 測試成功率，本方法則在少數迭代內達成 100%；方法亦推廣至 Java–Scala 與 C#–F# 語言對，並跨 GPT-5.3 Codex、Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5.4 均獲全數成功，整體 token 消耗減少約 70.5%。限制在於極大且高度耦合的中心類別（約 3K 行）仍難以自動處理，且方法僅適用於可互通執行並具備建置與測試環境的語言對。此研究顯示遷移單位應對齊相依結構，而非獨立翻譯各檔案。
radar.title: DepWareTrans: Dependency-Aware Incremental Repository Migration across Co-executable Languages
radar.title_zh: DepWareTrans：跨可共同執行語言的相依感知增量儲存庫遷移

links.title: Rollplex: Cross-Phase GPU Spatial Sharing for Vision Language Model Post-Training

evidence: Abstract/§1: Rollplex achieves 1.23x–1.30x over serial colocation and 1.57x–2.24x over disaggregation on 32 H800 GPUs for Qwen2.5-VL-32B.
§2.2/Figure 2: median prompt tokens are 79%–98% of video samples vs 11%–19% for GSM8K/MATH, motivating the input-heavy regime.
§2.4.1/Table 1: naive overlap requires ~165 GiB per GPU vs the H800's 80 GB, quantifying the memory challenge.

§4.4/Figure 8: all four ablations (no state offload, vLLM resident, unchunked optimizer, no weight sharing) run out of memory while full Rollplex stays below 80 GB; layout coverage is 60.0/32.8/7.2% for Cases 1/2/3 (92.8% shared).
§4.5/Figure 9: matched TP=8 slows rollout 1.17x–1.31x on three datasets; TP=4 rollout reduces per-step time 1.06x–1.17x via weight sharing.
§4.6/Table 2: MPS-Default stays within 2.7% of the best sharing policy; rigid 70/30 limits increase total time 1.30x–3.44x.
§4.3/Figure 7: per-step reward difference between Rollplex and colocated baseline stays near zero across four datasets.
§4.7: composition with partial rollout and oversampling yields additional 1.04x–1.23x gains.
§5: applicability envelope requires response-agnostic prefix work rivaling decode; fault isolation explicitly deferred to future work.

§4.1: setup is GRPO with N=8 (Video-R1 RLVR), 8k prompt/2k response budgets, datasets CLEVRER/PerceptionTest/LLaVA-Video-178K/STAR; implementation in ROLL with Megatron-Core 0.13.0 and vLLM 0.17.0 (§3); no code release stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems/runtime paper for synchronous GRPO post-training of Qwen2.5-VL-32B, not an LLM-methodology paper, but squarely within the LLM RLHF/RL-training-infrastructure preference space (RL post-training, vLLM serving, memory/efficiency optimization). The core idea—executing response-agnostic reference and actor prefixes inside the rollout decode window while preserving on-policy semantics—is a genuinely new scheduling point between colocation, disaggregation, and async systems, supported by an analytic critical-path model (Eq. 1, §2.3/§3.1). Evaluation is reasonably rigorous: two baselines with equal prefix-sharing optimizations (§4.2), four memory ablations that all OOM while the full system stays under 80 GB (§4.4, Fig. 8), TP-degree ablation (§4.5), resource-sharing policy study (§4.6, Table 2), and composition with async rollout optimizations (§4.7). Evidence is mostly concrete numbers, but headline gains over Colocate are modest (1.23–1.30×), Disagg comparisons are somewhat favorable to the authors, quality preservation rests on a 'near-zero' reward-difference plot (§4.3, Fig. 7), and only one model scale (32B; 7B for the policy study) on H800 hardware is tested. Generalizability is explicitly bounded: gains require prefix work rivaling decode (79–98% prompt fraction on video vs 11–19% on GSM8K/MATH, §2.2), so text-only RL would see little benefit; the authors also concede fault-tolerance limits (§5). Detailed implementation contracts (Appendix A) and pinned software versions aid reproduction, but no code release is stated. Out-of-scope categories do not apply.
topics: GPU memory management and KV cache residency

primary_link.title: Rollplex: Cross-Phase GPU Spatial Sharing for Vision Language Model Post-Training

radar.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable embodied agents to reason and act from visual observations and language instructions. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training enhances these capabilities using task feedback, but current on-policy RL runtimes execute rollout, reference scoring, and actor training in strict serial phases. While effective for text-only RL, this phase-granular execution is wasteful for VLMs, where processing dense video inputs and prompt prefixes occupies a large fraction of e
radar.summary_zh: VLM 強化學習後訓練中，rollout、參考評分與演員訓練通常按階段嚴格序列執行。但影片工作負載的提示 token 佔序列中位數 79–98%，其前置計算與回應內容無關，卻被迫等到 rollout 結束才執行，造成 GPU 運算閒置。Rollplex 將後續階段在第一個回應位置拆分為前綴與後綴，把與回應無關的前綴（視覺編碼與提示 prefill）疊合於 rollout 解碼視窗內執行，同時維持同步 on-policy 語意。為此提出兩項機制：（1）階段感知記憶體管理——依生產者—消費者生命週期控制 HBM 駐留，以 CUDA VMM 維持虛擬位址、卸載或重算龐大訓練狀態，並以分塊串流方式執行 FP32 最佳化器；（2）平行度感知權重共享——將張量分為相同分片、可轉置、不相容三類，前兩類透過 IPC 共享同一物理儲存，僅不相容張量需重建，使訓練與 rollout 得以採用不同的 tensor-parallel 度。在 32 張 H800 上訓練 Qwen2.5-VL-32B，相較序列共置加速 1.23–1.30 倍、相較分離部署加速 1.57–2.24 倍，且獎勵曲線與基線一致。速度上限受解碼視窗制約，共用 GPU 亦帶來容錯風險。
radar.title: Rollplex: Cross-Phase GPU Spatial Sharing for Vision Language Model Post-Training
radar.title_zh: Rollplex：視覺語言模型後訓練的跨階段 GPU 空間共享

links.title: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization for Model Merging

evidence: Abstract: 'MOBO-Merge obtains higher mean hypervolume than random search in 11 of 12 reported comparisons. The gain is small for one-dimensional Linear interpolation but substantially larger for several TIES, block-wise, and three-objective searches.'

Section 4.4 / Table 1: held-out hypervolume Qwen TIES 0.0847 (MOBO-Merge) vs 0.0739 (random); Llama ABC Block-Linear 0.0634 vs 0.0289; only reversal is Qwen AB Linear 0.0659 vs 0.0664 (random higher by 0.0005).

Section 5.3: paper acknowledges prior multi-objective Pareto-based merge search (Li et al. 2025a; Chen et al. 2025 BAMBO) and positions its contribution as a merge-operator-agnostic search layer with a fixed protocol across operators, families, and objective sets.

Section 4.1: 'Each benchmark is deterministically partitioned... first 30% of examples form the optimization partition and the complementary 70% form a held-out partition... deterministic decoding (temperature=0) through the LM Evaluation Harness'; seeds 42-51 (Section 4.1 Search protocol).

Section 4.3: BoTorch loop with independent SingleTaskGP per objective (ModelListGP), NEHVI maximized via Sobol QMC with 128 samples and multi-start; qNParEGO ablated in Appendix A.1 with 'neither acquisition function is uniformly more effective'.

Appendix A.4: 'Configurations, per-candidate objective values, and optimization-to-held-out mappings have been retained and will be released, together with the code... upon publication' — availability is promised, not verified.

Section 6 Limitations: repeated downstream evaluations are computationally expensive, framework restricted to shared-architecture weight-space merging, and scaling to higher-dimensional merge spaces/many objectives 'may require more expressive surrogate models and improved acquisition strategies'.
Appendix A.3: per-candidate runtimes documented (approx. 4-9 minutes on RTX 6000 Ada with vLLM-backed evaluation), supporting cost claims.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methods paper applying standard multi-objective Bayesian optimization (NEHVI, BoTorch) to LLM merge-weight selection. It is squarely LLM-centric (Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.1-8B; IFEval, zero-shot CoT GSM8K, HumanEval) and in scope, but it does not advance core LLM methodology beyond an optimization search layer, capping preference relevance. Novelty is modest: Section 5.3 itself catalogues prior single- and multi-objective BO for merging/fusion (Li et al. 2025a; Chen et al. 2025 BAMBO; Jang et al. 2024; Yuce & Amasyali 2025), leaving the operator-agnostic controlled comparison and held-out transfer protocol as the main increment. Rigor is solid: 10 seeds, deterministic 30/70 benchmark splits, acquisition-function ablation (NEHVI vs qNParEGO, Appendix A.1), and honest reporting of the one reversal (Qwen AB Linear, Table 1), though random search is the only primary baseline and dimensions are small (1-8 params). Evidence is concrete and appropriately hedged, with specific held-out hypervolume numbers (e.g., Llama ABC Block-Linear 0.0634 vs 0.0289), but significance tests are absent and code/configs are only promised 'upon publication' (Appendix A.4), weakening reproducibility. Generalizability is moderate: merge-operator agnostic across two families and two/three objectives, but restricted to shared-architecture weight-space merging and low-dimensional spaces per Section 6.

primary_link.title: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization for Model Merging

radar.summary: Model merging combines trained models directly in weight space, offering a compute-efficient alternative to additional fine-tuning. Selecting merge parameters is nevertheless difficult because downstream evaluations are expensive, gradients are unavailable, and source capabilities can conflict. We formulate merge-parameter selection as a black-box multi-objective optimization problem and introduce MOBO-Merge, a merge-operator agnostic framework that uses multi-objective Bayesian optimization to
radar.summary_zh: 模型合併直接在權重空間結合多個專精模型，省去額外訓練，但合併參數的選擇是昂貴、無梯度且多目標的黑盒最佳化問題：指令遵循、數學推理、程式碼生成等能力往往互相衝突。本文提出 MOBO-Merge，將合併參數選擇形式化為昂貴黑盒多目標最佳化，以獨立高斯過程代理各目標，採用 Noisy Expected Hypervolume Improvement（NEHVI）作為取得函式以逼近 Pareto 前沿，框架與合併算子無關。實驗涵蓋 Qwen3-4B 與 Llama-3.1-8B 的雙模型（指令—數學）與三模型（指令—數學—程式碼）設定，比較 Linear、SLERP、TIES 與 Block-Linear 4x 等參數化。在 12 組留出集比較中，有 11 組的平均 hypervolume 高於隨機搜尋；一維 Linear 下增益極小，但 TIES、區塊式與三目標搜尋的增益顯著，Llama 三模型合併以 Block-Linear 4x 最佳（0.0634 對 0.0289）。結果顯示沒有任一合併算子全面最優：TIES 在四組中三組領先，但對隨機參數較不穩健。限制包括下游評估成本高、僅支援同架構權重空間合併，且高維空間需更強的代理模型。此研究提供有限預算下系統性探索能力權衡的搜尋層。

links.title: P2Skill: Privacy Preserving Skill Distillation for Cloud-Local LLM Inference Systems

evidence: Abstract: claims 1.69× and 3.66× higher privacy-preserved inference quality than baselines via prompt-only skill distillation with no privacy-specific fine-tuning
§3.3: refinement loop scores end-to-end responses, attributes failures to one stage by deterministic rule, and a memorization check rejects placeholder slot tokens and long quoted sample text
§4.1: baselines are reimplementations that 'do not reproduce PRISM's trained adaptive LDP module'; evaluation uses PRISM's 160-prompt benchmark with 87 annotated PII identifiers
§4.2/Table 1: P2Skill removes all annotated Medical/Banking identifiers on Gemma4:e2B and Qwen3.5:2B (0/40, 0/47) while Qwen2.5:1.5B and Llama3.2:3B retain 2-4 identifiers
Appendix A Table 3: P2Skill average PQ 6.96 vs Selective LDP 4.11 and Uniform LDP 1.90, leakage 0-6/87 vs 47-67/87, supporting the headline multipliers
§4.4 Discussion: residual leakage attributed to decomposition-stage detection misses; authors note LLM-judge scores 'may not fully reflect human preferences' and no human study was conducted
Appendix C Table 5: Sonnet-4.6 judge reproduces the model-compatibility ordering, providing a partial cross-judge robustness check

§4.1/Appendix D: models named with Ollama tags at temperature 0.3 and 2048 max tokens, skill prompt examples provided; however refinement hyperparameters (T, τ, batch size) and code availability are not specified
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: privacy-preserving cloud-local inference via prompt-based skills distilled on a frozen SLM (§3.1-3.3), spanning high-weight preferences (LLM systems, prompting, agent-like orchestration/routing, AI safety/privacy). Novelty is moderate: cloud-LLM-guided iterative prompt refinement with a memorization check (§3.3) is a competent combination of decomposition prompting, routing, and automatic prompt optimization, but the core loop echoes existing prompt-optimization and cloud-edge routing work (PAPILLON, PRISM, §2). Rigor is limited: only two reimplemented LDP baselines, explicitly not reproducing PRISM's trained adaptive module (§4.1), no head-to-head with PAPILLON/PrivacyRestore/EmojiPrompt, no ablations (no skill removal, no variation of T or τ), and a small 160-prompt benchmark with LLM-judge-only scoring acknowledged in §4.4. Evidence is solid within its scope: audit-log substring leakage counting over 87 annotated identifiers (§4.1), Table 3 supports the 1.69×/3.66× claims (PQ 6.96 vs 4.11 and 1.90), zero leakage on two of four SLMs, and a cross-judge Sonnet-4.6 check (Appendix C); but the metric only counts annotated identifiers, and a minor 6.95 vs 6.96 inconsistency exists. Generalizability is constrained: single benchmark, four domains, per-SLM skills, with transfer explicitly listed as future work (§4.4). Reproducibility is fair: model tags, temperature, prompt excerpts (Appendix D), and versioned skill records, but no code release and unspecified refinement hyperparameters (T, τ, batch size, identifier-density threshold).

primary_link.title: P2Skill: Privacy Preserving Skill Distillation for Cloud-Local LLM Inference Systems

radar.summary: Cloud-local LLM inference systems have the potential to use the reasoning capability of large cloud models while protecting sensitive user data on personal devices. Cloud-bound requests must exclude personally identifiable information (PII) to prevent external data leakage. Existing privacy-preserving methods rely on prompt perturbation, entity masking, or model fine-tuning, but these approaches may distort contextual semantics or require additional training. This paper proposes P2Skill, a promp
radar.summary_zh: 雲端—本地 LLM 協同推論需將使用者提示送往雲端，但提示常含個人可識別資訊（PII）。既有做法如本地差分隱私會破壞語意連貫性，實體遮蔽損失任務脈絡，微調式隱私模組則需逐環境再訓練。本文提出 P2Skill：在凍結的本地小模型上以四個提示技能完成任務分解、PII 感知路由、改寫與最終重建；偵測到 PII 的子任務須先改寫並通過確定性識別碼比對器方可上雲，否則退回本地處理。技能由雲端 LLM 引導的迭代精煉迴路產生：回應失敗後歸因至單一階段，主管角色僅依彙整失敗統計改寫技能，並以防死記檢查拒絕佔位符與樣本片段抄錄，促使學得一般化的 PII 模式而非記憶特定範例。在四領域 160 提示基準與四個 SLM 上，P2Skill 的平均隱私—品質分數為選擇性 LDP 的 1.69 倍、均勻 LDP 的 3.66 倍，其中兩個 SLM 達成 87 個標註識別碼零外洩；殘餘外洩源自分解階段的漏標。限制為整體推論品質仍不及純雲端模型，且表現受本地模型推理能力制約，最小的 Qwen2.5:1.5B 在分解與改寫上均較弱。此研究顯示僅靠提示技能即可兼顧隱私與品質而免微調。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM-agents paper: multi-agent spreadsheet automation with GPT backbones, code generation, task decomposition, and iterative reflection aligns with high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents/tool use, reasoning, code). Novelty is modest: graph-based spreadsheet structure is cited prior work (Koci et al. 2018, Sec 2.1), and the plan-execute-reflect multi-agent loop plus dual memory largely recombines known patterns (MetaGPT, Reflexion, SheetAgent). Experiments cover three benchmarks and two backbones with component-wise ablations and hyperparameter sensitivity, but internal inconsistencies weaken trust: Sec 4.1.4 names GPT-4o-mini as second backbone while Table 1 labels it 'GPT-4'; Sec 4.2 reports SheetRM pass@1 43.5% vs 42.5 in Table 1; Sec 4.4.2 reports SB peak 26.1% at lambda=0.5 vs full-model 22.0/24.7 in Table 2. No variance, significance testing, or cost analysis for the heavyweight pipeline; unexplained baseline anomalies (SheetCopilot exec@1 drops 87.3 to 65.0 under GPT-5). Generalizability limited to closed-source OpenAI models and per-dataset threshold tuning (lambda). Reproducibility is aided by an anonymous code link, full prompt specifications (Appendix B), and implementation details (Appendix A.1), but the mixing weight beta is unspecified and the memory contents are only qualitatively described.

primary_link.title: SheetCompass: Hierarchical Relation Graphs for Agentic Spreadsheet Reasoning
