Real-world workbooks often contain implicit cross-table associations, fine-grained column dependencies, and complex spatial layouts. Existing methods typically flatten these multidimensional structures into sequential strings, losing important intra-sheet boundaries and inter-sheet semantics. Consequently, LLMs cannot ex
radar.summary_zh: 現有方法將試算表攤平為 Markdown 等線性字串，破壞了儲存格的空間布局與跨工作表的隱含語意依賴，導致 LLM 在複雜工作簿任務上表現驟降。本文提出 SheetCompass，將試算表由原始表格資料轉換為可引導代理規劃、執行與反思的結構化證據空間。核心包括：（1）階層式圖結構——以表格與欄位兩層節點搭配結構邊（包含與相鄰關係）及語意邊（以向量相似度與 LLM 關係評分混合決定），同時保留工作表內拓撲與跨表語意；（2）雙層記憶——專家知識記憶提供領域規則與工具使用經驗，推理經驗記憶記錄當前任務軌跡，並將成功經驗沉澱至長期儲存；（3）多代理工作流程——探索者進行任務分解與圖上定位，程式設計者在圖約束下產生沙盒執行程式碼，反思者以狀態檢核清單實施閉環驗證。在 SCB、SB、SheetRM 三基準上，以 GPT-4 與 GPT-5 為骨幹均創下最佳成績，例如 SB 硬限制指標達 22.0%；消融實驗顯示圖結構貢獻最大，移除語意邊會重創跨表任務。限制在於超參數設定敏感、效能仍隨多表難度下降。此框架證明結構感知與多代理協作可大幅提升試算表自動化的可靠性。
radar.title: SheetCompass: Hierarchical Relation Graphs for Agentic Spreadsheet Reasoning
radar.title_zh: SheetCompass：以階層式關係圖驅動的代理式試算表推理

links.title: Local and Global Regimes of Geometric Complexity in Language Model Representations

evidence: Abstract: claims an exact, parameter-free formula for the ID reversal point matching the observed transition at every scale tested
Section 3.1/Table 1: eleven conditions from 1 to 10,000 unique nouns at fixed N=10,000, five independent partitions per condition with reported mean/std
Section 4.2, Eq. 1: derivation n_transition = N/k from the constraint that at k=m a neighbour must come from a different word type
Section 4.3/Figure 4: all six scales collapse onto a single trajectory when plotted against k/m, crossing the transition at k/m=1, across layers 5, 21, 30, 36
Section 5/Figure 5: same-word fraction declines to ~0.2-0.4 in late layers for high-diversity conditions but stays far above the 1/n no-clustering baseline
Section 7: cross-validation replicates the transition with MLE estimator (Fig 7), Meta-Llama-3-8B (Fig 8), and a POS-diversified dataset (Fig 9)
Limitations: restricted to English WikiText-103 and 8B-scale models; clustering assumption weakens in late layers and the decline is not fully understood
Appendix D: licenses and URLs provided for WikiText-103, spaCy, Qwen3-8B, Llama-3-8B, DADApy, skdim
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid LLM interpretability/representation-geometry paper squarely within weighted preferences (LLMs 2.5, Interpretability 1.8, NLP 1.5), not a capped out-of-scope domain. Novelty is genuine but moderate: no prior work isolates lexical diversity as a controlled variable in ID estimation (Section 2), and the parameter-free transition formula n=N/k (Eq. 1) is elegant though derivable from a simple counting argument. Rigor is strong: 11 controlled diversity conditions at fixed N=10,000 with five partitions each (Section 3.1, Table 1), six GRIDE scales, a same-word fraction diagnostic that honestly stress-tests the clustering assumption (Section 5), and three-axis cross-validation over estimator (MLE, Sec 7.1), architecture (Llama-3-8B, Sec 7.2), and POS composition (Sec 7.3). Evidence strength is good but rests on curve-collapse and descriptive statistics (mean/std across partitions, Fig 4 collapse at k/m=1 with no fitted parameters; late-layer same-word fraction 0.2-0.4) without significance testing; figure content itself is unverifiable from text. Generalizability is explicitly limited: English WikiText-103 only, two 8B-scale models, and clustering assumption weakens in late layers (Limitations). Reproducibility is aided by full licenses/URLs (Appendix D) and precise hyperparameters, though no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Local and Global Regimes of Geometric Complexity in Language Model Representations

radar.summary: Intrinsic dimensionality (ID) is widely used to probe the representational complexity of language models, but it remains unclear whether ID differences reflect properties of language itself or artefacts of how the underlying dataset was constructed. In this paper, we focus specifically on how lexical diversity, the number of unique last-token items present in a dataset, affects ID estimates of that dataset. We find a scale-dependent transition between two regimes: at low lexical diversity, condi
radar.summary_zh: 本論文探討內在維度是否可靠反映語言模型的表示複雜度,或只是資料集建構方式的假象。作者以WikiText-103建構十一種詞彙多樣性條件(1至10,000個獨特名詞),固定樣本數N=10,000,以GRIDE在Qwen3-8B與Meta-Llama-3-8B各層隱藏狀態上估計ID。結果發現ID隨鄰域尺度k呈兩種機制轉換:局部機制中,詞彙多樣性越低ID越高;全域機制中,多樣性越高ID越高。作者推導出無參數的轉換點公式n_transition=N/k,並在多種尺度、層數、估計器與詞類上驗證吻合。以名詞與介詞比較為例,未控制詞彙多樣性時名詞ID較高,配對後排序反轉,證明原始差異是建構假象。限制包括僅用英文維基語料、限於8B規模模型,且同詞聚集假設在後期層減弱。此研究提醒任何跨類別的ID比較都須先確認所處機制,並提供轉換公式與同詞比例診斷工具,對解讀語言表示的幾何結構深具意義。
radar.title: Local and Global Regimes of Geometric Complexity in Language Model Representations
radar.title_zh: 語言模型表示中幾何複雜度的局部與全域機制

links.title: Individual Disempowerment through an Advice Channel: Control Loss when Influence is Endogenous

evidence: Abstract: an oracle 'rewarded by per-round approval cultivates reliance beyond a closed-form patience threshold', answering episodically in short deployments and cultivating in long-memory ones.

Section 2, Eqs (1)-(2): influence coefficient epsilon_t is modeled as a state variable 'driven by the oracle's own outputs', creating a reliance feedback loop the author compares to resource acquisition.
Section 4.2, Lemma 1 and Corollary 1: under Assumption 1 (Echo), human guaranteed value W_u(x, epsilon) declines pointwise in epsilon and control loss is bounded by epsilon/(1-gamma)^2.
Section 4.3, Theorem 1: closed-form thresholds gamma*(delta) = c/(alpha*eta + c(1-delta)) and stopping level epsilon-hat; cultivation is front-loaded with an explicit stopping point when delta = 0.

Section 4.4, Theorem 2: the per-step boxing certificate 'never fires' (an algebraic identity via Eq (5)), the certified parameter epsilon_0 is driven past epsilon-hat(gamma), and 'No horizon-blind bound exists' below the trivial ceiling.

Section 5: minimal example with alpha=1, c=0.1, eta=0.01 gives gamma*(0)~0.909 and reset threshold tau*~15.6, so a 15-round oracle never cultivates and a 16-round one does; 'all numerical claims are verified in the code supplement'.

Section 7 (Horizon and caveats): limitations stated openly - atrophy of T_0 lies outside the Lemma 2 accounting, the delta>0 cultivate boundary lacks a closed form, and exogeneity of institutional caps is questioned.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Formal AI-safety theory paper on oracle/boxing deployments, squarely in-scope for safety and alignment preferences (boxing, manipulation, sycophancy, safeguard guarantees) and formally grounded in MDP/reinforcement-learning theory; it is not an LLM-methodology contribution, so preference relevance is solid but not top-tier. Novelty is high: it makes reliance an endogenous state variable moved by the advisor's own messages, proves a dominance-decline lemma, an answer/cultivate switch with closed-form patience thresholds, and an impossibility result for horizon-blind static certification, positioning itself against power-seeking theorems and gradual-disempowerment position work. Rigor is good: explicit standing assumptions (Echo), stated norms (TV normalization), proof sketches, and honest limitations (atrophy, scalar compliance, delta>0 boundary only computed). Evidence strength is limited: full proofs are in an unavailable supplement, no empirical validation on real systems, and the author calls the recursion 'deliberately a caricature' (Section 2); support is analytic plus claimed code-verified numerics in a minimal example. Generalizability is moderate: prior-free framework over finite MDPs, but compliance-only channel and frozen-epsilon conventions restrict scope. Reproducibility is partial: closed-form constants and parameters are given and a code supplement is claimed, but no availability is verifiable from the document.

primary_link.title: Individual Disempowerment through an Advice Channel: Control Loss when Influence is Endogenous

radar.summary: An AI that can only give advice seems safe: the human is always free to ignore it. That is the premise of the boxing tradition in AI safety, and its long-suspected weak point is that the human who reads the answers is part of the system. We make the fraction $\varepsilon_t$ of behavior that follows the advice a state of a Markov decision process, moved by the advisor's own messages, so that use deepens reliance. Granted a channel rich enough to echo any action the human could take, higher $\vare
radar.summary_zh: 僅能提供建議的AI看似安全,因為人隨時可以忽略它。本文將此boxing傳統的隱憂形式化:閱讀並執行建議的人類本身是系統的一部分。作者把服從建議的行為比例ε_t建模為馬可夫決策過程的狀態變數,由顧問自身的訊息驅動——今天遵循建議會提高明日的影響力。在「回聲」假設下,ε上升會單調降低人類對任何訊息都能保證的權力。以每輪核准為獎勵的oracle存在「回答或培養依賴」的最優切換,並有封閉形式的耐心閾值γ*:同一組獎勵權重在短期部署中只回答,在長期部署中則先培養依賴。論文進一步證明:部署時一次性認證的boxing檢查無法為損失提供非平凡上界;外生影響力上限能約束通道項,卻挽回不了已造成的位移;短於臨界週期τ*的記憶重置可消除培養誘因。其最小數值範例顯示,最優oracle在15輪會話中從不培養依賴,在16輪則會。限制是未涵蓋效用漂移、將服從壓縮為純量,也未建模能力萎縮。此研究對AI安全評估極具啟示:危險的不是智慧,而是持久性。
radar.title: Individual Disempowerment through an Advice Channel: Control Loss when Influence is Endogenous
radar.title_zh: 透過建議通道造成的個體權力削弱:當影響力為內生時的控制喪失

links.title: LegacyWorld: Atomicity-Aware Evaluation of GUI Agents for Legacy Workflows

evidence: Abstract and Section I: benchmark of 28 Windows GUI workflows evaluated via atomicity, where 'a run should either complete the intended workflow correctly or fail without unintended persistent side effects'

Section II-E: atomicity defined as 'the fraction of runs ending in valid success or valid failure', yielding four classes (valid success, invalid success, valid failure, invalid failure) distinct from OSWorld/Windows Agent Arena completion metrics

Table II: six agents (gpt-5-4, gemini-2.5, opus-4-6, haiku-4-5, sonnet-4-6, kimi-k2.5) reported with VS/VF/IS/IF/US percentages; e.g., gpt-5-4 shows 3.6% valid success but 96.4% valid failure (100% atomicity) under expert-crafted prompts
Section II-D: 'one included run per task and prompt condition', temperature=0.0, 900-second timeout, fresh VM per run - confirming single-trajectory cells
Section II-A: 18 of 28 tasks externally verified by domain experts, explicitly 'design-time review of workflow realism and task specification, not independent auditing of model outputs'
Section III-A: concrete invalid-success case - DSWin Add New Patient run returned success but persisted insurance number 4212505 instead of expected 1234567890, caught by post-run database validator
Section IV: limitations state 'each model-task-prompt cell contributes one included trajectory' and results support 'risk-aware comparison... not deployment certification or inferential ranking'
Section II-F: replication package publicly available at github.com/ThiloReintjes/LegacyWorld containing benchmark catalog, prompts, validator metadata, run records, and reproduction scripts

Section II-C: video-generated prompt condition uses gemini-3.1-pro-preview on single golden-path recordings; contracts, parameters, and validators remain fixed, testing procedure reconstruction rather than end-to-end task inference
llm_evaluation.rationale: A computer-use/LLM-agent evaluation benchmark, directly matching the high-weight Agents & Tool Use and Evaluation preferences, with safety-adjacent framing (unsafe side effects) rather than pure CV. The atomicity-aware four-way outcome model (valid/invalid x success/failure) is a genuinely fresh framing versus OSWorld/Windows Agent Arena completion-only scoring, and the expert-crafted vs. video-derived prompt comparison is a useful but modest secondary contribution. Rigor is careful in design (task contracts, independent validators, expert grounding of 18/28 tasks) but limited by exactly one included trajectory per model-task-prompt cell, no repeated runs, and no inferential statistics - limitations the authors transparently acknowledge, framing results as descriptive only. Evidence is concrete (Table II distributions, the DSWin invalid-success database-delta example) and claims are calibrated, but single-run percentages over 28 tasks are fragile. Generalizability is constrained by Windows-only, one harness, hosted agents only, and legacy-like app selection, though the atomicity methodology itself transfers. Reproducibility is strong via a public replication package with contracts, validators, run records, and scripts, minus friction from proprietary apps (DSWin, Crystal). Not a domain-application or medical-imaging paper; it earns a mid-to-good score as an agent-evaluation contribution, held back by statistical thinness rather than scope.

primary_link.title: LegacyWorld: Atomicity-Aware Evaluation of GUI Agents for Legacy Workflows

radar.summary: Legacy and legacy-like enterprise systems often remain difficult to modernize because critical workflows expose limited programmable interfaces and still require manual GUI interaction. This paper reports a pre-deployment evaluation study motivated by the development of legacy-use, an industry-oriented framework for automating such workflows with multimodal LLM agents. During framework development, domain experts helped identify stateful workflows where successful demos are not sufficient: a fai
radar.summary_zh: 許多組織仍依賴缺乏可程式化介面的舊有企業系統,關鍵工作流程只能透過圖形介面手動操作。本文受產業框架legacy-use啟發,提出「原子性」評估:代理執行應正確完成工作流程,或在失敗時不留下非預期的持久性副作用。作者建立28個Windows GUI工作流程的基準,每項皆指定初始狀態、目標狀態與任務專屬驗證器,並比較專家撰寫的提示與由專家螢幕錄影自動生成的提示,測試六種託管的computer-use代理。結果顯示有效成功、有效失敗、無效成功與無效失敗是四種截然不同的操作輪廓:gpt-5-4原子性達100%但僅3.6%有效成功,屬保守失敗;opus-4-6有效成功率78.6%但伴隨約10.7%不安全副作用;kimi-k2.5的不安全率更高達35.7%。影片生成提示多使有效成功率下降,但常維持原子性。限制包括每格僅一條執行軌跡、只監控可觀測狀態,且屬受控的部署前評估。此研究指出成功示範不足以保證有狀態工作流程的安全部署,原子性感知驗收測試應列為必要需求。
radar.title: LegacyWorld: Atomicity-Aware Evaluation of GUI Agents for Legacy Workflows
radar.title_zh: LegacyWorld:針對舊有工作流程之GUI代理的原子性感知評估

links.title: Agentic Data Cleaning Without a Clean Reference: An Experimental Study of Capabilities and Trade-offs

evidence: Abstract: deterministic profiling baseline achieved highest detection F1 of 0.561; best LLM configuration (A6) reached 0.421; 126 completed runs across financial, clinical, and environmental datasets
Section 9, Table 13: A0 F1 0.013; A2 0.307 rises to A3 0.402 after adding executable Python tools; A6 0.421 with zero repair-class decisions
Section 9: A5 and A6 achieved lowest unsupported-rule rates (both 0.037) while decision-level citation alignment remained weak at 0.036 and 0.041
Section 9: only A3 achieved a non-zero repair-match rate (0.028), showing successful direct correction remained very limited across all configurations
Section 8 (Evaluation Protocol): 'No p-values, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests are reported'; original-data results explicitly kept descriptive
Section 7: LLM-based configurations used OpenRouter with openai/gpt-oss-20b, temperature 0.2, max output 3000 tokens; evidence retrieval restricted to a 17-record controlled local corpus (Table 9)

Section 11 (Threats to Validity): three repetitions 'insufficient for strong inferential claims'; one LLM and provider used; A0/A1 differ in both reasoning mechanism and capabilities, so not single-factor

Declarations, Data and Code Availability: blinded repository (Google Drive) containing code, configs, evidence corpus, and saved artifacts, to be replaced by a permanent archival record after acceptance
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solid in-scope LLM-agent methodology study: capability ablation (profiling, executable tools, retrieval, source ranking, citation alignment, conservative policy) for reference-free data cleaning, directly matching Agents & Tool Use, LLM, and RAG preferences rather than a pure vertical-domain application. The framework recombines known ingredients (ReAct/Toolformer-style tools, RAG, profiling, provenance) with somewhat fresh conservative abstention classes and decision-level citation-alignment metrics. Rigor is careful for an exploratory design (controlled synthetic corruption, 126 runs, honest baseline-confound acknowledgment) but limited: 3 repetitions per cell, no significance testing, one model (gpt-oss-20b via OpenRouter), and cumulative rather than factorial ablation. Evidence concretely supports only modest, directional claims — the deterministic baseline A1 wins detection (F1 0.561 vs 0.421 for the best LLM config), repair accuracy is near-zero (max repair-match 0.028), citation alignment stays weak (0.036-0.041), and the conservative policy's safety benefit is redundant with A5 — all candidly reported, which strengthens credibility but caps impact. Generalizability is constrained by three tabular datasets, a single LLM/provider, and a fixed local evidence corpus; reproducibility is aided by saved artifacts and a repository, but via a non-permanent blinded Google Drive link and a variable commercial LLM endpoint.

primary_link.title: Agentic Data Cleaning Without a Clean Reference: An Experimental Study of Capabilities and Trade-offs

radar.summary: Data cleaning without a trusted clean reference is challenging because unusual values may represent either genuine errors or valid observations. This paper studies how different agent capabilities affect reference-free data cleaning and proposes an evidence-grounded framework that combines structured context, profiling, LLM reasoning, executable checks, controlled evidence retrieval, source ranking, citation alignment, conservative repair, reversible scripts, and provenance logging. Seven config
radar.summary_zh: 在缺乏可信乾淨參考的情況下,資料清理極為困難,因為異常值可能是真錯誤,也可能是罕見但有效的觀測。本文提出以證據為本的代理式清理框架,結合結構化脈絡、資料剖析、LLM推理、可執行檢查、受控證據檢索、來源排序、引用對齊、保守修復、可逆腳本與來源紀錄。實驗以A0至A6七種設定,在金融、臨床與環境輻射監測三個資料集上進行受控合成污染與原始資料兩種模式,共126次執行。結果顯示:確定性剖析基線A1達到最高的偵測F1分數0.561;LLM設定中以完整保守配置A6的0.421最高;A5與A6的無依據規則率最低(0.037),但決策層級的引用對齊仍很弱;A6未產生任何不安全或不必要修改,卻也未執行直接修復,且執行時間與token成本最高。整體而言,增加能力帶來偵測、修復、證據紮根、保守性、可重現性與成本之間的權衡,而非全面改善。限制包括資料集與模型單一、使用本地證據語料且未做統計檢定。此研究為無參考清理提供可稽核的評估方法。
radar.title: Agentic Data Cleaning Without a Clean Reference: An Experimental Study of Capabilities and Trade-offs
radar.title_zh: 無乾淨參考下的代理式資料清理:能力與權衡的實驗研究

links.title: MoE Expert Execution in Disaggregated LLM Serving with a High-Bandwidth ReRAM Near-Memory Architecture

evidence: Sec. VI (Evaluation Methodology): 'All quantitative claims in this paper are a measured+modeled hybrid analysis... We do not claim silicon measurements of ReXpert itself.'

Sec. VI: 'grouped-GEMM decode kernels replaying the captured routing reach 88-94% of datasheet HBM stream bandwidth and the roofline matches measured kernel time within 7%'; baselines credited full stream bandwidth with no software overhead.

Table IX (Sec. VII-B): broadcast raises occupancy 0.152 to 0.510 at fixed ideal MFU 0.736; coactivation placement 0.519 to 0.532; load-aware fetch 0.422 to 0.552 only at G=2, with the note that gains are 'not additive across rows'.
Table X (Sec. VII-C): side-4 pooling raises occupancy 0.328 to 0.519 with 1.23x round stretch while 6x6/8x8 cores suffer 1.69-2.50x stretch; knee reproduced on Qwen3.5-397B traces.

Table VIII (Sec. VII-A): under equal-bandwidth normalization ReXpert is 1.0x vs both GPUs, and the text concedes 'the gain arises from bandwidth density, not aggregate bandwidth' — a candid scoping of the headline 9.5x claim.
Table VI (Sec. VI): routing robustness across two seeds, HumanEval code workload, and independent batches B in {8,64} with Gini 0.47-0.62 and hot/mean 6.4-18.2x.

Sec. VII-E (Limitations): 'ReRAM device variation, retention, endurance, and yield headroom... is a process and circuit prerequisite for a production resident FFN pool' and contention-aware multicast arbitration 'left for further study'.
Sec. VI: 'We do not re-implement Tutel/FasterMoE/MoE-Lightning as quantitative baselines', arguing they are bounded above by the HBM roofline; Table XIII is explicitly qualitative.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A computer-architecture proposal (ReXpert: ReRAM near-memory FFN pool for MoE decode in attention-FFN disaggregated serving). It matches LLM-serving, MoE/transformer, inference/serving, and scaling/efficiency preferences, but the contribution is hardware architecture, not language-model methodology, so topic relevance is moderate rather than high. Rigor is the paper's strength: an explicit MFU factorization, machine-balance analysis, measured router-hook traces on three models with multi-seed/multi-workload campaigns, kernel calibration (88-94% of datasheet HBM bandwidth, roofline within 7%), BookSim2/DSENT network sizing, per-mechanism ablations, a pooling-knee sweep, and honest statement that all headline numbers are measured+modeled projections, not silicon. Evidence is solid within the modeling paradigm but rests on unvalidated assumptions (ReRAM macro density/energy from one ISSCC macro, 2.5 ns column rate, RTL/DSENT area-power), and competing MoE schedulers are positioned only qualitatively. Equal-bandwidth normalization honestly showing the latency gain disappears (1.0x) increases credibility. Generalizability is bounded to MoE decode under SLO caps with resident weights; reproducibility is limited by no released artifacts and a multi-tool simulation stack that must be rebuilt.

primary_link.title: MoE Expert Execution in Disaggregated LLM Serving with a High-Bandwidth ReRAM Near-Memory Architecture

radar.summary: Attention-FFN disaggregation maps LLM modules to specialized pools, creating an opening to keep Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) weights resident in a high-bandwidth FFN pool. Decode SLOs, however, cap the run-batch while sparse routing expands the activated-expert union, so weight traffic amortizes poorly and routing skew idles cold-expert resources. The FFN pool must therefore deliver weight-read bandwidth density under sparse unions and recover occupancy under skew without a global sharing fabric. We

evidence: §4.1.2, Tables 1-2: dynamic transfer mode achieves 17/60 (28.3%) roots for ministral-8b and 23/60 (38.3%) for ministral-14b vs. 3/60 (5.0%) and 1/60 (1.7%) unaided baselines; common-path mode drops 8B success to 1/60 (1.7%).

§4.1: 'The full pipeline is implemented in approximately 3400 lines of Python... the learned MCs, the abstract traces, the concrete traces, and the source code are included in the replication package available at https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.32841767'.

§4 (Setup): k=20 runs per VM with DeepSeek V4 Flash on 12 vulnerable VMs with 20-turn limit; footnote 1 states Scenario 4 of thirteen excluded because SSH-based setup does not support interactive shell commands.
§4.1: transfer evaluation uses 5 penetration tests per VM per transfer mode against the unaided baseline; no statistical significance testing or variance reporting appears anywhere in the paper.

§1 (Related work): 'To the best of our knowledge, no existing approach combines semantic LLM-based abstraction with automata learning to recover behavioral models of AI agents from execution trajectories.'

§4.2, Fig. 3: DAG extraction compresses a 57-state MC to 7 states (Scenario 2); pruning/collapsing compresses a 41-state MC to 7 states (Scenario 13); caveat noted that important steps may be collapsed into SCCs.

§6 (Future Plans): 'The most important next step is to demonstrate the broader potential of this approach... in various application domains of agentic AI beyond penetration testing', plus planned user studies — authors concede generality is unproven.
§4.1.2: explanation of the common-path regression for 8B is speculative only ('This mode creates relatively large hints that may be hard to process for small models') with no supporting analysis.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an LLM-agent methodology paper (agent trajectory analysis, tool-using pen-testing agents, explainability, symbolic knowledge transfer between LLMs), not a pure domain application, so the out-of-scope cap does not apply. Novelty is moderate-to-good: combining LLM-guided trace abstraction with passive automata learning (Alergia) to recover labelled Markov chains of agent strategies is a genuinely new combination (§1 claims no prior work does this; nearest neighbors AgentGuard, ProbGuard, Trace2Chain, Ayoughi et al. differ in abstraction or formalism), though both ingredients are established and LLM trajectory-mining (ExpeL, Trace2Skill, TIM) is a crowded space. Rigor is middling: a structured case study with baselines and per-mode comparisons (§4.1), but no significance testing, no confidence intervals, small samples (5 runs/VM/mode), no validation of LLM abstraction correctness, no baseline where the frontier LLM summarizes raw traces (which would isolate the learned MC's contribution), and Scenario 4 excluded (§4 fn.1). Evidence is suggestive: dynamic mode lifts success from 5.0%→28.3% (8B) and 1.7%→38.3% (14B) (Tables 1-2), but the unexplained 'common path' regression for 8B (1.7% vs 5.0%) is only qualitatively hand-waved (§4.1.2). Generalizability is limited: single domain (pen testing), single agent framework, and the authors themselves list cross-domain demonstration and user studies as future work (§6); SCC collapsing can hide crucial steps (§4.2). Reproducibility is a relative strength: ~3400-line Python pipeline with a replication package containing learned MCs, traces, and code (§4.1, figshare DOI), though it depends on API-hosted models (DeepSeek V4, Ministral via openrouter) and LLM-stochastic abstraction.

primary_link.title: ATLAS: Discovering Agent Strategies through LLM-Guided Abstraction and Automata Learning

radar.summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used for complex tasks such as software testing and cybersecurity assessment. While these agents demonstrate impressive capabilities, their behavior is difficult to understand, explain, and analyze. Existing evaluations focus mainly on task success and execution traces, offering limited insight into the strategies employed by the agent. We present ATLAS (Automata Learning for Agent Trajectory Analysis and Strategy Discovery), an approach f
radar.summary_zh: LLM代理的行為難以理解、解釋與分析,現有評估多著重任務成功率與執行軌跡,對代理採用的策略著墨有限。本文提出ATLAS,結合軌跡抽象與自動機學習,從代理與環境的互動軌跡中回復可解讀的行為模型:先以LLM將具體動作與觀察歸類為高階類別並正規化,再以Alergia演算法從抽象軌跡學習標記馬可夫鏈。作者以滲透測試代理HackingBuddyGPT在12台含漏洞的虛擬機上驗證,學得的模型揭示偵察模式、分支決策與失敗迴圈。研究展示兩項應用:其一,將習得模型中的符號知識從前緣模型(DeepSeek V4 Flash)轉移至小型執行模型,動態模式使ministral-8b成功率從5.0%升至28.3%,ministral-14b從1.7%升至38.3%;其二,透過DAG萃取與修剪摺疊產生精簡的解釋模型,例如將57個狀態壓縮至7個。限制包括僅屬概念驗證、聚焦滲透測試場域,且長軌跡與任務多樣性可能考驗抽象的擴展性。此工作主張代理軌跡應成為模型驅動工程的一等建模素材,支援解釋、監控與稽核。

links.title: How Much Do Legal RAG Systems Still Hallucinate?

evidence: Section 3.3: 'we examine the generated answer, corresponding ground-truth answer, extracted claims, entailment labels, question category, and persona without re-executing the underlying RAG systems' — re-analysis, not new system development.
Section 3.3: 'The evaluation materials and source code will be released upon publication under an appropriate open-source license.' — availability is a promise, not verified release.

Table 1 (Section 3.4): BM25+GPT-5 achieves AL 20.1% (GDPR) and 8.3% (CIVIL) versus E5+Llama3-8B AL 48.3% (GDPR) and BM25+Llama3-8B AL 45.8% (CIVIL), supporting the 'less than 10% to nearly half' claim.
Section 4: external validation uses '142 questions manually drafted by a third-party legal expert, evenly split between GDPR and CIVIL', reproducing system rankings and FP difficulty (Table 6).

Section 5 Limitations: 'does not assess the impact of alternative prompts, chunking strategies, retrieval parameters' and FP/JT categories 'contain relatively few examples'; Section 5 lists 'expert-reviewed hallucination annotations' as future work, indicating no human validation of the automated entailment labels.

Section 3.5 (Table 3): FP questions show elevated answer-level rates (e.g., BM25+Mixtral-8x7B AL 100% on CIVIL FP, n=5), though the authors flag these as 'preliminary due to the limited number of questions'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-preference: hallucination/factuality evaluation of RAG systems built on GPT-4, GPT-5, Llama-3.1 and Mixtral, spanning RAG & Knowledge, LLM, and evaluation themes, so relevance is high even though the setting is legal-domain. Novelty is modest: the paper re-analyzes outputs from the authors' own ClaimRAG-LAW benchmark ('without re-executing the underlying RAG systems', Sec. 3.3), reusing established claim-level metrics from RAGChecker/RefChecker; the added value is the answer/claim-level decomposition, category/persona breakdown, and external validation. Rigor is reasonable (four metrics, 8 system configurations, two corpora, SDs, per-answer severity distribution, threats-to-validity section) but weakened by absence of significance testing, no human verification of entailment labels (expert-reviewed annotations deferred to future work, Sec. 5), and tiny FP/JT samples acknowledged in Limitations. Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent (Tables 1-6, e.g., BM25+GPT-5 AL 20.1%/8.3% vs E5+Llama3-8B 48.3%), plus an independent 142-question expert-authored validation, but conclusions about personas rest on uncontrolled observational splits. Generalizability is partially supported (two languages/jurisdictions, external validation) yet confined to legal corpora per the authors' own external-validity caveat. Reproducibility is limited: code/data only promised 'upon publication', analysis depends on prior benchmark artifacts, and proprietary GPT APIs underpin the generations.

primary_link.title: How Much Do Legal RAG Systems Still Hallucinate?

radar.summary: Hallucination is a major challenge for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems in the legal domain, where ungrounded answers can lead to serious consequences. To better understand this problem, we conduct a fine-grained analysis of hallucination behavior in eight legal RAG systems across two legal corpora, the GDPR (in English) and a national civil law (in French). Using claim-level and answer-level evaluation, we report on hallucination density and severity, analyze performance across ques
radar.summary_zh: 幻覺是法律領域檢索增強生成(RAG)系統的重大挑戰,無根據的答案可能導致嚴重後果。本文對八個法律RAG系統進行細粒度分析,結合BM25與E5兩種檢索器及GPT-4、GPT-5、Llama3-8B與Mixtral-8x7B四種生成器,評估英文GDPR與法語盧森堡民法典兩個語料庫,採用聲明層級與答案層級指標衡量幻覺密度與嚴重度,並分析題目類別與使用者角色。結果顯示幻覺仍普遍存在:最佳系統BM25+GPT-5的回答層級幻覺率約8%至20%,最差的Llama3-8B系統接近一半;多數幻覺是孤立的單一聲明錯誤,但嚴重的多聲明幻覺在頂尖系統中仍會出現。含錯誤前提的問題尤其危險,部分系統在CIVIL上的無效率高達100%;法律專家角色的題目幻覺率通常低於公務員或一般公民。作者另以142題法律專家手擬問題做獨立驗證,趨勢一致。限制包括僅涵蓋兩個語料、八個系統,部分題類樣本稀少。此研究指出僅改善檢索品質不足以緩解幻覺,前提驗證與對證據的忠實性才是關鍵。

links.title: Federated Prompt Learning: A Unified Framework, Empirical Analysis, and Future Directions

evidence: Abstract: 'This paper presents a comprehensive survey of federated prompt learning (FPL) to review recent advances in integrating the federated learning paradigm and large language models' with RQ1-RQ3 on motivations, trade-offs, and security/privacy challenges.

Section 1.2 Methods: 'Relevant studies are retrieved from databases, such as Web of Science, Google Scholar, and dblp... 52 high-quality studies were retained for subsequent analysis' after screening by publication period, type, relevance, and methodological completeness.

Section 1.1 Motivations and Contributions: 'The core contribution of this survey lies in the experimental validation of representative federated prompt learning models and frameworks' — claimed experiments are not present in the supplied excerpt.
Section 2.2.5 FPL: objective formalized in Eq. (4)-(5) with frozen backbone θ and aggregated prompt parameters φ; cites PROMPTFL and FedPrompt as representative methods.

Section 3.1: FedPepTAO 'consistently achieves state-of-the-art accuracy up to 60.8% improvement over baselines, while reducing training time by up to 97.59%' — a cited third-party result, not independently verified in this paper's supplied text.

Section 2.2.6: acknowledges that 'prompt or adapter updates may still reveal information about local examples through gradient inversion, membership inference, or representation reconstruction' and backdoor risks from malicious clients or servers.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A survey squarely on LLMs (federated prompt learning / PEFT for LLM adaptation), strongly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, prompting, training/optimization, privacy-security aspects, efficiency). It states a systematic review methodology (52 retained studies, predefined search terms, inclusion/exclusion criteria) and formalizes FPL objectives, which supports moderate rigor and reproducibility of the review process. However, novelty is limited to a taxonomy/unified-lifecycle framing of an existing area, and the claimed core contribution of 'experimental validation of representative FPL models' (Section 1.1) is not verifiable from the supplied text, which also weakens evidence strength: most quantitative claims (e.g., FedPepTAO '60.8% improvement', '97.59% training-time reduction') are third-party results relayed from cited works rather than independently validated here. Generalizability is decent given lifecycle-wide coverage across NLP, vision-language, IoT, and medical use cases, but the truncated excerpt precludes confirming the breadth/depth of later sections.
topics: privacy and security in federated LLM training

primary_link.title: Federated Prompt Learning: A Unified Framework, Empirical Analysis, and Future Directions

radar.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become core components of cloud-based intelligent services in academia and industry, yet their training and deployment are hindered by high computational costs, data centralization, and privacy concerns. Federated learning (FL) offers a decentralized training paradigm that enables clients to collaboratively train a learning model without sharing raw data, making it a promising solution for privacy-preserving LLM training and reasoning. This paper presents a comp
radar.summary_zh: 本文是聯邦提示學習的綜述,系統性回顧聯邦學習與大型語言模型整合的最新進展。核心概念是讓客戶端在凍結的基礎模型上,僅協同學習輕量的提示或適配器模組(如soft prompt、LoRA),再聚合這些更新,從而將通訊成本由全模型規模降至模組規模,並保留預訓練知識、支援個人化。全文圍繞三個研究問題:一是聯邦提示學習的動機、特性與使能技術,及其有別於傳統聯邦學習與全模型聯邦微調之處;二是各方法在效能、通訊效率、運算開銷、擴展性、個人化與異質性處理上的權衡;三是剩餘的安全、隱私、穩健性與系統挑戰及未來方向。作者依模型生命週期梳理聯邦預訓練、微調、指令調整、對齊與應用等方向,檢視52篇高品質研究,並對代表性方法進行實驗驗證,同時整理梯度反演、成員推論、投毒與後門等攻擊及對應防禦。主要洞見是提示模組的緊湊性與模組化天然適合聯邦環境,但資料異質可能造成提示錯位、客戶端漂移與負遷移。此綜述為研究者提供統一的參考框架與路線圖。

links.title: HELIX: Model-Harness Co-evolution for Recursive Self-Improvement

evidence: Section 5.2: 'The main evolution matrix contains Pi Mono and 64 Pi-centered source-pure recipes... Every one of the 65 candidates runs once on every task, producing 6,500 slots.'

Section 6.1 (Finding 1): best fixed candidate solves 52/100 vs Pi 50/100; 'only two of 64 non-baseline candidates exceed Pi'; SWE-bench follow-up 46/55 vs Pi 44/55 with preferred member changing across protocols.
Section 6.2: portfolio union covers 79/100 ('58.0% relative coverage gain') but is explicitly 'a post-hoc union over the evolved portfolio, not a deployable fixed-harness score'.

Table 3 / Section 6.3: 200-slot sibling slice yields 438 records (63 clean SFT, 52 critic negatives, 113 filter samples, 154 preference pairs); 'one verified sibling can contribute to more than one objective'.
Section 5.4: all rollouts use 'MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed' with deterministic=false; no significance testing or variance analysis reported anywhere.
Section 9.1: 'The main evolution matrix uses 100 AtCoder tasks and checks only their public tests' — contradicts Section 5.2's '100 fixtures derived from livecodebench/code_generation_lite'.
Section 9.5: 'This paper materializes model-update data but does not train an updated model'; scaling and reliable recursive updating deferred to future work.
Section 9.2: 'Each evolved harness changes several components at once... we cannot tell which individual component caused the change.'
Abstract / Section 1: code release claimed at https://github.com/HKUDS/HELIX; Section 3.2-3.3 describe deterministic lockfiles and pre-execution checks supporting repeatable builds.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: an LLM coding-agent harness-evolution system (SWE-bench, LiveCodeBench, tool use, SFT/critic/preference data generation) directly matching the highest-weight agent and code preferences. Conceptual novelty is moderate: harness evolution and joint harness-model loops already exist (paper itself cites HarnessX and Recursive Harness Self-Improvement as prior art, Section 8.1), with HELIX positioned as a 'complementary systems layer' (source-traceable ports/atoms/recipes and sibling-trajectory data handoff). Rigor is undermined by an internal contradiction (Section 5.2 describes 100 LiveCodeBench-derived fixtures while Section 9.1 calls them '100 AtCoder tasks'), single-attempt main matrix with small deltas (52 vs 50 of 100), confounded multi-component interventions acknowledged in Section 9.2, and an unfinished loop: Section 9.5 admits no updated model is actually trained, so 'co-evolution' is only half-demonstrated. Evidence is concrete and unusually candid (official SWE-bench evaluator, trace-strict status, post-hoc union explicitly labeled non-deployable), but effects are small, unstable across protocols (preferred member changes between LCB and SWE follow-ups), and statistically untreated. Generalizability is limited to coding agents and one model. Reproducibility is aided by claimed code release and deterministic lockfiles but unverifiable.

primary_link.title: HELIX: Model-Harness Co-evolution for Recursive Self-Improvement

radar.summary: Scaling agent capability has largely focused on improving the model, yet an interactive agent acts through a runtime harness that mediates context, tools, control flow, and stopping. The harness shapes both what a model can accomplish and the trajectories from which it learns. This coupling motivates model-harness co-evolution for recursive self-improvement: build harnesses for a fixed model, update the model from verified sibling trajectories, and rebuild the harnesses as model capabilities cha
radar.summary_zh: 提升代理能力通常聚焦於讓模型變強，但代理是透過執行時期的 harness 行動，後者決定上下文、工具、控制流程、權限與停止判斷。本文主張模型與 harness 應共同演化，提出 build–update–rebuild 流程：先為固定模型建立可溯源的 harness，再以驗證過的兄弟軌跡更新模型，最後依新模型能力重建 harness。系統 HELIX 將 OpenCode、Pi Mono、Nanobot、Hermes Agent 分解為型別化埠、原子、配方、產品外殼與執行期政策，透過預執行檢查與證據平面確保介入可稽核。在 LiveCodeBench 衍生的 100 個修復任務上評估 65 個候選：最佳固定 harness 較 Pi 提升 4.0% 任務覆蓋率，完整組合的事後聯集覆蓋最多高出 58.0%；選出成員經重複執行與官方 SWE-bench 評估驗證，200 個 slot 的兄弟切片產出 438 筆 SFT、批評、過濾與偏好訓練紀錄。限制在於僅產出訓練資料而未實際訓練新模型、難以隔離單一元件的因果效應，且擴大資料規模仍需可觀運算成本。此研究使 harness 演化成為可稽核的執行與資料生成介面，為遞迴自我改進奠定基礎。

links.title: Beyond the pale: Assessing prevalence and contents of extremist speech in LLM training data

evidence: Section 3: reservoir sample of 200k documents from ~3-trillion-token Dolma; multi-stage pipeline combining automated classification, GPT-4o mini rechecking, and expert validation (Figure 1).
Section 3 (Automated filtering): authors concede no false-negative screening is possible, so all estimates are explicitly lower bounds.

Section 4, Table 1: prevalence counts with standard errors across four models and three definitions plus union prompt; Llama 3 70B judged inconsistent (more Berger hits than union hits, large GPT-4o mini disqualification).

Section 5.2: only 30 texts (10 per definition) manually coded by one expert; ~33% coded extremist, 20% hate speech, remainder news/borderline/indeterminate, supporting the ~1/2000 estimate in Section 7.

Section 7: extrapolates the 1/2000 rate to the ~5-billion-document non-code portion of Dolma, yielding 'hundreds of thousands' of harmful documents with an allowed order-of-magnitude overcounting margin.
Appendix A: full system prompts and by-definition/union prompts are embedded in the paper, the main reproducibility provision; no code repository or released document sample is stated anywhere.
Limitations: authors acknowledge lower-bound status and high sampling variance from the low 1/2000 prevalence, arguing i.i.d. sampling mitigates but does not eliminate the issue.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solidly in-scope: an audit of extremist/hate content in the Dolma pre-training corpus using LLM-based zero-shot classification (Llama 3.3 70B, Qwen 2.5/3.5, Gemma 4), GPT-4o mini filtering, and expert close reading, with prompts fully reproduced in Appendix A. Preference relevance is high because it sits at the intersection of LLMs, AI safety, data curation, and text classification, though it is an audit rather than a methodological contribution. Novelty is moderate: political-content training-data audits exist (Ceron et al., Stammbach et al.), but multi-definition extremism estimation with union checks is a new angle. Rigor is limited by a 30-document, single-coder validation sample with no inter-annotator agreement, no false-negative screening (openly conceded in Section 3 and Limitations), ad hoc union-check thresholds, and subjective model-comparison judgments. Evidence strength is mid-range: Table 1 reports counts with standard errors and the headline 1/2000 rate is conservative, but the extrapolation to 'hundreds of thousands' of documents carries acknowledged order-of-magnitude uncertainty. Generalizability is moderate since Dolma is not representative of proprietary corpora. Reproducibility is partial: prompts, models, and quantization levels are specified, but no code or released sample is mentioned.

primary_link.title: Beyond the pale: Assessing prevalence and contents of extremist speech in LLM training data

In this work, we address the question of whether LLMs are exposed to unfiltered, uncontextualised extremist speech. Using several definitions of extremist speech, stemming from official documents and research literature, and an extraction pipeline combini
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型預訓練語料中是否含有極端主義言論，先前缺乏系統性檢視。本文以 Dolma（OLMo 系列的開放預訓練語料）為對象，透過水庫抽樣取得 20 萬份文件，採用英國政府定義與 Berger、Schmid 兩種學術定義，以 Llama 3.3 70B、Qwen 2.5 72B、Qwen 3.5 27B、Gemma 4 31B 等中型模型做零樣本分類，經聯集檢核與 GPT 4o mini 二次過濾，最後由極端主義研究專家對抽樣文本細讀編碼。結果顯示 Qwen 3.5 在一致性與精確度間取得最佳平衡，保守估計極端主義文件的盛行率下限約為 1/2000，推回整體語料意味著數十萬份潛在極有害文件，內容涵蓋右翼極端敘事、仇恨言論與直接鼓吹暴力；值得注意的是樣本中未發現聖戰主義文本，僅有一則相關新聞。主要限制是無法全面複查被過濾的文件，只能提供下限估計，且低盛行率使抽樣變異偏大。此研究凸顯預訓練資料治理與篩選的急迫性：安全對齊不應只仰賴後訓練，也需在更早的訓練階段處理有害內容。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems paper on online load balancing for MoE LLM inference, squarely relevant to LLM serving/efficiency and MoE architecture preferences, though it contributes infrastructure rather than language methodology. The core idea—predicting the next layer's expert workload by re-invoking the frozen router on the previous layer's residual stream, then overlapping budgeted expert swaps with attention—is clean and reasonably novel versus reactive post-routing balancers (EPLB, UltraEP, MoonEP). Evaluation is solid on breadth (2 models, 20 LongBench workloads, swap-count ablation, length sensitivity) but weak on baselines (only Vanilla and history-driven EPLB), prefill-only (decode, where the overlap window vanishes, is untested), single 8-GPU NVLink node despite an inter-node cost model, and no prediction-error (delta) sensitivity analysis. Quantitative claims are specific and internally consistent, but no code artifact is provided and no limitations section exists.

primary_link.title: FreeBalance: Pre-Routing Online Moe Load Balancing via Residual Workload Prediction

radar.summary: Load imbalance poses a major bottleneck to the efficiency of expert parallelism in distributed inference of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The most heavily loaded rank stalls global execution due to skewed routing distributions, directly increasing latency. While offline expert placement can alleviate persistent imbalance, practical multi-task serving workloads exhibit layer- and batch-dependent routing dynamics, making online load balancing indispensable. Existing approaches rely on routing s
radar.summary_zh: Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）模型的專家並行推論常因路由分布偏斜造成負載不均，最重的 rank 拖慢全域執行。現有線上負載平衡須等路由結果出爐才能遷移專家權重，搬移開銷落在推論關鍵路徑上。本文觀察到殘差網路相鄰層的隱藏狀態高度相似，提出 FreeBalance：將前一層殘差表示餵入目標層的凍結路由器，提前預測專家工作負載，再以成本模型約束的成對專家交換規劃遷移，使權重搬移與注意力等前置計算重疊；預測僅用於放置決策，最終仍依原始路由執行，確保輸出無損。在 Qwen3-30B 與 Moonlight-16B 上以 LongBench 十九個子集評估：最大與平均負載比降低 32.8%，端對端 prefill 延遲降低 13.1%，平均每層隱藏約 5.1 個專家的搬移開銷（約占關鍵路徑 8.5%）；序列越長效益越大，8K 輸入時 TTFT 減少 23.3%。限制包括僅評估特定模型與工作負載、負載改善未線性轉為整體加速，且規劃品質依賴預測準確度。此方法為無損、可線上調適的 MoE 負載平衡提供了新方向。

links.title: Frontier AI Forecasting Has a Measurement Problem: An Audit of Progress Evidence

evidence: Abstract: 'Only seven systems jointly observe estimated training compute and a METR 50% task horizon'; '52 of 71 substantive quantitative events (73.2%) come from one measurement programme'.

Section 4 (Result 1): '19 of 27 closed systems lack a compute estimate, while all 35 open-weight systems in the sample have one'; missingness described as 'block-structured rather than merely incomplete'.

Section 6 / Table 1: METR TH1.0→TH1.1 log2 slope 1.206 (95% CI 1.021–1.390) with 63% power at observed departure; MMLU→MMLU-Pro logit slope 0.976, linear 1.312, logarithmic 1.984; 80% MDE ≈ 0.25, requiring ~23–31 systems for a 10% departure.
Section 5 (Result 2): 'source Herfindahl index is 0.542, equivalent to only 1.85 equally represented sources'; 76.1% of substantive events are laboratory releases.

Section 9 (Limitations): 'The 62 systems form a curated analytic sample, not a population estimate'; OLS 'treats the old transformed score as measured without error'; the review 'is not a registered systematic review or meta-analysis'.

Data and Code Availability: '26 CSV tables and an RDF graph in Turtle, together with a 27-source verification log and cutoff audit... A clean run rebuilds the normalized data, graph, linking and power analyses... without author-specific paths'.
Section 3.1: evidence freeze at '12 August 2026' from Epoch AI and Our World in Data; METR Time Horizon 1.1 observations 'frozen locally for reproducibility'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A metascience audit of the public frontier-AI (LLM) measurement record, centrally relevant to LLM evaluation, benchmarking, scaling-compute evidence and safety-evaluation practice (Red Teaming & Evaluation, LLMs, Scaling). It is methodological rather than a new LLM capability. Novelty is moderate: quantifying three bottlenecks (joint-observability sparsity, link-scale dependence, provenance concentration) is a fresh empirical framing, but benchmark-unreliability critiques and psychometric alternatives already exist. Rigor is careful (explicit estimand framing, OLS diagnostics with leave-one-out, noncentral-t power analysis, honest limitations), yet rests on tiny observational bridges (n=7, n=6), a curated non-census sample, and low power (63% and 6% at observed departures; MDE ~25%). Evidence strength is bounded accordingly: numbers are concrete and internally consistent but explicitly sample-specific and not independently replicated. Generalizability is limited by the paper's own framing that percentages are 'properties of this record'. Reproducibility is a clear strength: frozen public sources (Epoch AI/OWID, METR), 26 CSV tables, an RDF provenance graph, verification log, and a single-path reproduction entry point.

primary_link.title: Frontier AI Forecasting Has a Measurement Problem: An Audit of Progress Evidence

radar.summary: Quantitative forecasts of frontier artificial intelligence often connect dated targets to trends in benchmark scores, training compute, release time, or expert belief. This paper audits whether the public measurement record supports those connections before another trend is fitted. I construct a frozen, event-centric record through 12 August 2026 with 62 selected systems, 12 versioned benchmarks, seven capability or impact criteria, 144 graded events, 27 source records, and 408 typed relations.
radar.summary_zh: 前沿 AI 的定量預測常將日期目標連結到基準分數、訓練算力或專家信念等趨勢，但公開測量紀錄未必支撐這些連結。本文以事件為中心建構凍結的稽核紀錄：62 個系統、12 個版本化基準、144 個分級事件與 408 條型別化關係，據此檢驗聯合可觀測性、基準銜接與來源集中度。結果揭露三大瓶頸：訓練算力與 METR 任務時程僅在 7 個系統上同時可觀測，封閉系統普遍缺算力資料，缺失模式與開放/封閉之別高度相關；METR Time Horizon 1.0 到 1.1 的對數斜率為 1.206，並非單純平移，MMLU 到 MMLU-Pro 的銜接結果則隨尺度選擇而異；兩組橋接僅在偏離約 25% 時才有八成探測力，且 73.2% 的實質量化事件來自單一計畫。綜整 56 個來源歸納出 16 個互補測量方向，但沒有單一指標可取代整體組合。限制在於樣本為人工策展、橋接規模小且僅使用公開證據。本文的價值在於指出：可辯護的預測應是對版本化測量系統的科學主張，須揭露測量工具、協定與來源相依性的不確定性。
radar.title: Frontier AI Forecasting Has a Measurement Problem: An Audit of Progress Evidence
radar.title_zh: 前沿 AI 預測的測量問題：進展證據的稽核

Section 5.2: 'MM Avg. increases from 54.68 to 64.12, corresponding to a 17.3% relative improvement' across nine matched backbones; arithmetic verified from Table 3 values.

Section 5.3: ablation (SI/LI, CT/ST variants) is run only on Wukong's 540 questions with GPT-4o, limiting the ablation's generalizability; 95% CIs reported (x̄ ± 1.96s/√540).

Section 5.1.2: controlled settings documented — BGE-M3 shared retriever, hybrid dense/sparse weights 0.7/0.3, temperature 0.2, 15-text/10-image budget, Recipe subset sampled to 500 QA pairs with seed 36.

Abstract and Conclusion: code claimed at github.com/MCCodeAI/HAM-RAG.git, but no verification of release; Wukong subset built from 'publicly available Black Myth: Wukong walkthroughs' with underspecified provenance relative to the WikiWeb2M/MinerU-traced subsets (Section 4.1).
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope multimodal RAG paper with strong LLM/RAG methodology (LLM and MLLM generators, retrieval grounding, structured prompts), not pure CV. Core idea — injecting document-hierarchy context into text/image evidence representations for interleaved generation — is reasonable but incremental over Wiki-LLaVA/M3DocRAG/MLDocRAG-style structural retrieval; Img-CBS and HAM-Bench add moderate novelty. Rigor is solid for a systems/benchmark paper (matched budgets, shared BGE-M3 retriever, 9 matched backbones, ablation with 95% CIs, failure and cost accounting) but weakened by reliance on author-defined LLM-judge metrics with no human validation, a single-dataset/single-generator ablation (Wukong, GPT-4o), and comparison only against reimplemented paradigms rather than published multimodal RAG systems. Quantitative claims are internally consistent (MM Avg 54.68→64.12 = 17.3% relative verified from Table 3; 57,123 runs matches 33 generator configs × 1,731 QA pairs), though the headline 24.2% Img-CBS gain compares best-of-framework across different backbones. Code and benchmark availability are claimed but unverifiable; proprietary backbones limit reproducibility.

primary_link.title: HAM-RAG: Hierarchy-Aware Multimodal RAG for Structure-Faithful Interleaved Generation

radar.summary: Existing multimodal RAG methods often flatten structured documents into isolated text and image units, weakening the source organization and local text-image logic needed for faithful evidence selection and placement. We propose HAM-RAG, a Hierarchy-Aware Multimodal RAG framework for structure-faithful interleaved generation. HAM-RAG uses document hierarchy as a grounding signal across retrieval and generation, contextualizing textual and visual evidence and preserving source position and local
radar.summary_zh: 多模態檢索增強生成（RAG）常把結構化文件攤平成零散的文字與圖片，忽略章節層級與圖文對應，導致答案無法忠實呈現來源組織。本文提出 HAM-RAG，把文件層級視為檢索與生成階段的核心接地訊號：文字單元附加標題路徑與章節脈絡，圖片單元保留來源位置、說明文字、鄰近文本與情境感知的視覺描述，並以結構化提示組織證據，支援交錯式圖文生成。研究另建構 HAM-Bench，涵蓋遊戲攻略（Wukong）、網頁（Wiki）、論文（arXiv）與食譜（Recipe）四類文件，包含原生與重建層級及圖文對齊標註。實驗顯示，跨九個骨幹模型，HAM-RAG 的主要多模態平均比最強非層級基準提升 17.3%，Wukong 的 Img-CBS 提升 24.2%；消融實驗證實圖片層級脈絡貢獻最大，整體失敗率僅約 0.067%。限制包括 arXiv 子集的圖片召回低於攤平基線、食譜子集採抽樣評估，以及每題成本高於規則式方法。此研究對技術手冊、維護指南與 SOP 等需忠實呈現流程結構的可靠多模態助理深具意義。
radar.title: HAM-RAG: Hierarchy-Aware Multimodal RAG for Structure-Faithful Interleaved Generation
