links.title: Beyond Capacity: Scalable MoE LLM Inference via High-Bandwidth Flash with Direct GPU and HBM Paths

evidence: Abstract: claims 1.94x throughput and 1.90x end-to-end speedup over a RelayOnly design for a representative MoE workload

Section VI-A: evaluation extends LLMSimulator [38] with HBF modeling; GPU timing model achieves median relative error 0.51% and 90% of errors below 3.52% across 1,107 validation measurements on H100 PCIe
Section VI-B: DASH achieves geometric-mean throughput speedups of 1.90x over RelayOnly and 1.84x over DirectOnly across five models and batch sizes, with E2E latency reductions of 42.2% and 40.8%
Section V-C: lookahead expert execution provides exact early top-k only when routing is scale-invariant and free of expert-specific additive bias; DeepSeek-V3 uses conventional late selection
Section VI-C: even a Hybrid oracle over CPU/GPU splits remains 8.22-12.32x slower than DASH
Section VI-H: endurance is projected analytically (0.645-year continuous at WAF=1, u=1); authors state deployed-lifetime claims require target-device measurements
Section VI-G: HBF per-stack price not reported by the fact sheet, so cost-per-capacity analysis is parametric with illustrative anchor r=1
llm_evaluation.rationale: A computer-architecture paper proposing DASH, an HBM+HBF memory topology for MoE LLM inference. It aligns with the Inference & Serving, Scaling & Efficiency, and MoE/Transformer preferences (KV cache, batching, throughput/latency) but not with the highest-weight preferences (no LLM methodology, reasoning, agents, or Japanese NLP content). Novelty is moderate: dual direct+relay HBF delivery and exact early top-k selection via RMSNorm algebraic decomposition are new, but KV write scheduling and HBF-as-capacity-tier ideas build closely on prior HBF works, and lookahead applies only to bias-free, scale-invariant routers (Section V-C excludes DeepSeek-V3). Rigor is comparatively strong for a simulation study: validated GPU timing model (median 0.51% error over 1,107 measurements, Section VI-A), four architectural baselines, CPU-offload oracle comparison (Section VI-C), and sweeps over tR, tPROG, page size, and bandwidth (Section VI-F). Evidence is simulation-only on a not-yet-manufactured HBF device with assumed parameters (4 KiB pages, 4 subarrays/plane, 3us/100us latencies), limiting external validity; endurance is analytically projected, not measured (Section VI-H), and cost analysis is parametric because HBF pricing is unavailable (Section VI-G). Model coverage (six MoE LLMs, batch 1-64, contexts to 1M) supports generalizability within MoE serving. Reproducibility is partial: base simulator is pinned via GitHub commit, model configs and workloads are specified, but no DASH artifact release is claimed.

primary_link.title: Beyond Capacity: Scalable MoE LLM Inference via High-Bandwidth Flash with Direct GPU and HBM Paths

radar.summary: Modern mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models increasingly strain the capacity and cost efficiency of high-bandwidth memory (HBM), as rapidly growing expert weights must be provisioned close to GPUs. High-bandwidth flash (HBF) offers substantially greater capacity, but conventional designs typically deliver HBF-resident expert weights to the GPU through HBM, leaving an additional direct GPU-HBF connection underutilized. We explore an HBF organization that simultaneously exploits two independen
radar.summary_zh: 大型 MoE 語言模型的專家權重動輒數百 GB 至 1.5 TB，遠超單一 HBM 容量。高頻寬快閃記憶體（HBF）提供大容量，但傳統設計須經 HBM 中轉，直接 GPU–HBF 連結未被善用。本文提出 DASH：以 UCIe 讓 HBM 與 HBF 獨立掛載於 GPU，並增設 HBM–HBF 專屬路徑，形成直接與中繼雙路徑並行的專家權重傳送；資料依可變性放置，模型權重與 KV 快取在抹除區塊層級分離，避免垃圾回收干擾；並透過前瞻式專家判定，在傳統路由完成前先算出 top-k 專家、提前發起 HBF 讀取以隱藏 NAND 感測延遲，再以 prefill 直接寫入與 decode 緩衝合併寫回排程 KV 寫入。事件驅動模擬顯示，代表性工作負載下相較僅中繼設計可達 1.94 倍吞吐量與 1.90 倍端對端加速，連續批次服務下 P90 延遲降低 53.5%，也遠優於 CPU 卸載方案（慢 8.22 至 12.32 倍）。限制包括結果基於模擬、HBF 完整規格未公開使參數屬推估，寫入壽命僅為投影估計。此架構把 HBF 從容量擴充層提升為一等記憶體層，對可擴充 MoE 推論深具意義。
radar.title: Beyond Capacity: Scalable MoE LLM Inference via High-Bandwidth Flash with Direct GPU and HBM Paths
radar.title_zh: 超越容量極限：以直接 GPU 與 HBM 路徑的高頻寬快閃記憶體實現可擴充 MoE LLM 推論

links.title: LLMs Can Predict Failure Risk, But Struggle to Predict Which Collaboration Protocol Pays Off: Cost-Aware Protocol Routing Across Reasoning Tasks

evidence: Abstract: post-answer gpt-oss-120b probe ranks Baseline failures at 0.8847 AUROC (4,151 parseable cases; 95% CI [0.8732, 0.8955]) but only 0.1674 and 0.1041 AUPRC for PER- and Broadcast-specific value.

Section 3 / Table 1: self-confidence gate reaches 78.0% [74.0, 81.8] solve at 45.0K tokens vs. frozen gpt-oss-120b router 73.8% at 71.3K; directional errors reported (gpt-oss router over-escalates 33.3%, Llama/Gemma routers over-escalate 63-71%).
Appendix A.3: 'The model-call file and scoring labels are physically separated... A schema validator rejects forbidden keys, and the saved leakage checks pass in all six settings' (Table S4).

Section 5 / Table S2: fixed-order-oracle coverage exceeds Baseline by 23.2-58.3 points across 10 paired model-condition settings spanning OmniMath 2, JEEBench, SciBench, and LAB-Bench with two solver families.

Section 7 Limitations: 'Each problem-protocol pair has one deterministic realized outcome' and cost is 'primarily in logged tokens,' with CIs quantifying benchmark-problem variation, not fresh-run variability.

Appendix F: companion dataset archive at huggingface.co/datasets/ChihHsuan-Yang/scientific-agent-protocol-traces with anonymized four-protocol traces, plus ancillary CSVs in the arXiv source package; restricted-license problems released as identifiers/reconstruction instructions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work on cost-aware routing across multi-agent collaboration protocols (Baseline/Single/PER/Broadcast) for reasoning tasks; squarely within high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents, reasoning). The matched four-protocol design with offline oracle evaluation and the explicit failure-risk vs. protocol-value distinction is a solid, moderately novel empirical contribution; routing/cascades exist (FrugalGPT, RouteLLM, MasRouter) but matched-outcome protocol-level analysis is less common. Rigor is strong: stratified seeded splits, dev-only selection, leakage checks (Appendix A.3), 2,000-resample bootstrap CIs, multiple ablations (tier removal, source holdout, embedding routers, cross-model confidence), and an honest limitations section. Evidence is quantitative and consistent (0.8847 AUROC failure risk vs. 0.1674/0.1041 AUPRC for protocol-specific value; 10 paired settings with 23.2-58.3 point oracle gains), though each problem-protocol pair is a single deterministic realization, limiting outcome-noise coverage. Generalizability is deliberately bounded (main routers on one solver/benchmark; six-setting confidence/router subset); the paper itself frames results as task-dependent, not universal. Reproducibility is high: full prompts, seeds, hyperparameters, compute accounting, HuggingFace trace archive, and ancillary CSVs.

primary_link.title: LLMs Can Predict Failure Risk, But Struggle to Predict Which Collaboration Protocol Pays Off: Cost-Aware Protocol Routing Across Reasoning Tasks

top5.summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems can improve reasoning by spending more computation, but deployment requires deciding when extra collaboration is worth its cost. We isolate this decision by running every problem under four protocols while holding the solver fixed within each setting: direct solving (Baseline), iterative self-correction (Single), planner-executor-reviewer collaboration (PER), and multi-agent deliberation (Broadcast). The primary benchmark comprises 4,181 competition
top5.summary_zh: 多代理 LLM 系統靠投入更多運算提升推理表現，但部署時必須判斷額外協作是否值得其成本。本文在固定 solver 下對 4,181 道競賽級數學題（Omni-MATH 2 子集）執行四種協定：直接求解（Baseline）、迭代自我修正（Single）、規劃—執行—審查協作（PER）與多代理商議（Broadcast），並比較固定策略、輕量學習與凍結 LLM 路由器及自我信心閘門。作者區分失敗風險預測（Baseline 是否會錯）與協作價值預測（哪個協定值得加價）。答題後探針以 0.8847 AUROC 預測 Baseline 失敗，對「任何協作是否有幫助」仍具參考性（0.7683 AUPRC），但對 PER 或 Broadcast 專屬價值的 AUPRC 驟降至 0.1674 與 0.1041。路由錯誤具方向性：保守策略傾向升級不足，高解題率凍結路由器則過度升級。自我信心閘門以 45K tokens 達 78.0% 解題率，優於凍結路由器的 73.8%，仍落後回溯性固定順序 oracle 的 92.4%。跨 JEEBench、SciBench、LAB-Bench 等四基準與兩種 solver 的十組配對設定中，oracle 較 Baseline 高 23.2–58.3 個百分點；六組保留測試中路由器與 oracle 仍差 18.5–28.9 點。限制包括每題僅單次確定性執行、成本以 tokens 計量、oracle 不可部署。本研究診斷性地分離「是否升級」與「升級到哪」兩個決策，為成本感知路由的後續研究提供可測量目標。
top5.title: LLMs Can Predict Failure Risk, But Struggle to Predict Which Collaboration Protocol Pays Off: Cost-Aware Protocol Routing Across Reasoning Tasks
top5.title_zh: LLM 能預測失敗風險，卻難以判斷哪種協作協定值得投入：跨推理任務的成本感知協定路由

links.title: You Only Pass Once: Answering and Abstaining Together in a Single Forward Pass of a Frozen Language Model

evidence: Abstract and Section 6 Table 2: label-free de-contamination lifts 1.5B one-pass transfer AUROC 0.836->0.888 against a 0.918 two-pass ceiling, recovering 63% of contamination, while the flagship (de-contam + BCE boost) tops in-domain at every scale (0.982/0.984/0.997).

Section 4 Table 1: steering write costs the gate 8.2 transfer points at 1.5B and 3.1 at 3B; at 7B the effect inverts in-domain (steered 0.995 vs clean 0.985), establishing the scale-dependent interference claim.

Section 9 Table 5: one-pass flagship beats the two-pass reference on 10 of 10 backbones across six families (0.5B-7B), with repaired gate AUROC >=0.963 everywhere despite family-dependent perturbation sizes (SmolLM2 0.975->0.754 naive).

Section 10 construction audit: the alphaNLI 4-condition set separates at layer 11 (AUROC 0.908), so constructed in-domain gate numbers are explicitly re-scoped as controlled-construction results anchored on native-label replications (SQuAD2, RepLiQA, MuSiQue).

Section 11: multi-layer reconstruction map fails to converge at 7B (AUROC 0.50) and a per-feature-standardized fix leaks task signature by the paper's own mechanism; reported as the registered failure with the identity-anchored single-layer map as the robust variant.

Section 12 Limitations: most grid cells are single-seed with full error bars pending; the cross-family grid covers one benchmark axis (alphaNLI) at <=8B; the paper is a consolidation of two author-group research lines.

Reproducibility Statement and Appendix C: all numbers recomputable from committed per-item logs and named scripts (e.g., scripts/m28b_eval.py, scripts/m39_score.py), public datasets, documented Apple-silicon workarounds; large binaries excluded from the repository.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: a conditional activation-steering writer and a zero-shot sufficiency-direction reader are fused in one forward pass of frozen backbones (Qwen2.5 1.5B/3B/7B plus nine other backbones), with a label-free denoising repair of write-read interference as the technical core. Strong match to LLM, reasoning/CoT, interpretability (residual-stream steering, directions, probing), and hallucination/abstention preferences. Novelty is genuine: the write-read interference problem, the reconstruction-based repair trained without sufficiency labels, the quantified capacity-transfer frontier, and the write-access ladder (read-only > constrained write > free write under shift) are new contributions beyond prior steering/answerability work. Rigor is unusually high: controlled grids, cross-implementation replication between two codebases, McNemar testing, seed checks, a self-audit exposing a construction artifact in its own alphaNLI benchmark, and a documented negative-results section. Evidence is abundant and carefully scoped, though many grid cells are single-seed, the scale ladder tops out at 8B, and key numbers come from self-constructed redaction benchmarks (flagged by the authors' own audit and partially anchored on native labels). Generalizability is supported across six model families but limited to one cross-family benchmark axis and a narrow task range. Reproducibility is well supported by named scripts, per-item logs, and hyperparameters, though no explicit public repository URL is given in the text.

primary_link.title: You Only Pass Once: Answering and Abstaining Together in a Single Forward Pass of a Frozen Language Model

top5.summary: A frozen language model on reasoning tasks has two coupled weaknesses: it under-uses evidence its own residual stream already encodes, and it fails to detect when the input is insufficient to answer, so it confabulates. This paper consolidates two research lines that address these on the same residual stream: a conditional steering probe writes the stream at mid-stack layers and recovers reasoning accuracy from a frozen backbone, and a zero-shot sufficiency direction reads the stream and abstain
top5.summary_zh: 本文針對凍結語言模型的兩個耦合弱點：殘差流已編碼卻未善用的證據，以及無法察覺輸入不足而幻覺作答。作者整合兩條研究路線：於中間層寫入的條件式引導探針提升推理，以及讀取殘差流、資訊不足即拒答的零樣本充分性方向。兩者在單次前向傳遞中互相干擾：引導寫入污染充分性讀取，1.5B 模型跨域 AUROC 最多損失 8 點。解法是固定該方向，訓練小型去污染映射，僅以 MSE 從引導後殘差重建乾淨殘差，不用任何充分性標籤，因而保留轉移能力。YOPO 在凍結 Qwen2.5 單次前向傳遞內同時完成回答、引導與拒答：1.5B 轉移 AUROC 由 0.836 升至 0.888（上限 0.918），域內 0.959；含監督 BCE boost 的旗艦版各規模域內居首，端對端三向準確率在 1.5B αNLI 由 0.375 升至 0.798，並於 6 個模型家族 10 個骨幹全面超越兩次傳遞參考。於首創四域 answer-or-abstain 基準，監督門控域內領先，最難來源擬合的免標籤方向為唯一跨域存活者；chain-of-thought 使 MuSiQue 可答多跳問答由 0.062 升至 0.313。限制含 αNLI 建構資料的早期層捷徑痕跡（經來源端審計證實）、多層重建映射於 7B 不收斂，及多數實驗僅單一種子。本文量化印證「拒答不應訓練進去、擾動應以免標籤還原」的設計法則，對凍結模型可靠部署意義重大。
top5.title: You Only Pass Once: Answering and Abstaining Together in a Single Forward Pass of a Frozen Language Model
top5.title_zh: You Only Pass Once：在凍結語言模型的單次前向傳遞中同時回答與拒答

links.title: Do LLMs Know What to Ask and When? Evaluating Multi-Turn Information Seeking

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: MT-InfoSeek instantiates a k-underspecified CSP formulation with 5,251 problems and 9,006 task instances spanning mathematics, logic, biology, medicine, and general knowledge.
Section 4, Takeaway 1/Fig. 3: k-prediction accuracy falls below 0.5 for k>=2, and at k=2 models predict a smaller k more than 4x as often as a larger one.

Appendix C.5: reruns under random and cooperative oracles confirm robustness - final sufficiency drops 29.7-41.9 pp (random) and 25.0-39.0 pp (cooperative) from k=1 to k=4 for four representative models.

Appendix C.6, Tables 4-10: LLM-based oracles (20Q, ClinGuide-MT) validated via 91.9-97.7% within-oracle consistency, 94.0% cross-oracle agreement, and human audits of 300 20Q questions and 200 ClinGuide oracle responses.

Appendix G.1.4, Table 22: prompt-perturbation study with problem-level cluster bootstrap (10,000 resamples, Holm correction) shows meaning-preserving reordering (P1) is within run-to-run noise for all tested models.
Appendix G.1.5, Table 23: force-ask intervention at k=3 raises final sufficiency by +25.7 pp for Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-FP8 (exact McNemar p<5e-4), with no significant effect for GPT-5-mini.

Appendix G.1.1/G.1.2: pooled fixed-effect regressions with interaction-clustered SEs show MSS relative mention rate predicts final sufficiency (beta_z=0.528, p=6.71e-45) while generic awareness does not (beta_z=0.005, p=0.853).
Appendix D, Table 11: per-dataset statistics given (e.g., Logic-Q-MT 600 problems/1200 tasks; GeneReg-MT 800 problems/2326 tasks; ClinGuide-MT 370 problems/1595 tasks).
Appendix E.2: open-weight models served with vLLM on H100 GPUs with documented tensor-parallelism, 131,072-token context, and FP8 KV cache settings.
Appendix A (Ethics statement): 'We have released code, data, and prompts to support reproducibility, auditing, and further stress-testing.'
Section 5 (Limitations): authors note equal-cost query assumption, LLM-based oracles for ClinGuide-MT/20Q, and that ClinGuide-MT 'does not establish clinical readiness.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference match: an LLM-centric evaluation paper on multi-turn information seeking, intersecting LLMs, agents/tool-use-style interaction, reasoning (Logic-Q-MT, CoT trace analysis), and benchmark/evaluation methodology; the clinical and gene-regulation domains are evaluation substrates for LLM behavior rather than out-of-scope medical-AI or biology-foundation-model work. Novelty is solid but incremental: it extends QuestBench's k=1 CSP formulation to multi-turn k>1 with ground-truth MSSs and a 'final sufficiency' metric that separates acquisition from answering (Table 2 positions it as uniquely combining objective query labels, timing/order, and target control). Rigor is a standout: formal CSP definitions, adversarial/random/cooperative oracle robustness reruns (Appendix C.5), LLM-oracle reliability audits with human validation (Appendix C.6), prompt-sensitivity and MSS-resampling studies with cluster bootstrap and Holm correction (Appendix G.1.4, G.1.6), a force-ask intervention (Appendix G.1.5), and non-inferiority testing for first-turn-miss recovery. Evidence is quantitative and largely supports the takeaways (e.g., k-prediction accuracy <0.5 for k>=2 with >4x under-prediction at k=2; regression-adjusted CoT mention-rate effects), though some analyses rest on ~14-17 models and correlational comparisons, and a few models were run on reduced conditions. Generalizability is capped by the controlled setting: equal query costs, predefined queryable variables in structured domains, oracle-based rather than realistic user models - limitations the authors acknowledge in Section 5. Reproducibility is good: full prompts (Appendix E.1), vLLM serving details (Appendix E.2), dataset statistics (Table 11), and a stated release of code, data, and prompts (Appendix A).

primary_link.title: Do LLMs Know What to Ask and When? Evaluating Multi-Turn Information Seeking

top5.summary: When a user question is underspecified, a capable model should recognize that its context is insufficient, identify the missing information, ask for it, and respond only once that information determines a unique answer. We formalize multi-turn information seeking as solving a k-underspecified constraint satisfaction problem, where k is the number of variables jointly required to determine the target and therefore measures the degree of missing information. We instantiate the formulation in MT-In
top5.summary_zh: 哈佛大學團隊系統性評估大型語言模型（LLM）的多輪資訊尋求能力：當使用者問題欠明確（underspecified）時，理想模型應察覺脈絡不足並主動詢問缺少的資訊，直到該資訊足以唯一決定答案才回答。作者將此過程形式化為 k-欠明確約束滿足問題（k-underspecified CSP），k 為共同決定目標所需的最少變數數，並建構 MT-InfoSeek 評測套件，涵蓋數學、邏輯、生物、醫療與常識，共 5,251 個問題、9,006 個任務實例。評測分三軸：預測欠明確程度 k、辨識最小充分集合（MSS）、多輪循序互動解題，並以「最終充分性」（final sufficiency）區分資訊尋求與答案生成兩種能力。主要結果：模型能察覺資訊不足卻普遍低估其程度，在 k=2 邏輯題上低估約為高估的四倍；即使給定真實 k，仍難選出最小充分集合；互動常在資訊未充分時提前作答。隨 k 增大，成功更仰賴跨回合持續追問，首次提問失誤多可挽回；在講究順序依賴的臨床診斷任務（ClinGuide-MT）中，即使取得全部必要資訊，錯誤的提問順序仍會降低準確率；20Q 實驗顯示提問資訊量高不等於成功，證據整合能力同樣關鍵。限制：各提問皆視為等成本，ClinGuide-MT 與 20Q 由 LLM 擔任 oracle（經一致性與人工驗證），nEIG 指標依賴代理候選池，結果不代表臨床就緒。本研究指出最終準確率無法衡量互動素養，評測應記錄模型是否察覺資訊不足、需要哪些變數、以及是否確實透過多輪互動取得，MT-InfoSeek 提供了可控且具真值標註的評估框架。
top5.title: Do LLMs Know What to Ask and When? Evaluating Multi-Turn Information Seeking
top5.title_zh: LLM 知道該問什麼、何時提問嗎？——多輪資訊尋求能力評估

links.title: AnchorBench: A Multi-Pathway Benchmark for the Anchoring Effect in LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'Across fourteen models, including ten open-weight models and four frontier API models... (1) anchoring is strongly pathway-dependent, (2) plausible anchors usually induce larger shifts than irrelevant ones... (4) high task accuracy... does not guarantee robustness'
§3.2: 'an irrelevant and a plausible condition in the same direction use an identical numeric anchor value a; only the surrounding sentence differs' — defines the relevance axis

§3.3: 'Each suite contains 360 items (6 domains × 60 items) in five conditions, giving 1,800 prompts per model per suite'; 'External and RAG have no format confounds and provide the strongest cross-model evidence'
§3.4: definitions of MAE_c, Acc_10, UAI (Eq. 3), TAR (Eq. 4), and Disc_Δ (Eq. 5) with exclusion rule ε=3 and stability across ε∈{1,3,5} (Appendix A.6)
§4.2: 'Across the 69 model–suite cells with computable Disc_Δ, 55 (80%) show positive discrimination... Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirm the pattern on External, RAG, and Tool (p_BH<0.01)'

§4.4: 'Task accuracy and anchoring discrimination are only weakly correlated (r=-0.24, bootstrap 95% CI [-0.43, -0.00])'; 'all four achieve ≥96% accuracy on External yet show positive Disc_Δ (0.05–0.16)'

§4.5 / Table 2: partial-evidence stress test where 'Three of the four models exceed the ceiling at some k', with Gemma-4B as a counterexample showing the design does not mechanically force positive UAI

Appendix A.10: 'matched-format analysis reduces Disc_Δ by up to 70% for some models' for History; Appendix A.12: 'Cross-model Tool-suite comparisons... mix formats... and should be interpreted accordingly'

Appendix A.17.7 footnote 2: batched GPU inference 'is not bitwise reproducible even at temperature 0'; baseline UAI_pls spans 0.32–0.39 across three runs for one cell — transparent reporting of run-to-run variance
Limitations: 'synthetic deterministic-aggregation tasks make comparison clean but do not cover the complexity of real judgment, and some pathways require cautious interpretation'

Reproducibility statement: 'Code and the benchmark data are at https://github.com/Ydrg9989/AnchorBench' and HF Hub release covering '14,400 prompts, each carrying its gold answer', with checksummed raw generations (~520 MB)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark for the anchoring effect in LLMs, squarely within core LLM evaluation/robustness scope: it spans LLMs (§3.5, 14-model panel), AI-safety/robustness framing (abstract: 'even frontier API models above 95% control accuracy remain susceptible'), RAG and Tool-use pathways (§3.3), ICL (§3.3), and CoT prompting mitigations (Appendix A.16/A.17.7), making it highly preference-relevant. Novelty is moderate rather than high: LLM anchoring is already documented (Related Work cites Nguyen 2024, Lou & Sun 2025, SynAnchors), and the contribution is breadth — five pathways in one setup plus an irrelevant-vs-plausible relevance axis with matched anchor values (§3.2) — plus a rational-updating ceiling UAI=0.167 as a practical-significance threshold (§4.4, A.17.1). Rigor and evidence are strong: standardized inference with greedy decoding and 99.9% median parse rate (§3.5), Wilcoxon tests with BH correction and bootstrap CIs (Table 10), exclusion-threshold sensitivity (A.6), boundary-clipping sensitivity (A.8), sampling robustness (A.15), and unusually honest confound handling — History single-stage control (A.10, up to 70% DiscΔ reduction) and Tool structured-vs-plaintext format mixing (A.12). They even report batched-GPU run-to-run variation (A.17.7 footnote 2). Claims are consistently matched to data. Generalizability is limited by the synthetic deterministic-aggregation task (Limitations: 'synthetic deterministic-aggregation tasks... do not cover the complexity of real judgment'), partially mitigated by domain and large-model extensions (A.17.5, A.17.11) and a partial-evidence stress test with rational ceilings (§4.5). Reproducibility is excellent: code and 14,400 released prompts with gold answers on GitHub/HF Hub plus checksummed raw generations (Reproducibility statement). No unsupported headline claims detected; the main deductions are incremental novelty and limited external validity.

primary_link.title: AnchorBench: A Multi-Pathway Benchmark for the Anchoring Effect in LLMs

top5.summary: The anchoring effect is a cognitive bias in which an initial reference value shifts a later judgment toward itself. This effect is well established in human judgment and decision-making, and recent work suggests that large language models (LLMs) exhibit similar behavior. However, existing work on anchoring in LLMs typically evaluates only a narrow set of anchor pathways and rarely distinguishes irrelevant from plausible anchors. We introduce AnchorBench, a benchmark for the anchoring effect in L
top5.summary_zh: 本研究針對大型語言模型（LLM）的錨定效應——即初始參考值使後續判斷向其偏移的認知偏誤——提出AnchorBench基準。現有研究多半只檢驗少數錨定路徑，也鮮少區分無關錨點與貌似合理的錨點。本基準涵蓋五種錨點傳遞途徑：External（提示詞）、History（對話）、ICL（範例）、RAG（檢索文件）與Tool（工具輸出），並引入錨點相關性軸，將情境分為對照、無關與合理三類。每個題目皆為0–100的數值聚合任務，標準答案僅由證據決定，因而可衡量偏移是否合理，指標包含Acc₁₀、UAI、TAR與鑑別度差距DiscΔ。團隊評估十四個模型（十個開放權重、四個前沿API模型），主要發現：錨定強烈依賴途徑，External與RAG效應最廣，ICL（中繼資料）近零；合理錨點引起的偏移通常大於無關錨點；錨點離證據支持的答案越遠，影響力大致遞減；高準確率不代表穩健，控制條件準確率逾95%的前沿模型仍受合理錨點影響。作者另以部分證據的壓力測試與誤差分解佐證效應真實存在。限制包括任務為合成題、History與Tool途徑受格式混淆影響、小型效應對排除規則敏感，且提示詞緩解只能減弱而無法根除。此研究提醒：平均準確率不足以保證LLM判斷可靠，穩健性評估必須檢視數值情境實際抵達模型的各種途徑，對醫療等高風險決策支援場景尤為重要。
top5.title: AnchorBench: A Multi-Pathway Benchmark for the Anchoring Effect in LLMs
top5.title_zh: AnchorBench：針對大型語言模型錨定效應的多途徑基準測試

links.title: Regime-Conditional Verification: Correctness Estimation for Adapting and Monitoring Safety Classifiers

evidence: Abstract: RCV improves adherence in every classifier–dataset combination, catching up to 0.81 of previously missed unsafe content without modifying the underlying classifier.
Table 1: adherence rises in all six cells (largest Beaver on PKU-SafeRLHF 0.787→0.920); caught share spans 0.29–0.81 across cells with ten-seed stds.
Ablations / Fig. 4: per-regime routing exceeds pooled AUROC in every cell of a three-probe-family ablation by 0.2–4.6 pp; routed linear probe beats pooled GBT (0.961 vs 0.913 on Beaver).
Appendix B.1 / Table T1: re-scoring against unused human labels moves corrected adherence toward the oracle–human agreement level (0.9195 / 0.9298) in 48 of 50 seeds (paired p ≤ 0.042).
Detection section: monitor alarms in 100/100 runs before the 0.30 attack-rate cap, median attack rate 0.115; null false-alarm rate 14/90 (Clopper–Pearson CI [0.088, 0.247]).
Gate outcomes / Fig. 6 and Tables T5–T6: 79/100 episodes repair in place under the deployed budget (median 600 labels), 87/100 under the data bound; 13 never pass the gate at any audit size.

Appendix B.5 / Tables T3–T4: fine-tune+probe passes the powered acceptance gate in 5/5 trainer seeds (recall s.d. 0.004 vs raw fine-tune 0.019), but the authors concede base+probe also passes on the powered set, so the fine-tune's necessity is not established.

Limitations: detection limited to one classifier over ten held-out families; end-to-end loop on one deployment; both datasets English single-turn; drift simulated via category hold-out injection, not naturally occurring; white-box access required and score-only probe recovers adherence but far less caught share.

Appendix D: extraction recipes reproduce representations at cosine 0.99995–0.99997; seeds, splits, design constants (Table T9), per-stage compute (Table T10), and SHA-256 provenance digests; code, judge prompt, label map, and dataset rebuild scripts are claimed to be released.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodology paper squarely in LLM safety: probes the internal representations of frozen LLM-based safety classifiers (Llama-Guard-3, WildGuard, Beaver) to estimate verdict correctness under a deployer policy, flips wrong verdicts, and reuses the same estimates for label-free drift monitoring and a maintenance loop. Preference match is strong (LLMs, AI safety, evaluation, probing/interpretability), and it is not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: correctness probes and per-verdict calibration have precedents (ConfidNet, top-label calibration, judge-correctness probes); the contributions are the verdict-regime conditioning (backed by a simple but correct Proposition 1), using the estimate to correct rather than abstain, and the combined correction+monitor+maintenance loop. Rigor is high: 10-seed protocol, routing vs pooled ablation across three probe families (routing wins all 60 paired comparisons, AUROC +0.2–4.6 pp), probe-input ablations (internal state beats confidence score in 119/120 paired comparisons and beats TF-IDF in all 12 cells), human-label re-scoring bounding oracle bias (48/50 seeds move toward the oracle–human agreement level), matched false-alarm baseline comparison (score-KS, ATC), and Clopper–Pearson intervals. Evidence is strong but confined to simulated drift: detection 100/100 runs at median attack rate 0.115 with 14/90 null alarms; 79/100 episodes repair in place at deployed budget (87/100 at data bound). Caveats: the oracle is a single LLM judge (κ=0.838/0.766) on which the probes are trained while the raw classifier is not — an acknowledged asymmetry only partially bounded; a base+probe comparator also passes the powered gate in the fine-tune experiment (Table T4), weakening the necessity claim for escalation. Generalizability is limited: English single-turn moderation, white-box access required, detection on one classifier, end-to-end loop on one deployment. Reproducibility is excellent: released code, label map, rebuild scripts, extraction recipes verified to cosine ≥0.99995, pinned seeds/splits/design constants and provenance digests.

primary_link.title: Regime-Conditional Verification: Correctness Estimation for Adapting and Monitoring Safety Classifiers

top5.summary: Safety classifiers deployed with large language models often fail for two reasons: their decisions reflect the policy learned during training rather than the deployer's desired policy, and their performance degrades as deployment traffic evolves. top5.summary_zh: 部署於大型語言模型應用的安全分類器有兩大失效：其判決反映訓練時習得的隱含政策，未必符合部署者所需；且隨流量分布漂移，判決品質逐漸衰退。本文提出 Regime-Conditional Verification（RCV），一個輕量外掛層，在不重訓分類器的前提下讀取其內部表徵，估計每筆判決與部署者政策不一致的機率，並翻轉估計錯誤的判決。核心發現是估計須依分類器判決分區：safe 判決只可能漏放違規，unsafe 判決只可能過度封鎖，兩種錯誤結構不同，故每個區間各有獨立探針與校準映射。同一組正確性估計亦提供免標籤的漂移訊號，驅動維護迴圈：警報觸發稽核與探針更新，僅在修復無效時才升級至 fine-tuning。實驗涵蓋三個現成分類器與兩個英文資料集，六種組合的政策符合率全數提升，先前漏放的不安全內容可攔截 0.29 至 0.81，以人工標籤重評亦支持修正方向。十個排除於訓練外的攻擊家族注入實驗中，監控器於一百次執行全數在攻擊率上限前示警；一百個漂移事件裡七十九個僅靠探針更新即原地修復，放寬資料上限後達 87，fine-tuning 僅留給少數無法修復的事件。限制包括：偵測與維護實驗僅限單一分類器與單一部署、漂移為模擬而非自然發生、一致率相對單一 LLM 評審衡量，且探針需白箱權重存取。研究顯示部署後的政策調適與維護不必是權重更新問題。
